listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Boss Femme Eau De Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Hugo Boss Femme Eau De Parfum (75ml) is a gentle, ultra-feminine women's fragrance that envelopes you in a silky veil of elegance. As part of the iconic fashion house's extensive collection of scents, this women's EDP was designed to underline sensuality and emphasise natural charm with an aroma that's suitable for day wear or spring and summer months.The refreshingly radiant scent opens with fruit notes that blend seamlessly into delicate florals before ending with bold musk and woody tones. The fragrance is packaged in a distinctly feminine pink bottle with an elaborately spaced clear top. Top Notes: Freesia, Tangerine and Blackcurrant. Heart Notes: Lily, Jasmine and Bulgarian Rose. Base Notes: Amber, Lemon Tree and Apricot.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty For Him Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Gucci Guilty For Him Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a woody, aromatic and spicy EDP for men which seeks to intensify the traditional images of masculine beauty, enhancing their appeal with mystery and unconventionality. The combination of floral, citrus and spicy olfactory notes creates an unexpectedly invigorating retro vibe.The composition opens with the acidic, sweet, tanginess of Balsamic Vinegar blending with the heat of Red Chilli Pepper and floral tones of Rose. This leads on to the delicious harmony of a fruity, floral heart characterised by the delicacy of Neroli before the scent culminates in an earthy woody base of Cedar and Patchouli. The fragrance is housed in a sleek, matte black bottle with a silver cap and embossed G logo. Top Notes: Rose, Balsamic Vinegar, Red Chilli Pepper and Salt. Heart Notes: Lavender, Orange Blossom and Neroli. Base Notes: Cedar and Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Boss Femme Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Hugo Boss Boss Femme Eau De Parfum (30ml) is a gentle, ultra-feminine women's fragrance that envelopes you in a silky veil of elegance. As part of the iconic fashion house's extensive collection of scents, this women's EDP was designed to underline sensuality and emphasise natural charm with an aroma that's suitable for day wear or spring and summer months.The refreshingly radiant scent opens with fruit notes that blend seamlessly into delicate florals before ending with bold musk and woody tones. The fragrance is packaged in a distinctly feminine pink bottle with an elaborately spaced clear top. Top Notes: Freesia, Tangerine and Blackcurrant. Heart Notes: Lily, Jasmine and Bulgarian Rose. Base Notes: Amber, Lemon Tree and Apricot.

listings.rawTitle: Gres Cabochard Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Gres Cabochard Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a woody, seductive and exotic EDT for women which portrays strong-willed femininity.This elegant, spicy opening blends balsamic Galbanum, earthy Sage and floral Aldehydes, leading on to a floral heart of precious flowers including Rose, sensual Jasmine and richly sweet Ylang Ylang. The composition culminates in a provocatively leathery drydown with accents of Sandalwood, Patchouli and Leather Accord. Captivating and mysterious, Cabochard is a tribute to bold, spirited women who aren't afraid to walk their own path. It makes a strong impression, embodying audacious, determined and occasionally capricious femininity. Top Notes: Aldehydes, Galbanum and Sage. Heart Notes: Ylang Ylang, Rose and Jasmine. Base Notes: Leather Accord, Patchouli and Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Terre D'Hermes Eau De Toilette 200ml
listings.description: Hermes Terre D'Hermes Eau De Toilette (200ml) is a mineral, woody EDT which seeks to convey the humble and harmonious relationship between man and Earth, connecting him to his origins and to the elements of nature which provide the source of his creative power. Terre d'Hermes combines the strength of Cedarwood at the base with the radiance of Grapefruit and Orange at the top, adding a vibrant touch of Flint at the heart of the composition. Opening with the zest of Orange and bitterness of Grapefruit, the scent leads on to the vivacity of Pepper and fresh spices with the mineral effect of Flint and the coarseness of Vetiver. This culminates in a drydown dominated by Cedar, combined with the earthiness of Patchouli, the sweetness of resins and the impalpable voluptuousness of Benzoin. Top Notes: Orange and Grapefruit. Heart Notes: Pepper, Pelargonium and Flint. Base Notes: Vetiver, Cedar, Patchouli and Benzoin.

listings.rawTitle: Montale Intense Cafe Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Montale Intense Cafe Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an amber vanilla EDP for women and men with an addictive gourmand aspect, providing the perfect fix for all coffee lovers. Opening with a fragrant burst of floral notes, the composition moves on to a heart where the delightful aroma of Coffee Bean is augmented by the olfactory notes of fresh, vegetal Rose, the two combining in an unexpectedly dry yet refreshing scent. This culminates in a sophisticated base with creamy Vanilla and White Musk bringing a slight sweetness to the ambery drydown in which Coffee remains as a lingering, nutty presence. Top Notes: Floral Notes. Heart Notes: Rose and Coffee. Base Notes: Vanilla, White Musk and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Zadig & Voltaire This Is Him Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Zadig & Voltaire This Is Him! Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a sensual woody EDT for men which depicts the image of an urban adventurer, the epitome of a rock 'n' roll gentleman whose assured style emphasises his confidence. Opening with a melange of spicy Incense, Grapefruit and Black Pepper, the masculine heart combines creamy Vanilla with Incense. The concept of a free spirit is underlined by Zadig & Voltaire's signature olfactory note of Sandalwood in the base. Top Notes: Grapefruit. Heart Notes: Vanilla-Intense Accord. Base Notes: Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Sarah Jessica Parker NYC Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Sarah Jessica Parker NYC Eau De Parfum (30ml) is a celebration of fashion and fragrance inspired by the Sex and the City's star's synonymous relationship with style and New York. Influenced by the actress' love of layering unexpected clothes and scents, NYC Eau De Parfum is a deliciously addictive floral fragrance that embodies fashion and feminine expression. The perfume was released in 2010 and described as a party in a bottle, a sensual, floral fragrance that is suitable for both everyday wear and special occasions. The perfume comes packaged in a fun spray that is colourfully adorned with contrasting prints, a signature style of SJP's Carrie Bradshaw character. Cruelty-free. Top Notes: Mandarin, White Ostmanthus and Wild Strawberries. Heart Notes: Gardenia, Honeysuckle, Mimosa and Red Damascene Rose. Base Notes: Vanilla, Sandalwood, Musk and Rum.

listings.rawTitle: Montale Sensual Instinct Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Montale Sensual Instinct Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an amber vanilla EDP for women and men which is irresistibly elegant whilst inviting obsession. Its innate sensuality encourages the wearer to release their most primitive instinct. Lush, warm and dense, the composition opens with the vibrant notes of Roasted Coffee Beans, leading on to a heart balancing the olfactory mysteries of Rose and Praline balance with mesmerising sensuality. This culminates in a sublime base combining precious Amber and the subtlety of Cedarwood and Oakmoss. Top Notes: Roasted Coffee Beans. Heart Notes: Praline and Rose. Base Notes: Oakmoss, Amber and Cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Montale Starry Nights Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Montale Starry Nights Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an amber floral EDP for women and men with a celestial composition featuring Calabrian Bergamot shining like a star, lighting the olfactory path to a floral heart of Bulgarian Rose and Egyptian Jasmine augmented by the oriental notes of earthy Sumatran Patchouli. The scent culminates in a long-lasting drydown combining Powdery Notes, White Musk and Amber. Top Notes: Apple, Bergamot and Lemon. Heart Notes: Rose, Patchouli and Jasmine. Base Notes: White Musk, Powdery Notes and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Neutrogena Hydro Boost Water Gel Cleanser Fragrance-Free 200ml
listings.description: Neutrogena Hydro Boost Fragrance-Free Water Gel Cleanser (200ml) has been expertly formulated with Natural Moisturising Factors (NMFs) including Hyaluronic Acid and Glycerin which occur naturally in the skin to gently and thoroughly cleanse skin, locking in moisture.This cleanser effectively washes away dirt, oil and makeup. The non-comedogenic formula transforms into a silky lather, rinsing away easily, leaving skin feeling refreshingly clean and soft. Free from fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Woman Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Versace Woman Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an elegant and feminine floral, woody EDP that captures the essence of timeless beauty and sensuality. It is designed for women who exude confidence and grace, making it a perfect addition to any collection. The perfume embraces a harmonious blend of delicate florals and warm, woody notes, offering a versatile scent for both day and evening wear. The fragrance opens with a fresh burst of Frangipani Blossoms and Jasmine, creating a captivating floral introduction. The heart reveals a soft blend of Lotus and Cedarwood, adding a natural depth to the composition. Finally, the base brings a comforting touch of Musk and Amber, rounding off the scent with warmth and sophistication. Top Notes: Frangipani Blossoms, Jasmine. Heart Notes: Lotus, Cedarwood. Base Notes: Musk, Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Ted Baker X20 Extraordinary Women's Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Ted Baker X20 Extraordinary Women's Eau De Toilette (100ml) is an elegant fruity, floral EDT for women.Opening with top notes of Star Anise and Grapefruit, the composition leads on to a fruity floral heart of Plum, Magnolia and Water Lily. This culminates in an earthy drydown of Musk and Precious Woods. Top Notes: Grapefruit and Star Anise. Heart Notes: Magnolia, Mirabelle Plum and Water Lily. Base Notes: Precious Woods and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Dear, Klairs Supple Preparation Facial Toner Unscented 180ml
listings.description: Dear, Klairs Supple Preparation Facial Toner Unscented (180ml) is an oil-free, hydrating toner with a fast-absorbing, lightweight texture which infuses deep moisture into the skin. This toner balances the pH and increases the effectiveness of your skincare regime without irritating sensitive skin.Enriched with a soothing blend of plant-based extracts, hydrating Hyaluronic Acid, and calming Centella Asiatica, this lightweight toner is an essential first step in your skincare regimen. Lipidure and Beta-Glucan optimise hydration levels and help to prepare the skin to absorb further treatments, enhancing their effectiveness. Cruelty-free & vegan-friendly.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana The One for Men Intense Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Dolce & Gabbana The One for Men Intense Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a leather-scented EDP for men with woody, ambery notes reflecting masculine charisma and sophisticated elegance. Combining radiant warm notes with deep, elegant accords, The One for Men Eau de Parfum Intense elevates the irresistible appeal of the wearer with its striking intensity.With its air of timeless elegance, the composition melds warm Neroli facets with earthy Black Leather creating an air of olfactory chiaroscuro. Opening with a warm, spicy combination of Golden Neroli Essence, fresh Cypress and aromatic Cardamom, the heart features Cashmeran with its spicy overtones, calming Clary Sage and resinous Benzoin. This culminates in an intoxicating drydown blending the smoky notes of Leather with the earthy spice of Patchouli and refinement of Cistus Labdanum. Bottled in a refined flacon with clean, geometric lines and gold detail, the bottle conveys the sensuality and elegance of the liquid within. Top Notes: Cardamom, Neroli and Cypress. Heart Notes: Cashmeran, Benzoin, Neroli and Clary Sage. Base Notes: Leather, Neroli, Patchouli and Labdanum.

listings.rawTitle: Ted Baker X20 Extraordinary Men's Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Ted Baker X20 Extraordinary Men's Eau De Toilette (100ml) is an oriental spicy EDT for men.This composition opens with a combination of fruity, herbal and spicy notes featuring Tea, Tangerine and Cardamom. The opening then leads on to a predominantly floral heart of Lavender, Rosemary and Violet Leaf before culminating in a warm, ambery drydown of Sandalwood and Amber with the spicy influence of Pepper. Top Notes: Tea, Tangerine and Cardamom. Heart Notes: Spices, Lavender, Rosemary and Violet Leaf. Base Notes: Sandalwood, Pepper and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Nuxe Prodigieux Beautifying Scented Body Lotion 200ml
listings.description: Nuxe Prodigieux Beautifying Scented Body Lotion (200ml) is a luxurious skin enhancer that combines the allure of precious botanical oils with the brand's signature fragrance, Huile Prodigieuse. Infused with oils from Camellia, Argan, Sweet Almond, Macadamia, Hazelnut, and Borage, this lotion offers deep moisturisation while leaving the skin with a silky, luminous finish.These botanical ingredients contribute to its 91.7% natural origin composition, ensuring a gentle and nurturing experience for all skin types. The enchanting scent is characterised by notes of Orange Blossom, Magnolia, and Vanilla, providing a subtle, warm, and sensual aroma that enhances the skincare ritual. This product is ideal for daily use to maintain supple and beautifully scented skin. Cruelty-free & vegan-friendly.

listings.rawTitle: Vera Wang Princess Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Vera Wang Princess Eau De Toilette (100ml) is from the fragrance collection of Vera Wang, the New York fashion designer renowned for creating wedding dresses for celebrities. Princess is a sheer, floral perfume that is described as an enchanting celebration of modern femininity. Packaged in a lilac, heart-shaped bottle that is topped with a bejewelled golden crown. Top Notes: Water Lilly, Apple, Freshly Squeezed Mandarin, and Apricot. Heart Notes: Guava, Tiare Flower, Tuberose, Dark Chocolate, and Pink Frosting Accord. Base Notes: Chiffon Vanilla, Amber, and Forbidden Woods.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Pi Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Givenchy Pi Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a refined, woody amber EDT designed for the charismatic creator and curious explorer. This scent is woven with sensual undertones, presenting a dynamic journey for the senses.The olfactory experience begins with the vibrant freshness of Mandarin Orange and Basil, setting a refreshing tone. The heart unfolds with the robust notes of Iron Wood and Geranium, enriched by the deep, resinous aroma of Benzoin Crystals, adding an animalistic intensity. The journey concludes with a warm and inviting drydown of creamy Vanilla and toasted Tonka Bean, enhanced by the woody depth of Cedar. Encased in a sophisticated geometric glass bottle with elegant gold accents, this fragrance is a testament to bold exploration. Top Notes: Mandarin Orange, Galbanum, and Basil. Heart Notes: Iron Wood, Benzoin Crystals, Geranium. Base Notes: Infinium, Vanilla, Tonka Bean and Cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Eau De Toilette 200ml
listings.description: Marc Jacobs Daisy Eau De Toilette (200ml) is a floral EDT for women which effectively conveys the joyful, free spirit of the Marc Jacobs woman with their exuberant, unquestioning joie de vivre.This composition opens with a zesty, floral melange with the tender, powdery softness of Violet combining with citrusy sweet Wild Berries. This leads on to a heart of heady Jasmine with its rich, sensual, and musky notes, culminating in an earthy dry down of Sandalwood. The fragrance is presented in a lovely bottle decorated with daisy flowers atop. Top Notes: Wild Berries and White Violet. Heart Notes: Jasmine Infusion. Base Notes: Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau D'Issey Pour Homme Eau De Toilette Gift Set 75ml
listings.description: Issey Miyake L'Eau D'Issey Pour Homme Eau De Toilette Gift Set (75ml) is a beautifully presented 2 piece fragrance gift set containing a 75ml EDT and 75g Deodorant Stick in this invigorating fragrance for men. Collection Contains: 1 x Issey Miyake L'Eau D'Issey Pour Homme Eau De Toilette (75ml) - a refreshingly invigorating men's fragrance that was launched in 1994 as the brand's signature scent. The truly timeless fragrance is both delicate and masculine - a classic aroma that radiates power and prestige. The scent opens with fresh herb and citrus notes that give way to exotic spices and light floral accents before leaving a lasting impression with warm, woody tones. L'Eau D'Issey is a subtle yet sophisticated scent that is equally manly as it is modest. Packaged in the iconic Issey Miyake bottle inspired by waterfalls - with slender, frosted glass widening at the base. 1 x Issey Miyake L'Eau D'Issey Pour Homme Deodorant Stick (75g) - combines long-lasting freshness with calming properties to soothe and refresh your underarms and body. This deodorant stick leaves behind this refreshingly invigorating men's fragrance which was launched in 1994 as the brand's signature scent. The truly timeless fragrance is both delicate and masculine - a classic aroma that radiates power and prestige.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Erba Gold Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Xerjoff Erba Gold Eau De Parfum (50ml) is an enticing EDP which captivates and charms with its mesmerising, inspiring melange of olfactory notes. Fresh and fruity, the composition blends citrusy top notes of Amalfi Lemon, Brazilian Orange and Ginger with a spicy heart of Guatemalan Cardamom and Cinnamon. This culminates in an enticingly warm base of White Musk, Amber and Madagascan Vanilla. The epitome of style and contemporary flair, Xerjoff Erba perfumes are presented with a silk neck scarf designed by Xerjoff and manufactured in Lake Como, Italy's silk capital. Top Notes: Amalfi Lemon, Calabrian Bergamot, Brazilian Orange and Ginger. Heart Notes: Green Apple, Melon, Pear, Cloves, Guatemalan Cardamom and Madagascan Cinnamon. Base Notes: Musk, Amber, Madagascan Vanilla and Woody Notes.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Eau Des Merveilles Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Hermes Eau Des Merveilles Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a captivating fragrance that invites one into the whimsical world of Hermes, where the line between the ordinary and the magical blurs, revealing a universe sprinkled with stars visible in the daylight. The EDT is a harmonious blend of woody and amber notes, with the comforting warmth of Benzoin, the zest of Bigarade Orange, and the spicy undertone of Elemi. Eau des Merveilles, the herald of the Merveilles collection, serves as an invitation to explore the enchanting and the extraordinary, keeping one's feet on the ground with its dry, spicy notes, while allowing the imagination to soar among the stars. The bottle mirrors the enchanting essence of the fragrance with a star-spangled design that captures and plays with light, ranging from fiery orange to soft, ethereal tones. Adorned with the house's emblematic Clou de Selle seal on the spray top, it is a treasure trove that holds within it the house's poetic and somewhat whimsical view of the world. Top Notes: Orange, Elemi Reson and Lemon. Heart Notes: Amber, Pepper, Pink Pepper and Violet. Base Notes: Fir, Cedar, Vetiver, Oakmoss and Benzoin.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Colonia Essenza Eau De Cologne 50ml
listings.description: Acqua Di Parma Colonia Essenza Eau De Cologne (50ml) exudes a fragrance which embodies the traditional values of the Colonia while embracing a modern perspective.This EDC a citrus-scented and woody fragrance with a strong personality. Its classic freshness becomes even more vivacious with the addition of floral scents like Grapefruit, Mandarin and Petit Grain notes, all brought together by a vibrant woody Patchouli base. The sophisticated woody notes lend an elegant sober touch to this cologne. Top Notes: Lemon, Orange, Bergamot, Mandarin, Grapefruit, Neroli and Petit Grain. Heart Notes: Rosemary, Lily of the Valley, Rose Accord, Jasmine Accord and Cloves. Base Notes: Vetiver, Patchouli, White Musk and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Alexandria II Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Xerjoff Alexandria II Eau De Parfum (100ml) forms part of the Oud Stars Collection which takes its inspiration from the journey of Ibn Battuta. He has honoured the cities he visited by creating an exquisitely crafted perfume for each one. This EDP conveys the spirit of Alexandria, a city scent steeped in history and rich culture. This diversity is reflected in the wealth of olfactory notes, each drawn from the ancient Arabian art of perfumery. The composition opens with the zesty, citrus hints of Apple, elegantly blending with floral Lavender and Rosewood. This leads on to an overtly oriental heart where Cedarwood meets the fragrant florality of Lily of the Valley and Bulgarian Rose. Concluding this tribute to the thousand-year-old capital city, Alexandria II Xerjoff combines warming base notes of Amber, Sandalwood and precious Laotian Oud. Top Notes: Rosewood and Lavender, Cinnamon and Apple. Heart Notes: Lily Of The Valley, Bulgarian Rose and Cedarwood. Base Notes: Sandalwood, Musk, Laotian Ouds, Amber and Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Al Haramain Amber Oud Gold Eau De Parfum 120ml
listings.description: Al Haramain Amber Oud Gold Eau De Parfum (120ml) is an Arabian EDP from the House of Al Haramain which apprises everyone in the vicinity of the wearer's presence, arousing their attention. Staying true to the tradition of woody Amber Oud eau de parfum, this gold edition represents decadence in a bottle.Melding perfectly matched olfactory ingredients, the impeccable composition opens with a zingy citrus burst, combining the natural fruity freshness of Bergamot with Green Notes. This leads on to an exclusively gourmand heart of Melon and Pineapple, perpetuating the captivating yet delicate, fruity theme. The scent culminates in a woody and sensual drydown where Musk and Woody Notes are warmed by the presence of sensual, creamy Vanilla. Top Notes: Bergamot and Green Notes. Heart Notes: Melon, Pineapple and Gourmand. Base Notes: Woody Notes, Vanilla and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Sol De Janeiro Brazilian Crush Cheirosa '62 Fragrance Mist 240ml
listings.description: Sol De Janeiro Brazilian Crush Cheirosa '62 Fragrance Mist (240ml) is a body fragrance mist which can be used on the body, hair, and lingerie to ensure that you are 'cheirosa', as they say in Brazil - smelling delightful from dusk until dawn.Bursting with an alluring Pistachio and Salted Caramel scent, enhanced by Heliotrope, Jasmine Petals, Almond and Sandalwood, it instantly transports you to the sultry beaches of Rio de Janeiro. Dermatologically tested. Free from sulphate, phthalate and paraben. Cruelty-free & vegan-friendly. Top Notes: Pistachio and Almond. Heart Notes: Heliotrope and Jasmine Petals. Base Notes: Vanilla, Salted Caramel and Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Sol De Janeiro Rio Radiance Cheirosa '87 Fragrance Mist 90ml
listings.description: Sol De Janeiro Rio Radiance Cheirosa '87 Fragrance Mist (90ml) is a body fragrance mist which can be used on the body, hair, and lingerie to ensure that you are 'cheirosa', as they say in Brazil - smelling delightful from dusk until dawn. Bursting with an alluring Solar Tuberose & Leite De Coco scent, enhanced by Warm Sand, Ylang-Ylang, Vanilla and Amber, this floral scent instantly transports you to the sultry beaches of Rio de Janeiro. Dermatologically tested. Free from sulphate, phthalate and paraben. Cruelty-free & vegan-friendly. Top Notes: Leite De Coco and Warm Sand. Heart Notes: Solar Tuberose and Ylang-Ylang. Base Notes: Creamy Vanilla and Amber Essence.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Erba Pura Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Xerjoff Erba Pura Eau De Parfum (50ml) is an enticing EDP which captivates and charms with its mesmerising, inspiring melange of olfactory notes. Fresh and fruity, the composition blends top notes of Sicilian Orange and Lemon with a multifaceted Mediterranean fruit basket at its heart. The slow release notes of White Musk, Amber and Madagascan Vanilla Bean sit in the base gradually reveal themselves. The epitome of style and contemporary flair, Xerjoff Vibe perfumes are presented with a silk neck scarf designed by Xerjoff and manufactured in Lake Como, Italy's silk capital. Top Notes: Sicilian Orange And Lemon, and Calabrian Bergamot. Heart Notes: Mediterranean Fruity Basket. Base notes: Amber, Madagascan Vanilla Bean and White Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Sol De Janeiro Brazilian Crush Cheirosa '68 Fragrance Mist 240ml
listings.description: Sol De Janeiro Brazilian Crush Cheirosa '68 Fragrance Mist (240ml) is a fruity floral fragrance which draws inspiration from the year 1968 when the Tropicalia Movement influenced an exciting musical and cultural shift in Brazil.Depicting this celebration of colourful energy, the scent is bright and blooming with vibrant notes of Brazilian Jasmine, Pink Dragonfruit and creamy Vanilla. It has a refreshing feel reminiscent of a lush oasis by the sea or a garden in Rio. Dermatologically tested. Free from sulphate, phthalate and paraben. Cruelty-free & vegan-friendly. Top Notes: Pink Dragonfruit and Lychee Essence. Heart Notes: Brazilian Jasmine, Ocean Air and Hibiscus. Base Notes: Sheer Vanilla and Sun Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradoxe Virtual Flower Eau De Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Prada Paradoxe Virtual Flower Eau De Parfum (90ml) is a floral musky fragrance which features the complex, sensual scent of Jasmine - floral, soft and sweet.This composition opens with the citrus zest of Vert De Bergamot, leading on to a complex melange in the heart blending the floral, citrus and green notes of Jasmine and Neroli. This culminates in a comforting base with Musk and Ambrette. Top Notes: Vert de Bergamot. Heart Notes: Jasmine Accord. Base Notes: Musk Accord.

listings.rawTitle: Al Haramain Amber Oud Gold Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Al Haramain Amber Oud Gold Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an Arabian EDP from the House of Al Haramain which apprises everyone in the vicinity of the wearer's presence, arousing their attention. Staying true to the tradition of woody Amber Oud eau de parfum, this gold edition represents decadence in a bottle.Melding perfectly matched olfactory ingredients, the impeccable composition opens with a zingy citrus burst, combining the natural fruity freshness of Bergamot with Green Notes. This leads on to an exclusively gourmand heart of Melon and Pineapple, perpetuating the captivating yet delicate, fruity theme. The scent culminates in a woody and sensual drydown where Musk and Woody Notes are warmed by the presence of sensual, creamy Vanilla. Top Notes: Bergamot and Green Notes. Heart Notes: Melon, Pineapple and Gourmand. Base Notes: Woody Notes, Vanilla and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Pour Homme Profondo Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Pour Homme Profondo Parfum (100ml) is an aromatic, aquatic masculine fragrance which reinterprets the iconic Acqua di Gio in a contemporary, intensely marine manner. Combining marine notes with aromatic essences, Acqua di Gio Profondo is a captivating exploration of the profundity of the soul, encompassing the aspects of freedom, sensuality and masculinity.Reminiscent of diving into the deep blue ocean, the composition opens with a shock to the senses with zesty Green Mandarin and Bergamot meeting Acqua di Gio's iconic marine notes. This leads on to a heart of Rosemary, Lavender, Cypress and Lentisk Absolute. The scent culminates in a base portraying an intense masculine character with notes of earthy Patchouli and powdery, leathery Musk melding with a mineral ambery accord. The fragrant liquid of Acqua di Gio Profondo is housed in an elegant, frosted glass bottle in deep navy blue, reflecting the ocean depths it conveys. Top Notes: Bergamot and Brazilian Green Mandarin. Heart Notes: Rosemary, Lavender, Cypress and Lentisk Absolute. Base Notes: Mineral Amber Accord, Guatemalan Patchouli and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Al Haramain L'Aventure Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Al Haramain L'Aventure Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an Arabian EDP for men from the House of Al Haramain which apprises everyone in the vicinity of the wearer's presence, arousing their attention. Perfectly crafted for the resilient, adventurous spirit exploring uncharted destinations, this delightful scent lingers constantly. Melding perfectly matched olfactory ingredients, the composition opens with a zingy citrus burst blending Bergamot, Pineapple, Pink Berries and Blackcurrant. This leads on to a floral heart of Rose and fragrant Freesia which is warmed by the balsamic, aromatic notes of Cedar. The scent culminates in an earthy, musky drydown where Sandalwood, Patchouli, Amber and Musk conspire to leave a sensuous conclusion. Top Notes: Bergamot, Blackcurrant, Pink Berries and Pineapple. Heart Notes: Rose, Freesia and Cedarwood. Base Notes: Sandalwood, Patchouli, Amber and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Accento Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Xerjoff Accento Eau De Parfum (50ml) is an indulgent, romantic EDP with a fruity character which conveys a wearer possessing elegant flair. The composition opens with a fruity floral combination of top notes with fresh Pineapple and Hyacinth whilst a refined heart of fragrant Jasmine, Iris and spicy Pink Pepper gives the parfum a classy edge. The warmth of the olfactory melange in the base augments this classiness with earthy Patchouli, Amber and Musk completing the mix. Accento is presented with a unique silk neck scarf designed by Xerjoff and produced by famous silk manufacturers in Lake Como. Top Notes: Pineapple and Hyacinth. Heart Notes: Jasmine, Iris and Pink Pepper. Base Notes: Patchouli, Musk, Vanilla, Amber and Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Dark Leather Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Dark Leather Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a warm and sensual, woody, leathery EDP for men which elevates the Spicebomb collection's renowned seduction and masculinity to an unprecedented level, bestowing the wearer with enigmatic magnetism.A complex and refined fragrance of smoky woods and warm spices, the composition reveals a diverse masculinity - sensual yet strong, subversive yet sophisticated. Combining Dark Leather with a rich melange of smoky woods and warm spices, the scent conveys complexity and sophistication. Opening with notes of spicy Black Pepper, Nutmeg and warming Cinnamon, the heart offers an olfactory contrast with smoky Incense, and zesty Cardamom. The nuanced drydown of Dark Leather and Tobacco accord heighten the enduring intensity of masculinity. Top Notes: Black Pepper and Nutmeg. Heart Notes: Cardamom, Cinnamon and Frankincense. Base Notes: Black Leather and Tobacco.

listings.rawTitle: Lancome La Vie Est Belle Elixir Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Lancome La Vie Est Belle Elixir Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a velvety, fruity floral, gourmand EDP for the woman whose happiness is derived from exceeding expectations, pursuing intuitions and fiercely following her dream. Featuring the combination of a noble Violet Leaf Absolute and a delightful Cocoa Butter Absolute, the uplifting composition conveys the liberation that self-confidence brings.Opening with notes of sparkling Raspberry liquor, combined with the brightness of Bergamot, the composition moves on to an intense heart with velvety Violet Absolute heightened by Rose Absolute, evoking a modern florality. This culminates in a sensual base where the delicious notes of the Cocoa Butter Absolute is enhanced by Leather Accord and the warmth of elegant Cedarwood. The fragrant liquid is housed in the iconic crystal smile bottle, the smile on this occasion etched into the glass. Top Notes: Raspberry, Liquor and Calabrian Bergamot. Heart Notes: Violet Leaf and Rose. Base Notes: Leather, Cacao Butter and Cedarwood.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Dark Leather Eau De Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Dark Leather Eau De Parfum (90ml) is a warm and sensual, woody, leathery EDP for men which elevates the Spicebomb collection's renowned seduction and masculinity to an unprecedented level, bestowing the wearer with enigmatic magnetism.A complex and refined fragrance of smoky woods and warm spices, the composition reveals a diverse masculinity - sensual yet strong, subversive yet sophisticated. Combining Dark Leather with a rich melange of smoky woods and warm spices, the scent conveys complexity and sophistication. Opening with notes of spicy Black Pepper, Nutmeg and warming Cinnamon, the heart offers an olfactory contrast with smoky Incense, and zesty Cardamom. The nuanced drydown of Dark Leather and Tobacco accord heighten the enduring intensity of masculinity. Top Notes: Black Pepper and Nutmeg. Heart Notes: Cardamom, Cinnamon and Frankincense. Base Notes: Black Leather and Tobacco.

listings.rawTitle: Sol De Janeiro Brazilian Crush Cheirosa '68 Fragrance Mist 90ml
listings.description: Sol De Janeiro Brazilian Crush Cheirosa '68 Fragrance Mist (90ml) is a fruity floral fragrance which draws inspiration from the year 1968 when the Tropicalia Movement influenced an exciting musical and cultural shift in Brazil. Depicting this celebration of colourful energy, the scent is bright and blooming with vibrant notes of Brazilian Jasmine, Pink Dragonfruit and creamy Vanilla. It has a refreshing feel reminiscent of a lush oasis by the sea or a garden in Rio. Dermatologically tested. Free from sulphate, phthalate and paraben. Cruelty-free & vegan-friendly. Top Notes: Pink Dragonfruit and Lychee Essence. Heart Notes: Brazilian Jasmine, Ocean Air and Hibiscus. Base Notes: Sheer Vanilla and Sun Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Sol De Janeiro Rio Radiance Cheirosa '87 Fragrance Mist 240ml
listings.description: Sol De Janeiro Rio Radiance Cheirosa '87 Fragrance Mist (240ml) is a body fragrance mist which can be used on the body, hair, and lingerie to ensure that you are 'cheirosa', as they say in Brazil - smelling delightful from dusk until dawn.Bursting with an alluring Solar Tuberose & Leite De Coco scent, enhanced by Warm Sand, Ylang-Ylang, Vanilla and Amber, this floral scent instantly transports you to the sultry beaches of Rio de Janeiro. Dermatologically tested. Free from sulphate, phthalate and paraben. Cruelty-free & vegan-friendly. Top Notes: leite De Coco and Warm Sand. Heart Notes: Solar Tuberose and Ylang-Ylang. Base Notes: Creamy Vanilla and Amber Essence.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff More Than Words Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Xerjoff More Than Words Eau De Parfum (50ml) is an evocative EDP that blends smoky and woody notes with a deep, rich sweetness. The scent opens with a complex mix of smoky Labdanum and enchanting wood, creating a captivating introduction. As the fragrance unfolds, it delves into exotic realms with the inclusion of Oud and Benzoin, providing a warm and sensual backdrop. This composition is complemented by hints of Amber, which enhance the fragrance's richness and depth. The overall effect is a luxurious and profound scent that's well-suited for those who appreciate a sophisticated and layered aromatic experience. Top Notes: Smoky Labdanum and Wood. Heart Notes: Oud and Benzoin. Base Notes: Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Sabrina Carpenter Sweet Tooth Caramel Dream Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Sabrina Carpenter Sweet Tooth Caramel Dream Eau De Parfum (30ml) is a decadent oriental Vanilla fragrance for women with a delightful Caramel twist, oozing delectably gourmand notes. At once playful and sophisticated, the composition combines rich flavours with luxurious scents.The composition opens with a combination of Almond Milk and fragrant...

listings.rawTitle: Sabrina Carpenter Sweet Tooth Caramel Dream Eau De Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Sabrina Carpenter Sweet Tooth Caramel Dream Eau De Parfum (75ml) is a decadent oriental Vanilla fragrance for women with a delightful Caramel twist, oozing delectably gourmand notes. At once playful and sophisticated, the composition combines rich flavours with luxurious scents.The composition opens with a combination of Almond Milk and fragrant Freesia together with the zesty citrus notes of Sugared Lemon and Orange Zest. This leads on to a heart where the candied offering moves over to the dark side as Dark Chocolate Bean combines with Orange Blossom, Tiger Orchid and Vanilla. The scent culminates in an opulent, rich drydown of warm Sandalwood, Caramelised Amber, earthy Patchouli and fluffy Musk. The fragrant liquid is housed in the iconic chocolate bar-shaped bottle in a light caramel shade, dusted with a pearlescent opaque finish for an irresistible sugary sparkle. Cruelty-free & vegan-friendly. Top Notes: Sugar, Almond Milk, Orange, Lemon and Freesia. Heart Notes: Dark Chocolate, Vanilla, Orchid and Orange Blossom. Base Notes: Caramel, Patchouli, Musk, Amber and Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Erba Pura Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Xerjoff Erba Pura Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an enticing EDP which captivates and charms with its mesmerising, inspiring melange of olfactory notes. Fresh and fruity, the composition blends top notes of Sicilian Orange and Lemon with a multifaceted Mediterranean fruit basket at its heart. The slow release notes of White Musk, Amber and Madagascan Vanilla Bean sit in the base gradually reveal themselves. The epitome of style and contemporary flair, Xerjoff Vibe perfumes are presented with a silk neck scarf designed by Xerjoff and manufactured in Lake Como, Italy's silk capital. Top Notes: Sicilian Orange And Lemon, and Calabrian Bergamot. Heart Notes: Mediterranean Fruity Basket. Base notes: Amber, Madagascan Vanilla Bean and White Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Lattafa Khamrah Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Lattafa Khamrah Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an aromatic oriental spicy fragrance for women and men with an opulent composition which blends precious spices, the warmth of woody notes and the creamy, sensual softness of Vanilla.Opening with the zesty citrus freshness of Bergamot in combination with the warm, velvety spice of Cinnamon and the clean, herbaceous aroma of Clary Sage, the scent moves on to a heart which resonates with the sumptuous creamy notes of Praline, luxuriating in a fragrant haze of Tuberose, delicate, green Mahonial and Dates. This culminates in a deeply aromatic base where spicy precious woods, smoky Myrrh, spicy Tonka Bean and resinous Benzoin meet the creamy sweetness of Vanilla. Top Notes: Cinnamon, Nutmeg and Bergamot. Heart Notes: Dates, Praline, Tuberose and Mahonial. Base Notes: Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Amberwood, Myrrh, Benzoin and Akigalawood.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff K'Bridge Club Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Xerjoff K'Bridge Club Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a luxurious and unique EDP that captures the essence of Knightsbridge's opulent shopping atmosphere. This unisex scent is notable for its rich blend of floral and gourmand notes, creating a sophisticated aroma profile. It opens with the elegant floral note of Bulgarian Rose, complemented by the spice of Coriander. The heart of the fragrance continues with Rose, enhancing the floral theme, while the base introduces the sweet warmth of Bourbon Vanilla and Caramel, adding depth and a lasting impression. Top Notes: Bulgarian Rose. Heart Notes: Absolute of Rose. Base Notes: Vanilla Bourbon and Caramel.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradoxe Virtual Flower Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Prada Paradoxe Virtual Flower Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a floral musky fragrance which features the complex, sensual scent of Jasmine - floral, soft and sweet.This composition opens with the citrus zest of Vert De Bergamot, leading on to a complex melange in the heart blending the floral, citrus and green notes of Jasmine and Neroli. This culminates in a comforting base with Musk and Ambrette. Top Notes: Vert de Bergamot. Heart Notes: Jasmine Accord. Base Notes: Musk Accord.

listings.rawTitle: Sol De Janeiro Delicia Drench Cheirosa '59 Fragrance Mist 90ml
listings.description: Sol De Janeiro Delicia Drench Cheirosa '59 Fragrance Mist (90ml) captivates the essence of a Brazilian sunset with its warm, sweet, and uplifting fragrance, perfect for use on body, hair, and lingerie.Inspired by the groundbreaking 1959 bossa nova album 'Chega de Saudade' by Joao Gilberto, this mist wraps you in notes of Vanilla Orchid, Sugared Violet, and Sheer Sandalwood, blended harmoniously with the richness of Velvet Plum and the freshness of Vetiver. Dermatologically tested. Free from sulphate, phthalate, and paraben. Cruelty-free & vegan-friendly. Top Notes: Velvet Plum, Sugared Violet. Heart Notes: Vanilla Orchid, Whipped Amber. Base Notes: Sheer Sandalwood, Fresh Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff Erba Gold Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Xerjoff Erba Gold Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an enticing EDP which captivates and charms with its mesmerising, inspiring melange of olfactory notes. Fresh and fruity, the composition blends citrusy top notes of Amalfi Lemon, Brazilian Orange and Ginger with a spicy heart of Guatemalan Cardamom and Cinnamon. This culminates in an enticingly warm base of White Musk, Amber and Madagascan Vanilla. The epitome of style and contemporary flair, Xerjoff Erba perfumes are presented with a silk neck scarf designed by Xerjoff and manufactured in Lake Como, Italy's silk capital. Top Notes: Amalfi Lemon, Calabrian Bergamot, Brazilian Orange and Ginger. Heart Notes: Green Apple, Melon, Pear, Cloves, Guatemalan Cardamom and Madagascan Cinnamon. Base Notes: Musk, Amber, Madagascan Vanilla and Woody Notes.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff More Than Words Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Xerjoff More Than Words Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an evocative EDP that blends smoky and woody notes with a deep, rich sweetness. The scent opens with a complex mix of smoky Labdanum and enchanting wood, creating a captivating introduction. As the fragrance unfolds, it delves into exotic realms with the inclusion of Oud and Benzoin, providing a warm and sensual backdrop. This composition is complemented by hints of Amber, which enhance the fragrance's richness and depth. The overall effect is a luxurious and profound scent that's well-suited for those who appreciate a sophisticated and layered aromatic experience. Top Notes: Smoky Labdanum and Wood. Heart Notes: Oud and Benzoin. Base Notes: Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Xerjoff 40 Knots Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Xerjoff 40 Knots Eau De Parfum (50ml) embodies the essence of the luxurious yachting lifestyle in the Mediterranean. Part of Xerjoff's exclusive 'Join the Club' collection, which celebrates various elite pursuits from art to yachting, this unisex marine EDP invites wearers to delve into a vivid imaginary world. The scent captures the exhilaration of sailing across the open sea, with vivid notes that suggest the freshness of marine life and the salty breeze. Its composition, while kept secret to maintain its exclusivity, features an invigorating mix of Woody Notes, Cedar, Sea Water, Salt, and Green Notes, crafting a unique olfactory experience that conveys freedom and adventure on the high seas. Top Notes: Sea Water and Green Notes. Heart Notes: Cedar. Base Notes: Woody Notes and Salt.

listings.rawTitle: Byredo Gypsy Water Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Byredo Gypsy Water Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a woody aromatic EDP for women and men whose name and composition pay homage to the beauty of Romani culture, its unique values, intimate beliefs and alternative way of life. Created with a medium intensity, the scent depicts the concept of an innately nomadic, characterful lifestyle.Opening with a zesty, spicy melange of Bergamot, Juniper Berries, Lemon and Pepper, the olfactory trail leads on to woody notes of Pine Needle, powdery Orris and exotic Incense before culminating in a sensual base of creamy Vanilla, Sandalwood and powdery Amber. Top Notes: Bergamot, Juniper Berries, Lemon and Pepper. Heart Notes: Incense, Orris and Pine Needle. Base Notes: Amber, Sandalwood and Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry London For Women Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Burberry London For Women Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a stylish floral, fresh signature scent, perfect for daytime or evening wear. It opens with tender notes of elegant Rose and Honeysuckle.Solar notes of Sandalwood, Musk and Patchouli add a subtle warmth to create a distinctive and inspiring fragrance. The classic chunky bottle is wrapped in iconic Burberry check fabric. Top Notes: Rose and Honeysuckle. Heart Notes: Tiare Flower, Jasmine, Peony and Clementine Zest. Base Notes: Sandalwood, Musk and Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Cacharel Amor Amor Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Cacharel Amor Amor Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a floral women's fragrance that was created to capture the electric sensation of love at first sight. The scent makes a passionate declaration twice - using the French word for love.Amor Amor was the first fragrance from Cacheral to use fruit accords, which combine with floral notes to create a captivatingly delicate and feminine aroma. This women's EDT opens with vibrant Pink Grapefruit that makes way for romantic and luxurious flowers before ending in sensuous tones that leave a lasting impression. The fragrance is packaged in a striking red bottle with a rose motif and distinctive metal cap. Cruelty-free. Top notes: Blackcurrant and Pink Grapefruit. Heart notes: Jasmine, Lily of the Valley and Rose. Base notes: Vanilla, Cedar and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Weekend Men Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Burberry Weekend Men Eau De Toilette (100ml) is an invigorating, fruity men's EDT, light, luminous and elegant in character.This perfume opens with zingy citrus top notes of fresh Lemon, Grapefruit and Sweet Tangerine, leading on to softer heart notes combining Oak Moss, Ivy Leaves and Sandalwood. This culminates in a warm and radiant dry down of Honey, Amber, and Musk. Presented in a minimalistic glass bottle decorated with a white logo and check trim, the brushed silver cap has been engraved with the Burberry logo. Top Notes: Lemon, Grapefruit and Sweet Tangerine. Heart Notes: Oak Moss, Ivy Leaves and Sandalwood. Base Notes: Honey, Amber and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Fico Di Amalfi Eau De Toilette 30ml
listings.description: Acqua Di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Fico Di Amalfi Eau De Toilette (30ml) is a fresh and fruity EDT for men and women, which exudes a revitalising fragrance which continuously surprises just like the stunning landscape of the Amalfi coast.This fragrance is characterised by its fruity notes of Bergamot, Lemon, Grapefruit and Cedar Wood. At its heart, notes of Fig come together with Pink Pepper scents and Jasmine Petals accords while the base of this fragrance is rounded off with harmonious accents of Fig, Cedar Wood and Benzoin. Top Notes: Italian Lemon, Italian Bergamot and Grapefruit. Heart Notes: Fig Nectar, Pink Pepper and Jasmine Petals. Base Notes: Fig Wood, Cedarwood and Benzoin.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Mandorlo Di Sicilia Eau De Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Acqua Di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Mandorlo Di Sicilia Eau De Toilette (75ml) is a EDT for men and women with a delightfully soft fragrance evoking the sweet memories of a Sicilian way of life.The caressingly sweet fragrance is characterised by top notes of Star Anise, Bergamot and Orange. At the heart of this fragrance spray, citrus accents intertwine with soft and enveloping notes of the islands iconic Mediterranean Green Almonds and Ylang-Ylang, while its base is rounded off by Cedar Wood, Vanilla and White Musk notes. Top Notes: Star Anise, Italian Bergamot and Italian Orange. Heart Notes: Green Almonds and Ylang Ylang. Base Notes: Madagascar Vanilla , Lebanese Cedarwood, Tolu Balsam and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity Aqua Man Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Calvin Klein Eternity Aqua Man Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a woody aromatic EDT for men with a refreshing, citrusy and aquatic character which conveys a timelessly elegant persona.Opening with an intoxicating green melange of Cucumber, Lotus and Green Notes, the composition moves on to an evergreen woodsy heart blending Lavender, Cedarwood and Sichuan Pepper. This culminates in a sensual, earthy and musky drydown with the woody notes of Guaiac and Sandalwood blending with earthy Patchouli and Musk. Top Notes: Cucumber, Citruses, Green Notes and Lotus. Heart Notes: Plum, Lavender, Sichuan Pepper and Virginia Cedar. Base Notes: Sandalwood, Musk, Patchouli and Guaiac Wood.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity Moment Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Calvin Klein Eternity Moment Eau De Parfum (30ml) is a floral, feminine fragrance for women from the iconic US fashion house. Inspired by the thrill and excitement of falling in love, the fresh fragrance captures attention with a romantic blend of dew-kissed florals, Asian fruits, and subtle undertones.The sensuous scent...

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Hero Eau De Parfum 150ml
listings.description: Burberry Hero Eau De Parfum (150ml) is a woody, spicy fragrance for heroic men who are embarking on a journey of self-discovery, exploring and embracing their true self with courage whilst reflecting the powerful energy of the horse, a perfect symbol of our hero's strength.The EDP opens vibrantly with the sensual olfactory notes of fresh Pine Needle and balsamic, aromatic Olibanum. This leads on to a heart blending sweetly smooth Benzoin and spicy floral Incense. The scent culminates in a woody drydown encompassing three variants of Cedarwood sourced from Virginia's Appalachian Mountains, the Atlas Mountains of Morocco and the Himalayan Mountains in Asia. Boldly displaying the TB monogram, the bottle is decorated with deep oak and gold tones drawn from the house livery. Top Notes: Pine Needles and Olibanum. Heart Notes: Benzoin and Incense. Base Notes: Atlas Cedar, Himalayan Cedar and Virginia Cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Colonia Intensa Eau De Cologne 180ml
listings.description: Acqua Di Parma Colonia Intensa Eau De Cologne (180ml) is an intense and sophisticated men's fragrance, creating a perfect balance between the traditional and contemporary.It is a classic composition of Bergamot and Lemon notes gets a modern touch with the addition of woods and resin accords, resulting in a unique sensory experience. Designed for the charismatic and assertive soul, the elegant scent of this EDC reflects a strong and confident style. Top Notes: Cardamom, Calabrian Bergamot, Sicilian Lemon and Ginger. Heart Notes: Myrtle, Artemisia and Neroli. Base Notes: Leather Accord, Cedar Wood, Patchouli, Benzoin and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Colonia Club Eau De Cologne 50ml
listings.description: Acqua Di Parma Colonia Club Eau De Cologne (50ml) is a fresh and stylish embodiment of contemporary Italian living, a refined and elegant olfactory interpretation of classic Italian cologne for the gentleman who experiences life with passion.Elegantly dynamic and fresh, the Colonia Club scent is characterised by original top notes of Neroli, Mint and Galbanol. The energetic vitality of the Mint and the freshness of the Galbanol give a new spicy perspective to the traditional Colonia. Top Notes: Sicilian Lemon, Petit Grain, Bergamot, Sicilian Mandarin, Mint and Neroli. Heart Notes: Lavender, Geranium and Galbanol. Base Notes: Haitian Vetiver, White Musk and Ambergris Accord.

listings.rawTitle: Britney Spears Curious Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Britney Spears Curious Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an exhilarating white floral fragrance accented with Louisiana Magnolia and wrapped in the sensuality of Vanilla-infused Musk. Curious was launched in 2004, and was Britney's first endorsed perfume, which instantly became a world-wide best-seller.A Curious EDP for the inquisitive at heart, it celebrates Britney's birthplace by taking the essence of Louisiana Magnolia. It is presented in a sparkling azure bottle with many facets to arouse curiosity, while the heart-shaped charms attract good fortune. Top Notes: Lotus, Pear and Magnolia. Heart Notes: Tuberose, Jasmine and Pink Cyclamen. Base Notes: Musk, Vanilla and Woody Accords.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Insolence Eau De Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Guerlain Insolence Eau De Parfum (75ml) is a floral, fruity EDP of seduction which depicts a bold, sensual wearer, impossible to resist and who will transport you to a world of daring, irreverence and freedom. The sensual composition combines red fruit notes with feminine Violet and Orange Blossom, alongside velvety and luxurious Iris, exuding its sultry and voluptuous accord. The melange of Violet and Iris produces a refined, powdery fragrance with fruity, woody accents. Orange Blossom contributes sunny, soft and sensual floral notes. The olfactory trail concludes with a woody drydown comprising Oriental Sandalwood, Resin and earthy Musk. The fragrant liquid is housed in an inverted heart, pink-purple flacon with a golden lid and adorned with graceful scrolls. The avant-garde stopper, shaped like a hollowed heart, evokes the delicate romanticism of this delightful scent. Top Notes: Violet and Orange Blossom. Heart Notes: Iris. Base Notes: Oriental Sandalwood, Resin and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty For Him Eau De Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Gucci Guilty For Him Eau De Parfum (90ml) is a woody, aromatic and spicy EDP for men which seeks to intensify the traditional images of masculine beauty, enhancing their appeal with mystery and unconventionality. The combination of floral, citrus and spicy olfactory notes creates an unexpectedly invigorating retro vibe.The composition opens with the acidic, sweet, tanginess of Balsamic Vinegar blending with the heat of Red Chilli Pepper and floral tones of Rose. This leads on to the delicious harmony of a fruity, floral heart characterised by the delicacy of Neroli before the scent culminates in an earthy woody base of Cedar and Patchouli. The fragrance is housed in a sleek, matte black bottle with a silver cap and embossed G logo. Top Notes: Rose, Balsamic Vinegar, Red Chilli Pepper and Salt. Heart Notes: Lavender, Orange Blossom and Neroli. Base Notes: Cedar and Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy L'Interdit Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Givenchy L'Interdit Eau De Parfum (50ml) unveils the beauty concealed within, marking its stature as an emblematic floral woody fragrance that resonates with your deepest cravings.This enthralling EDP by Givenchy initiates with the familiar zest of Ginger, drawing you into its pristine aura. Progressing, it reveals a captivating heart imbued with the opulence of Orange Blossom, Jasmine, and Tuberose, wrapping you in its luxurious embrace. Descending to its base, the fragrance indulges in the profound, mesmerizing chords of Patchouli and Vetiver, adding depth and intricacy to its allure. The celebrated scent by Givenchy takes you on an odyssey of introspection, inspiring you to acknowledge the shadowed passions within. The fragrance is encased in a classic bottle, its contrasting edges and supple curves mirroring the multifaceted nature of one's identity. Head Notes: Ginger. Heart Notes: Orange Blossom, Jasmine, Tuberose. Base Notes: Patchouli, Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Bottled Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Hugo Boss Bottled Parfum (100ml) stands as a testament to the man who is unmistakably a BOSS. This parfum emanates an overwhelming sense of sophistication and warmth. With its woody-ambery notes, it encapsulates the noble heart of Orris Concrete and Fig Tree Root Accord, perfectly portraying his magnetic charisma.Bottled Parfum is the epitome of the iconic Bottled fragrance lineage, presenting its highest concentration to date. This enriched men's parfum delivers a woody green aroma that commences with the invigorating notes of Mandarin and spicy Incense oils. As it unfurls, its heart radiates with Orris Concrete and Fig Tree Root Accord, which accentuates his compelling presence. The woody undertones of Cedarwood Essence and Vegetal Leather Accord infuse warmth, ensuring a lasting and powerful aura. Top Notes: Mandarin, Incense. Heart Notes: Orris, Fig Tree Roots Accord. Base Notes: Cedarwood, Vegetal Leather Accord

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Bottled Infinite Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Hugo Boss Bottled Infinite Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a fragrance designed for the man of today, embodying his aspirations and desires to reconnect with his inner self. An energising and sensual perfume, it beautifully melds the crisp freshness of Citrus notes with the robust intensity of aromatic, woody notes, ensuring a scent that is both invigorating and enduring.Bottled Infinite symbolises the multifaceted roles and endeavours of the man of today, whether he is pursuing success or seeking a balanced and authentic existence. This scent represents his longing to reconnect with his inner world, offering an energising and sensual fragrance that intertwines the brisk freshness of Citrus notes with the potent depth of aromatic, woody notes. Top Notes: Apple, Mandarin, Cinnamon. Heart Notes: Patchouli, Rosemary, Lavender. Base Notes: Olive Wood, Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Terre D'Hermes Eau Intense Vetiver Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Hermes Terre D'Hermes Eau Intense Vetiver Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a luminous, woody fragrance for men, presenting a new dimension of the iconic Terre d'Hermes. This scent captures the essence of Vetiver in a blend that is both intense and vibrant, with the freshness of Green Bergamot and the spicy edge of Sichuan Pepper adding layers of complexity.This EDP encapsulates the spirit of Terre, with its core Vetiver note achieving a unique balance - transforming the original woody and mineral signature into a woody and vegetal harmony. The design of the bottle incorporates Hermes' attention to detail and craftsmanship: the cap adopts the warm brown of sun-tanned leather, and the base features an 'H' in a deeper shade of orange, while the metal shoulders of the bottle reflect and intensify the light. The intricate details, such as the iconic saddle nail and the sliding spray cover, are inspired by a travel vanity case bottle from the Emile Hermes Museum. This attention to detail and commitment to heritage make the Terre d'Hermes Eau Intense Vetiver bottle a masterpiece of design, as compelling as the fragrance itself. Top Notes: Green Bergamot and Citrus. Heart Notes: Sichuan Pepper. Base Notes: Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Bottled Eau De Toilette 200ml
listings.description: Hugo Boss Bottled Eau De Toilette (200ml) encapsulates the luxury brand's original fragrance that encourages modern men to express themselves through their actions. The men's scent carries elegant, woody accords of the classic fragrance that reflect confidence, versatility and a distinctive contrast of aromas.The men's EDT remains as relevant and contemporary now as it was when first launched as a symbol of masculinity 20 years ago. Comes packaged in an iconic bottle embossed with the brand's name and bookended by matte metal. Top notes: Apple, Lemon Bergamot, Oakmoss and Plum. Heart notes: Geranium, Cinnamon, Carnation and Mahogany. Base Notes: Cedar, Vetiver, Vanilla, Olive Tree and Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Armani Code Eau De Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Giorgio Armani Armani Code Eau De Parfum (75ml) captures a vibrant new intensity in this captivating, refillable masculine fragrance.Starting with a fresh and vibrant Green Mandarin essence from Italy, this spicy woody fougere perfume sets a distinctive tone. The heart features a warm and spicy essence of Nutmeg, leading to a base where a rich and warm Tonka Bean Absolute brings out a deep masculine sensuality. The new Armani Code bottle reimagines the original iconic design with an environmentally mindful approach by Giorgio Armani. Its sleek, striking black form, enhanced with silver accents and sensorial touches, is not only aesthetically pleasing but also rechargeable in all formats, demonstrating a commitment to environmental sustainability. Top Notes: Green Mandarin Essence. Heart Notes: Nutmeg Essence. Base Notes: Tonka Bean Absolute.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty For Him Eau De Parfum 150ml
listings.description: Gucci Guilty For Him Eau De Parfum (150ml) is a woody, aromatic and spicy EDP for men which seeks to intensify the traditional images of masculine beauty, enhancing their appeal with mystery and unconventionality. The combination of floral, citrus and spicy olfactory notes creates an unexpectedly invigorating retro vibe.The composition opens with the acidic, sweet, tanginess of Balsamic Vinegar blending with the heat of Red Chilli Pepper and floral tones of Rose. This leads on to the delicious harmony of a fruity, floral heart characterised by the delicacy of Neroli before the scent culminates in an earthy woody base of Cedar and Patchouli. The fragrance is housed in a sleek, matte black bottle with a silver cap and embossed G logo. Top Notes: Rose, Balsamic Vinegar, Red Chilli Pepper and Salt. Heart Notes: Lavender, Orange Blossom and Neroli. Base Notes: Cedar and Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentleman Eau De Parfum 60ml
listings.description: Givenchy Gentleman Eau De Parfum (60ml) is an exceptional fragrance for men, embodying a magnetic personality that doesn't just follow the flow but becomes it. Ideal for the sensual Gentleman whose appeal stems from a unique blend of strength and gentleness. This EDP offers a woody interpretation that captivates and charms. This fragrance is for the man who confidently embraces his eccentricity, enjoying spontaneous and shared pleasures, setting his own rules with a free spirit.This composition creates a dynamic rhythm from the first moment, beginning with the soft tempo of aromatic lavender and vibrant pepper. It warms up with the smooth Peru balsam and iris, striking a balance between strength and delicacy. The woody tones of patchouli and the sensuality of black vanilla bring forth an addictive oriental note, crafting a rich, textured signature that lingers on the skin throughout the night. Top Notes: Pepper Essence and Lavender. Heart Notes: Orris Concrete and Peru Balm. Base Notes: Patchouli Essence and Black Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Gres Cabotine Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Gres Cabotine Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a fresh, fruity scent for women which is ideal for casual wear. This EDT spray for women opens with a blend of Blackcurrant Buds, Pear, Plum and Coriander, leading to a heart of Rose, Tuberose, Ylang-Ylang, Ginger Lily, Hyacinth, Heliotrope, Freesia, Violet and Iris.This culminates in a smooth drydown of Cedarwood, Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Cybet, Musk and Amber. Top Notes: Blackcurrant Buds, Pear, Plum and Coriander. Heart Notes: Rose, Tuberose, Ylang Ylang, Ginger Lily, Hyacinth, Heliotrope, Freesia, Violet and Iris. Base Notes: Cedarwood, Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Cybet, Musk and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Gres Cabochard Cherie Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Gres Cabochard Cherie Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a floral, fruity gourmand EDP for women which represents a celebration of power and seduction. It has been created for a graceful, sensual yet determined character, one who nevertheless embraces compromise and employs her irresistible charm to get what she wants.This scent opens with the spicy green radiance of sparkling green fruits, leading on to a brightly elegant heart of fragrant Freesia, heady Narcissus and complex Orange Blossom. The composition culminates in a woody and leathery drydown, its addictive warmth emanating from a combination of earthy Patchouli and nutty Praline. The clear, faceted bottle reveals the feminine, rose-beige fragrance within. Its sculpted form personifies the strong character of its wearer, whilst the iconic Cabochard signature and distinctive white bow hark back to the brand's origins. Top Notes: Bergamot, Pear Accord and Basil. Heart Notes: Narcissus Absolute, Orange Blossom Absolute and Freesia. Base Notes: Patchouli, Praline Accord and Leather Accord.

listings.rawTitle: Phizz Daily Energy Hydration, Caffeine, Electrolytes & Vitamins Effervescent Tablets Cherry 20 Tablets
listings.description: Phizz Daily Energy Hydration, Caffeine, Electrolytes & Vitamins Effervescent Tablets Cherry (20 Tablets) are formulated to deliver rapid hydration and sustained energy, helping you feel alert and energised throughout the day. Harnessing the sodium-glucose co-transporter for three times faster hydration than water alone, this advanced formula combines electrolytes, B vitamins, guarana and a dual-release caffeine blend for lasting focus and vitality. Perfect for kick-starting your mornings, supporting workouts, or overcoming the mid-afternoon slump.Each serving provides 75mg of total Caffeine from Caffeine and Guarana Extract, offering both fast and slow release for a balanced energy lift. With a high-strength B-vitamin complex to unlock the body's natural energy and reduce fatigue, plus a comprehensive multivitamin containing 16 essential vitamins and minerals, this formula supports immunity, brain function and daily wellbeing. With 7 key electrolytes to optimise hydration and a science-led formulation, Phizz Daily Energy ensures physical and mental performance is supported at every stage of the day. As Dr Paul Anastasiades, PhD Neuroscientist and Co-Founder of Phizz, explains, 'electrolytes are unsung heroes of daily health', and 'when your body is properly hydrated with sufficient electrolyte levels, you think clearer, feel more awake, and perform at your best, whether in the gym, at work, or travelling.'Phizz is also proudly plastic neutral. While tubes are packaged in plastic for food safety and efficacy, the brand offsets its footprint by recovering the equivalent weight of plastic waste through its partnership with CleanHub. Since July 2023, Phizz has removed 70,000kg of plastic waste from the environment, equivalent to 3.5 million plastic bottles or 70 elephants in weight, with a target to surpass 100,000kg by the end of 2025. This commitment ensures every purchase supports personal health while making a positive environmental impact.Key Features: Fast Hydration - Hydrates 3x faster than water alone with 7 key electrolytes, helping to combat dehydration as a root cause of fatigue. Caffeine Blend - Provides 75mg caffeine from caffeine and guarana extract, combining fast and slow release for sustained alertness. Lasting Energy - Enriched with B vitamins to unlock natural energy and reduce tiredness and fatigue. Brain and Muscle Function - Contains essential vitamins and minerals to support normal cognitive, nerve and muscle function. Comprehensive Daily Multivitamin - High-quality formula with 16 vitamins and minerals to support energy, immunity and overall wellbeing. Suitable for Vegans - Vegetarian and vegan-friendly formulation. Informed Sport Tested - Every batch tested under the Informed Sport programme to the highest standards of safety and assurance for athletes. Contains 20 cherry flavoured effervescent tablets with electrolyte hydration, 16 vitamins and minerals and caffeine (20 servings).

It effectively maintains or develops a soft pearly sheen while removing brassy yellow tones from blonde hair. Suitable for all hair types, this shampoo works best on hair which has been toned and coloured with Bleach London Pearlescent Toner and Pearlescent Super Cool Colour, or on bleached blonde hair for an iridescent pearly shimmer. listings.description: Creed Viking Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a bold, exhilarating EDP which encapsulates the powerful spirit of boundless exploration, symbolising a fearless voyage undertaken with unshakeable perseverance.Viking reflects the spirit and determination of the skilled Viking seamen of the ninth century who crafted powerful longships to transport them on their journey to conquer. Iceland, the land of fire and ice, volcanos and glaciers, perfectly embodies the inspiration behind this fiery men's fragrance. Spicy, fougere and aromatic, the composition combines the fresh citrus notes of Calabrian Bergamot and Sicilian Lemon with Pink Peppercorn, Bulgarian Rose and Peppermint. listings.rawTitle: Montale Arabians Tonka Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Montale Arabians Tonka Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an amber woody EDP for women and men which takes its inspiration from the animal known as the 'King of the Desert' - the Arabic horse. Combining the sensuality, power and elegance demonstrated by this impressive beast, this audacious, racy and fiery fragrance was created for lovers of rare perfumes. The finely blended composition opens with the floral, honeyed notes of Saffron and zesty Bergamot, leading on to a bewitching Bulgarian Rose. This culminates in a drydown displaying the animalic melange of Oud, Amber and Musk. The fragrant liquid is housed in a black aluminium flacon bearing an image of the horse which inspired this unisex eau de parfum. Top Notes: Saffron and Bergamot. Heart Notes: Agarwood (Oud) and Bulgarian Rose. Base Notes: Tonka Bean, Sugar Cane, Amber, White Musk and Oakmoss.

listings.rawTitle: Byredo Black Saffron Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Byredo Black Saffron Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an intense floral amber fragrance with a multifarious olfactory composition which seeks to convey a sense of unity and inclusion. Centred on the smell of Saffron, an exalted spice in India where the Hindu monks and sages wear Saffron clothes as a symbol of abstinence from all material things, thoughts and pleasures, it is revered by Byredo's founder. Opening with a spicy fruity melange of Juniper Berries, Pomelo and spicy Saffron, the heart blends the floral notes of Black Violet and Cristal Rose with the smoked leather nuances of Accord Cuir with its Saffron content. The scent culminates in an earthy, woody drydown with Vetiver and Blonde Woods enlivened by the inclusion of zesty Raspberry. The fragrant liquid is housed in the brand's instantly recognisable, chic and simple monochrome bottle. Top Notes: Juniper Berries, Pomelo and Saffron. Heart Notes: Black Violet, Cristal Rose and Accord Cuir. Base Notes: Blonde Woods, Raspberry and Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Bois Du Portugal Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Creed Bois Du Portugal Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a woody, spicy and aromatic, rich men's EDP which combines elegance with a robust virility. Effortlessly masculine, sensual and mysterious, the scent draws its title and inviting spirit from the fragrant palette of the Iberian Peninsula forest with its warm Mediterranean air enlivened by the olfactory notes from pine, oak and chestnut trees. Opening with an aromatic and fruity melange of Basil, Bergamot, Lemon, Lime and Mandarin, the composition leads on to a warm, distinctive heart of Lavender and exotic Spices before culminating in an earthy yet smooth and refined base with the exotic woods of Cedarwood and Sandalwood amalgamating with Patchouli and Vetiver. Top Notes: Bergamot, Lemon, Lime, Basil and Mandarin. Heart Notes: Lavender and Spices. Base Notes: Sandalwood, Patchouli, Vetiver and Cedarwood.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Silver Mountain Water Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Creed Silver Mountain Water Eau De Parfum (50ml) draws its inspiration from the invigorating freshness of mountain air and the crystal-clear waters of alpine streams, landscapes where the Creed family seeks solace and rejuvenation. This contemporary EDP captures the essence of purity through its crisp citrus notes, alongside the distinct aromas of Tea, Blackcurrant, and Musk, conjuring the cool and pristine ambience of the Swiss Alps, with their snow-capped peaks and icy, mentholated streams. The scent begins with a refreshing blend of Bergamot, Mandarin, and Neroli, setting a vibrant and pure tone. The heart of the fragrance unfolds with the delicate aroma of Green Tea and the fruity zest of Blackcurrant Bud, leading to a serene and uplifting sensation. The base notes of Sandalwood and Musk provide a warm and comforting finish, grounding the fragrance in a rich, sensual depth. Top Notes: Bergamot, Mandarin, Neroli. Heart Notes: Green Tea, Blackcurrant Bud. Base Notes: Sandalwood, Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Original Vetiver Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Creed Original Vetiver Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a fresh, woody, aromatic EDP for men which conveys the sensual feeling of time spent outdoors amongst verdant greenery, time spent beneath warm sunshine enjoying the stimulating company and lively conversation of friends. Bottling this captivating atmosphere and the irresistible attraction of the great outdoors, Original Vetiver conveys sophistication and romance through its traditional Vetiver interpretation. With a green and masculine signature, the composition includes refreshing Vetiver leaves, aromatic heart and earthy roots for a captivating, fresh and warming effect. Opening with the zesty, fresh and uplifting notes of Lemon, Green Notes and Ginger, the heart features the earthy, leathery characteristics of Vetiver in combination with herbaceous Coriander, peppery Cypress and fresh floral scents. This culminates in a rich and woody base combining White Musk, balsamic Cedarwood and sweet, powdery Guaiac Wood. Top Notes: Ginger, Green Notes and Lemon. Heart Notes: Vetiver, Fresh Floral, Coriander and Cypress. Base Notes: White Musk, Cedarwood and Guaiac Wood.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Aventus Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Creed Aventus Eau De Parfum (30ml) stands as a true testament to masculine excellence, earning its place as the best-selling men's EDP in the history of The House of Creed. This fragrance is a tribute to strength, power, success, and heritage, embodying sensuality, audacity, and contemporary allure. It opens with tantalising fruity top notes of Pineapple, Blackcurrant, Apple, and Bergamot, creating an invigorating and refreshing introduction. As the scent develops, a fresh and fruity heart emerges, characterized by notes of Jasmine, Pineapple, and Patchouli. These elements combine harmoniously, lending a captivating and enduring quality to the fragrance. As Aventus unfolds further, it reveals a rich and robust base, where Oakmoss, Cedarwood, Birch, and Creed's distinctive Ambroxan take centre stage. This woody foundation adds depth and character to the composition, leaving a lasting and memorable impression that exudes confidence and sophistication. Aventus by Creed is an olfactive masterpiece that captures the essence of a modern-day legend. Top Notes: Pineapple, Blackcurrant, Apple, Bergamot. Heart Notes: Juniper Berries, Birch, Patchouli, Jasmine. Base Notes: Musk, Oak Moss, Ambergris, Vanilla.

This fresh, warm and enticing scent conjures images of a sailing trip across the Caribbean, visiting spectacular destinations. Refreshing with its tropical theme, the composition opens with tantalising notes of crisp Mexican Lime, Bergamot and zesty tropical fruits. This moves on to a heart which reflects the delights of an invigorating summer cocktail with exotic White Flowers and fragrant Jasmine mingling with the milky richness of layered Coconut. Tonka Bean and White Musk combine in the base producing an irresistible warmth and serenity to conclude the experience. Top Notes: Bergamot, Lime and Tropical Fruits. Heart Notes: Coconut Milk, Coconut Water, Jasmine and White Flowers. Base Notes: Tonka Bean and White Musk.
