This culminates in a rich and woody base combining White Musk, balsamic Cedarwood and sweet, powdery Guaiac Wood. Top Notes: Ginger, Green Notes and Lemon. Heart Notes: Vetiver, Fresh Floral, Coriander and Cypress. Base Notes: White Musk, Cedarwood and Guaiac Wood.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Green Irish Tweed Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Creed Green Irish Tweed Eau De Parfum (50ml), inspired by Olivier Creed's family couture legacy, stands as a quintessential fougere EDP, embodying both aromatic freshness and the lush greenery of Ireland. This iconic scent draws its inspiration from the verdant landscapes of the Emerald Isle, evoking images of freshly cut grass and a revitalizing sea breeze, making it a clean and naturally enticing choice for men. Green Irish Tweed pays homage to the Creed family's couture heritage, with its composition reflecting the earthy tones of luxurious hand-woven yarns and the craftsmanship associated with the Linton Tweed Mill.The fragrance opens with invigorating notes of Lemon and Verbena, cooled by a breath of Peppermint, leading into a heart where fresh green Geranium and aromatic Lavender blend seamlessly. The dry down is a sophisticated mix of Cedarwood, Sandalwood, Oakmoss, and Ambroxan, creating a long-lasting, arboreal scent that captures the essence of elegance and the great outdoors. This fragrance paints a vivid picture of spring meadows, delicate wildflowers, and the traditions of countryside estates, where hunting, hip flasks, and horseback riding were the norm. It's a fragrance that offers a perfect dose of nostalgia, akin to a flawlessly tailored riding outfit and the finest tweed suit, making it the definitive touch for the classic gentleman. Top Notes: Peppermint, Verbena, Lemon, Bergamot and Galbanum. Heart Notes: Green Geranium, Lavender and Violet. Base Notes: Cedarwood, Sandalwood, Oakmoss and Ambroxan.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Le Parfum Intense Eau De Parfum 125ml
listings.description: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Le Parfum Intense Eau De Parfum (125ml) is an intense woody amber EDP for men with a sultry, seductive character arousing boundless temptation to rival that of the Garden of Eden.Reflecting this addictive seduction, the composition combines the raw sensuality of Ambergris with the warming freshness of Ginger and sweet intensity of Coconut Woods. Potent masculinity enters the mix in the form of creamy Sandalwood and enticingly spicy Tonka Bean. Housed in the iconic Jean Paul Gaultier bottle, the male torso has been lacquered with a black and green gradient effect to accentuate the muscular torso whose modesty is spared by a single gold vine leaf plucked from the iconic green box. Top Notes: Coconut Wood. Heart Notes: Tonka Bean. Base Notes: Santal Wood.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Carmina Eau De Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Creed Carmina Eau De Parfum (75ml) is a floral, amber, woody and musk EDP for women which celebrates the overt sensuality of feminine allure with a sophisticated composition which conveys a captivating charisma. Opening with the sultry melange of seductive Black Cherry, warming Pink Pepper and spicy, golden Saffron, the heart joins exquisite Rose de Mai with luxurious, indulgent Cashmere Wood, heavenly Peony and fragrant Violet. This culminates in a seductive, intoxicating base of precious Myrrh and Frankincense, together with Amber and smouldering Musk. The fragrant liquid is housed in a bottle clad in a Raspberry hue with flecks of muted Rose. Top Notes: Black Cherry, Saffron and Pink Pepper. Heart Notes: Rose De Mai, Violet, Cashmere Wood and Peony. Base Notes: Frankincense, Myrrh, Amber and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Elixir Parfum 125ml
listings.description: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Elixir Parfum (125ml) is a woody, aromatic amber fragrance for men which exudes sex appeal and sensuality inviting addiction on the part of those who encounter it. The composition opens with a refreshing breeze, mingling dashing Lavender with cooling Mint. This leads to a heart of creamy, sensual Vanilla enhanced by the balsamic richness of Benzoin. The olfactory trail culminates in an overtly masculine base with the mellow tones of Tonka Bean warmed by the sweetness of Honey and the earthy, smoky and mysterious character of Tobacco. Housed in the iconic Jean Paul Gaultier bottle, its flaming male torso displays the striated gold hue of his bulging muscles and skin turned copper by the setting sun, drawing a contrast with the translucent brown stripes on his sailor shirt. Top Notes: Lavender and Mint. Heart Notes: Vanilla and Benzoin. Base Notes: Honey, Tonka Bean and Tobacco.

listings.rawTitle: Montale Chocolate Greedy Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Montale Chocolate Greedy Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an amber vanilla EDP for men and women with a mouthwatering composition filled with delectable creaminess, a sumptuously rich ganache of utter scrumptiousness. Opening with a Coffee and Bitter Orange melange, the scent features a powdery heart reminiscent of the highest quality Cocoa when sprinkled over an expensive truffle. Sensual Vanilla Pods mixed with Chocolate creaminess produce a delicate and subtly gourmand drydown. Top Notes: Moka Bean and Bitter Orange. Heart Notes: Cacao Cream. Base Notes: Vanilla Pods.

listings.rawTitle: Montale Dark Purple Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Montale Dark Purple Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an amber floral EDP for women with a sensual, oriental character which exudes bold seduction. Opening with the zesty, citrus aroma of ripe Plum together with fresh Orange, these top notes are enveloped by luscious, floral notes from intense Rose and Geranium and the enticing aroma of sweet Red Berries. This culminates in a dark, earthy and opulent base with earthy Patchouli combined with animalistic White Musk, exotic Teak Wood and Amber. Top Notes: Plum and Orange. Heart Notes: Rose, Red Berries, Patchouli and Geranium. Base Notes: Musk, Teak Wood and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Himalaya Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Creed Himalaya Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a fresh, spicy, aromatic, woody fougere EDP for men whose uplifting, adventurous, masculine spirit draws its inspiration from the rugged magnificence, beauty, power and eternity of the Himalayan Mountains as experienced by Oliver Creed during a Tibetan mountain-climbing expedition. Opening with a fresh, citrusy melange of Bergamot, Lemon, Grapefruit and Mandarin, the composition leads on to an overtly masculine heart where unique notes of Gunpowder blend with Juniper Berries, Nutmeg and Pepper, giving Himalaya a uniquely innovative edge. This culminates in a pure and seductive drydown of Sandalwood, Vetiver and Cedarwood, perfectly rounding off this irresistible signature scent. The fragrant liquid is housed in a flacon which is unique among the Creed collection for its metallic exterior. It reflects the mountain influence, resembling both a mountaineer's canteen as well as the shiny surface of ice on mountain rocks. Top Notes: Calabrian Bergamot, Mandarin and Sicilian Lemon. Heart Note: Gunpowder, Juniper Berries, Nutmeg, Pepper, Lavender and Jasmine. Base Notes: Sandalwood, Vetiver and Cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Montale Black Aoud Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Montale Black Aoud Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a woody floral musk EDP for men, a dramatic elixir which transports you on a journey to a new destination, one you will want to return to. Intense, warm and animalic, the composition is a rich, bubbling melange of velvety Rose, leathery Labdanum and darkly complex Oud. Opening with the zesty citrus notes from Tangerine, the scent features Rose and Labdanum at its heart before culminating with a drydown of Cambodian Agarwood, earthy Patchouli and Musk. Top Notes: Tangerine. Heart Notes: Rose and Labdanum. Base Notes: Patchouli, Agarwood and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Montale Honey Aoud Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Montale Honey Aoud Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an amber vanilla EDP for men and women which brings together the deep, warm and luxurious scents of Honey and Agarwood Oud. Opening with delicate floral notes, the irresistible heart encloses Honey with Sumatran Patchouli leaves, enlivened by Cinnamon from Ceylon. The composition culminates with a drydown whose essential ingredient Agarwood Oud is combined with rich Amber, earthy Leather and creamy, sensual Vanilla Pods from Madagascar. Top Notes: Blossoms. Heart Notes: Honey, Patchouli and Cinnamon. Base Notes: Agarwood, Leather, Amber and Madagascar Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Eros Energy Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Versace Eros Energy Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a refreshing and citrusy EDP that delivers an invigorating blast of citrus energy, instantly uplifting and energising the senses. The fragrance begins with a sparkling concoction of Italian Bergamot, Blood Orange, Lime, Lemon, Grapefruit, and Mandarin, each note blending into a harmony that radiates pure joy and delight. As the fragrance progresses, a fiery heart emerges with the heat of Pink Peppercorn and the sensuality of juicy Blackcurrant, complemented by the smooth, soothing presence of White Amber. This combination creates a passionate and enchanting core to the scent. As Eros Energy settles, it reveals a robust base where earthy Patchouli enhances the blend's depth, while clean Musk envelops the senses in a comforting embrace, and Oakmoss adds a touch of classic elegance with its green, velvety texture. Top Notes: Italian Bergamot, Blood Orange, Lime, Lemon, Grapefruit and Mandarin. Heart Notes: Pink Peppercorn, Blackcurrant and White Amber. Base Notes: Patchouli, Musk and Oakmoss.

listings.rawTitle: Montale Roses Musk Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Montale Roses Musk Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a floral woody musk EDP for women with a perfect, uncluttered and minimalist composition dominated by the exquisite scent of dew-kissed roses in full, breathtaking bloom. Present in both the opening and heart of the melange, Bulgarian Rose is augmented with a hint of sweetness to create a divine, light and airy result, flawless like a solitary diamond. In the base, soft, clean, skin-loving Musk delights the senses. Top Notes: Bulgarian Rose. Heart Notes: Bulgarian Rose. Base Notes: Amber and White Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne One Million Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Paco Rabanne 1 Million Parfum (100ml) is a floral leather men's fragrance that captures the essence of sun-drenched charm, pushing boundaries and playing with the senses. Intensely masculine, this parfum contrasts the duality of salty notes with the warmth of leather. The amber heat enhances its sensuality, reminiscent of skin that's been kissed by the sun. 1 Million Parfum is not just addictive but also bold, exaggerated, and designed for those who dare to stand out in the crowd. The fragrance plays between the salty pulse of Salty Tuberose, Ambroxan, and Cashmeran, leading to the leathery opulence of Sun-drenched Leather and Citrus Resin. Housed in a 1 Million ingot bottle with extreme lines cut from glass and gold, it epitomises opulence and audacity. The golden hue shines with extreme radiance, capturing light and making its presence known, a true emblem sculpted in metal. Top Notes: Salty Tuberose, Ambroxan, and Cashmeran. Heart Notes: Sun-drenched Leather and Citrus Resin. Base Notes: Amber Heat.

listings.description: Zadig & Voltaire This Is Her! Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a warm and spicy, floral EDP for women which depicts a wearer who is confident, unpredictable and irresistible. This leads on to a sensual heart where creamy Vanilla and luxurious Whipped Cream meet the sweet note of Chestnut. This culminates in the Maison's signature, powerful Sandalwood in the base, joined by Cashmere. Top Notes: Pink Pepper, Silkwood Blossom and Jasmine Sambac. Heart Notes: Whipped Cream, Vanilla and Chestnut. Base Notes: Sandalwood and Cashmere Wood.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty For Her Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Gucci Guilty For Her Eau De Parfum (50ml) is an ambery floral EDP for women who treasure friendship and love, thriving on these emotions to engender self-acceptance and inner confidence. The scent is characterised by the delicate, fresh femininity of Lilac Petals invigorated with a sparkling citrus Mandora facet on a trail of richly sensual amber notes and Patchouli.The composition opens with shimmering top notes of Mediterranean Mandora citrus, natural Bergamot and spicy Pink Pepper, generating a welcoming luminosity and warmth. This leads on to a blooming heart featuring Lilac in combination with a floral melange of Violet, Rose and Geranium. This culminates in an earthy, powdery base blending Patchouli with Amber. Top Notes: Mandora and Pink Pepper. Heart Notes: Lilac. Base Notes: Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty For Her Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Gucci Guilty For Her Eau De Parfum (30ml) is an ambery floral EDP for women who treasure friendship and love, thriving on these emotions to engender self-acceptance and inner confidence. listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia Eau De Parfum (30ml) is a chypre floral EDP for women conveying the image of a confident wearer brimming with inner strength.The composition features the fruity floral sweetness of the Magnolia flower, its Clary Sage-like edge exuding a joyous spirit. The olfactory melange opens with the juicy citrus notes of Dewberry in sensual unison with the creamy Vanilla freshness of Coconut. This leads on to the floral heart of Magnolia, Jasmine Sambac and calming, warming Clary Sage. The scent culminates in the earthy, intense woodiness of Patchouli and Blonde Woods in a drydown which includes the mellow, leathery undertones of Musk. Gucci's iconic flora pattern, featuring vibrant blooms and rich hues, decorates both the bottle and outer packaging of Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia with its captivating purple shade. Top Notes: Dewberry and Coconut. Heart Notes: Magnolia, Jasmine Sambac and Clary Sage. Base Notes: Musk, Patchouli and Blonde Woods.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Eau De Parfum (30ml) is a joyful floral EDP for free-spirited women who abound with positive energy. The composition centres around the Gardenia flower, revered since time immemorial for its splendour and regularly included in elixirs and magic potions. Drawing inspiration from this legendary power, the gorgeous White Gardenia note blends with the smooth, intense florality of Jasmine Grandiflorum Absolute.Opening with a jubilant citrus melange of Pear Blossom accord, Mandarin Orange and Red Berries, the scent moves on to an overtly floral heart combining fragrant Jasmine, spicy and zesty Gardenia and exotic, sultry Frangipani. This culminates in an earthy Patchouli base with Brown Sugar accord adding a delicate sweetness to the silage. The fragrant liquid is housed in an elongated bottle, the lacquered pink glass and shiny gold cap transforming it into an object of beauty. Top Notes: Pear Blossom, Red Berries and Italian Mandarin. Heart Notes: Gardenia, Jasmine and Frangipani. Base Notes: Brown Sugar and Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Terre D'Hermes Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Hermes Terre D'Hermes Parfum (75ml) is a dense, warm, and woody parfum that encapsulates the essence of man's profound connection with the Earth. This parfum reflects a harmonious dialogue between nature and the elements, with a richer olfactory experience. The composition begins with sparkling top notes of Grapefruit and Orange, leading to a complex heart where Gunflint, Flint, Peppers, Pink Peppercorn, Geranium Leaves, Patchouli, and Baies Rose intermingle. The base grounds the scent in a deeply woody character with Atlas Cedarwood, Vetiver, and Gum Benzoin. The bottle design pays homage to Hermes' heritage, with a visible orange 'H' at the base signifying the Earth, while the metal shoulders reflect light. The bottle is inspired by an item from the travel vanity case at the Emile Hermes Museum, featuring the house's iconic saddle nail and a sliding cover for the spray. Terre d'Hermes Parfum not only tells a story with its scent but also with its carefully crafted design, connecting man to his origins and the source of his creative power. Top Notes: Grapefruit and Orange. Heart Notes: Gunflint, Flint, Peppers, Pink Peppercorn, Geranium Leaves, Patchouli and Baies Rose. Base Notes: Atlas Cedarwood, Vetiver and Gum Benzoin.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty For Him Eau De Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Gucci Guilty For Him Eau De Toilette (50ml) is a woody, aromatic fougere EDT for men with a seductive, provocative composition which depicts a charismatic alpha male wearer, an irresistible magnet for his admirers.The fragrance opens with a fruity melange blending Lavender with zesty Lemon, leading on to a heart brimming over with the appealing scents of African Orange Blossom. It culminates in an earthy, woody and sensual base combining warm accords of Cedar, Patchouli and creamy Vanilla. The fragrance is housed in a luxurious, masculine bottle crafted from cold metal and heavy glass, making an impression of masculinity and luxury. The centre of the bottle is adorned with a metallic Gucci sign, transparent to reveal the contents. Top Notes: Lavender and Amalfi Lemon. Heart Note: African Orange Flower. Base Notes: Virginia Cedar, Patchouli and Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Guy Laroche Drakkar Noir Eau De Toilette 200ml
listings.description: Guy Laroche Drakkar Noir Eau De Toilette (200ml) is an aromatic fougere EDT for men which conveys a strong yet emotional character.The powerful composition is an explosive blend combining stimulating Lavender, Lemon and Mandarin Orange top notes which lead to a warm spicy and herbaceous heart including Coriander, Juniper and Angelica. The scent culminates with an earthy, woody base with Patchouli, Cedar, Oak Moss and Pine Needle. Top Notes: Basil, Rosemary, Green Mint, Verbena, Lavender and Lemon. Heart Notes: Angelica, Wormwood, Juniper and Coriander. Base Notes: Oak Moss, Patchouli, Cedar, Pine Needle and Balsam.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Terre D'Hermes Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Hermes Terre D'Hermes Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a mineral, woody EDT which seeks to convey the humble and harmonious relationship between man and Earth, connecting him to his origins and to the elements of nature which provide the source of his creative power. Terre d'Hermes combines the strength of Cedarwood at the base with the radiance of Grapefruit and Orange at the top, adding a vibrant touch of Flint at the heart of the composition. Opening with the zest of Orange and bitterness of Grapefruit, the scent leads on to the vivacity of Pepper and fresh spices with the mineral effect of Flint and the coarseness of Vetiver. This culminates in a drydown dominated by Cedar, combined with the earthiness of Patchouli, the sweetness of resins and the impalpable voluptuousness of Benzoin. Top Notes: Orange and Grapefruit. Heart Notes: Pepper, Pelargonium and Flint. Base Notes: Vetiver, Cedar, Patchouli and Benzoin.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Jasmine Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Jasmine Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a fruity floral EDP for women bursting with the radiance and inner joy of a composition featuring Jasmine Grandiflorum. This inner joy is further elevated by notes of Mandarin Essence and Magnolia Accord which bring a joyous element to the scent.Opening with a fruity melange of Mandarin and Bergamot, the olfactory trail leads to an overtly floral heart with tender wreaths of Jasmine meeting the sweetness of Magnolia and Damask Rose. This culminates in an earthy, woody base comprising Patchouli, Sandalwood and sensual Benzoin. The fragrant liquid is housed in an elongated bottle featuring a shiny gold cap, crafted from lacquered turquoise stone glass and bearing the distinctive Gucci flora pattern. Top Notes: Italian Mandarin, Bergamot and Black Pepper. Heart Notes: Jasmine, Jasmine Sambac, Magnolia and Damask Rose. Base Notes: Benzoin, Australian Sandalwood and Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Samsara Eau De Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Guerlain Samsara Eau De Parfum (75ml) is a floral woody musk EDP for women which depicts a wearer who radiates with serene beauty, inner harmony and fulfilment. Comfortable both in the world and her skin, she has encountered absolute love. Opening with a fruity blast of citrus notes, the composition moves on to a fragrant floral heart rejoicing in the prevalence of Jasmine flowers and sunny Ylang-Ylang. This floral melange is accentuated by the generously radiant warmth of Sandalwood in the base where Iris, Tonka Bean and sensuous Vanilla enhance the complex fragrance trail. The fragrant liquid is housed in an inverted heart flacon adorned with graceful scrolls. The avant-garde stopper, shaped like a hollowed heart, evokes the delicate romanticism of this delightful scent. Top Notes: Citruses. Heart Notes: Ylang-Ylang and Jasmine. Base Notes: Sandalwood, Iris, Vanilla and Tonka Bean.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Bottled Eau De Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Hugo Boss Bottled Eau De Toilette (50ml) encapsulates the luxury brand's original fragrance that encourages modern men to express themselves through their actions. The men's scent carries elegant, woody accords of the classic fragrance that reflect confidence, versatility and a distinctive contrast of aromas.The men's fragrance remains as relevant and contemporary now as it was when first launched as a symbol of masculinity 20 years ago. Comes packaged in an iconic bottle embossed with the brand's name and bookended by matte metal. Top Notes: Apple, Lemon Bergamot, Oakmoss and Plum. Heart Notes: Geranium, Cinnamon, Carnation and Mahogany. Base Notes: Cedar, Vetiver, Vanilla, Olive Tree and Sandalwood

listings.rawTitle: Guy Laroche Fidji Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Guy Laroche Fidji Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a feminine floral EDP for women which has been named after the exotic South Pacific islands of Fiji and evokes their tropical beauty in the olfactory blend of its composition.This scent opens with a floral yet spicy sensation with the richness of comforting, seductive Cardamom meeting the Cucumber-like freshness of Violet Leaf. This leads on to a heart which features a sophisticated melange of floral notes including balmy Carnation, powdery Iris, exotic Ylang Ylang and fragrant Jasmine, all the while sharpened by verdant Spices. This culminates in an earthy, woody drydown with Sandalwood and Patchouli warmed by the subtlety of Musk. Top Notes: Violet Leaf and Cardamom. Heart Notes: Carnation, Iris, Spices, Jasmine, Ylang-Ylang and Bulgarian Rose. Base Notes: Musk, Sandalwood and Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Mitsouko Eau De Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Guerlain Mitsouko Eau De Parfum (75ml) is a chypre fruity EDP which depicts a woman's inner conflict with her heart's desires, a story of impossible love. The fragrant liquid is housed in an inverted heart flacon adorned with graceful scrolls. Heart Notes: Peach, Ylang-Ylang, Jasmine, Rose and Lilac. Base Notes: Oakmoss, Spices, Cinnamon, Vetiver and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Bottled Aftershave Splash 50ml
listings.description: Hugo Boss Bottled Aftershave Splash (50ml) is a fresh, fruity, and slightly spicy aftershave that has celebrated ten years of success since its launch. This masculine, inviting fragrance features bold top notes of Apple, pleasantly complimented by a spiced heart of Geranium and Cinnamon. listings.rawTitle: Hermes Terre D'Hermes Parfum 200ml

The composition begins with sparkling top notes of Grapefruit and Orange, leading to a complex heart where Gunflint, Flint, Peppers, Pink Peppercorn, Geranium Leaves, Patchouli, and Baies Rose intermingle. The base grounds the scent in a deeply woody character with Atlas Cedarwood, Vetiver, and Gum Benzoin. The bottle design pays homage to Hermes' heritage, with a visible orange 'H' at the base signifying the Earth, while the metal shoulders reflect light. The bottle is inspired by an item from the travel vanity case at the Emile Hermes Museum, featuring the house's iconic saddle nail and a sliding cover for the spray. Terre d'Hermes Parfum not only tells a story with its scent but also with its carefully crafted design, connecting man to his origins and the source of his creative power. Top Notes: Grapefruit and Orange. Heart Notes: Gunflint, Flint, Peppers, Pink Peppercorn, Geranium Leaves, Patchouli and Baies Rose. Base Notes: Atlas Cedarwood, Vetiver and Gum Benzoin.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy L'Interdit Rouge Eau De Parfum 50ml

The diffuser is infused with the sweet fragrance of Vanilla accompanied by warm notes of Almond, Tonka, Soft Lilly, and intense Musk.The fragrance carries a new formula that allows the scent to infuse your home for even longer. It can be used to neutralise odours with gentle, lasting smells that uplift baths, indoor and small outdoor spaces. Wax Lyrical is based in the Lake District and the company is committed to producing fragrances made in England. Cruelty-free & vegan-friendly.

listings.rawTitle: Wax Lyrical Sea Breeze Scented Reed Diffuser 100ml
listings.description: Wax Lyrical Sea Breeze Scented Reed Diffuser (100ml) is a fragrance diffuser that welcomes a splash of watery notes into your home. The diffuser has a sheer floral heart accompanied by fresh Figs and a wave of woody notes, Amber and Musk.The fragrance carries a new formula that allows the scent to infuse your home for even longer. It can be used to neutralise odours with subtle smells that uplift baths, indoor and small outdoor spaces. Wax Lyrical is based in the Lake District and the company is committed to producing fragrances made in England. Cruelty-free & vegan-friendly.

listings.description: Wax Lyrical Lemon Verbena Scented Reed Diffuser (100ml) is a fragrance diffuser that is designed to welcome fresh, natural aromas into your home. listings.rawTitle: Yankee Candle Scent Plug Diffuser Faceted
listings.description: Yankee Candle Scent Plug Diffuser Faceted is an attractively-patterned diffuser with adjustable intensity that provides a convenient way to enjoy authentic Yankee Candle fragrances 24/7.Supplied without fragrance, it can be combined with your favourite ScentPlug refill. Use only with a properly-functioning 230-volt electrical socket.Key Features: Dimensions: 7cm x 6cm x 6cm Weight: 72g.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Luce Di Colonia Scented Jar Candle 200g
listings.description: Acqua Di Parma Luce Di Colonia Scented Jar Candle (200g) is a harmonious blend of citrus essences, floral notes and elegant warm woody accents which takes its inspiration from Acqua Di Parma's signature Colonia fragrance, radiating brightness and light through your living space. This is an unmistakably Italian scent, elegant and timeless.The initial scent, blending Orange and Italian Lemon, gives way to the main body fragrance of Petitgrain and Neroli. This culminates in a lingering impression of Patchouli with a hint of Vetiver.This Luce Di Colonia candle has been crafted from white wax and is presented in an Art Deco style yellow glass jar. It burns for up to 50 hours. This 200g candle comes in a foldable outer pack made from FSC paper featuring a luxurious matte label with the Acqua di Parma logo embossed in hot foil.Key features: Dimensions: 7.7cm x 10cm Weight: 200g Burn time: 50 hours.

listings.rawTitle: Miniml Eco-Friendly White Vinegar Unscented Refill 5000ml
listings.description: Miniml Eco-Friendly White Vinegar Unscented Refill (5000ml) is an eco-friendly, fragrance-free, biodegradable white vinegar which effectively removes dirt, grime and grease.This formula has a multitude of uses including being used as a rinse aid, glass cleaner, limescale remover, multi-surface cleaner, laundry softener, stain remover and pet odour remover. Equally effective in hard and soft water, this plant-based vinegar is safe for septic tanks if used as directed. Miniml refills can be collected, cleaned and refilled. Free from VOCs, chlorine bleaches, solvents, lanoline, sulphates, parabens and phosphates. Cruelty-free & vegan-friendly.Areas of usage: Dishwasher. Windows. Mirrors. Toilet. Urinal. Bidet. Work surfaces. Kitchen. Bathroom. Washing machine. Carpets. Once you have finished with your empty packaging, you can send it back to Miniml free of charge by scanning the QR code on the back of the packaging or the information card in your order so that it can be cleaned, reused and refilled. This means that there is absolutely no single use plastic going to waste!

listings.rawTitle: Haruharu Wonder Black Rice Hyaluronic Cream Unscented 50ml
listings.description: Haruharu Wonder Black Rice Hyaluronic Cream Unscented (50ml) is a fragrance-free, deeply nourishing moisturiser enriched with fermented Black Rice, an active ingredient abundant in antioxidants and anti-ageing properties. Suitable for all skin types, it delivers skin-firming, hydrating care in a gentle formula.Black Rice contains high levels of Polyphenols and Flavonoids, providing effective protection from free radicals and stimulating the growth of new skin cells. Hyaluronic Acid ensures deep moisturisation, Red Ginseng rejuvenates, and a blend of Primrose and Lavender Essential Oils soothes the skin. Fragrance-free. Cruelty-free & vegan-friendly.Key Benefits Deeply nourishes and moisturises all skin types. Helps protect the skin from free radicals. Firms and hydrates for a healthy-looking complexion. Rejuvenates and soothes the skin. Key Ingredients Fermented Black Rice - rich in Polyphenols and Flavonoids to protect from free radicals and stimulate new skin cell growth. Hyaluronic Acid - ensures deep moisturisation. Red Ginseng - rejuvenates the skin. Primrose & Lavender Essential Oils - soothe while adding skin-firming, hydrating benefits.

listings.rawTitle: Elemis Pro-Collagen Naked Fragrance-Free Hydrating Cleansing Balm 100g
listings.description: Elemis Pro-Collagen Naked Fragrance-Free Hydrating Cleansing Balm (100g) is a fragrance-free version of the best-selling Elemis Cleansing Balm that transitions through three indulgent textures: starting as a rich balm, it melts into a luxurious oil when gently massaged into the skin, and then transforms into a hydrating milk upon contact with water.Designed to effortlessly remove long-wear makeup, daily grime, and surface pollutants, this balm also doubles as a facial mask to deeply cleanse and soften the skin. It's infused with a trio of nourishing plant oils, Elderberry, Optimega, and Bee Friendly Starflower Oil, alongside the superhero algae Padina Pavonica, leaving your skin soft, hydrated, and glowing. Free from mineral oil, this formula is suitable for all skin types.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden Eight Hour Skin Cream Protectant Lightly Scented 50ml
listings.description: Elizabeth Arden Eight Hour Skin Cream Protectant Lightly Scented (50ml) is the legendary skincare formula created in 1930 by Miss Arden to soothe and protect the skin. This award-winning skin protectant deeply moisturises and protects the skin, whilst its versatile formula can also be used to shape brows, add shine...

listings.rawTitle: O'Keeffe's Lip Repair Unscented Lip Balm Stick 4.2g
listings.description: O'Keeffe's Lip Repair Unscented Lip Balm Stick (4.2g) is a highly-concentrated lip balm with a non-greasy hydrating formula containing 7 different moisturising actives which has been developed to hydrate and relieve extremely dry, chapped lips. This lip balm effectively works to relieve, repair and provide 24-hour moisturisation, treating even the most advanced cases of dry, chapped lips, leaving them soft, smooth and healthy with just a single application. This unscented balm creates a protective layer on the surface of the skin, helping to prevent further moisture loss whilst boosting moisture levels.The natural protective skin barrier can become damaged on our lips, leading to increased moisture loss which results in dry, cracked skin. O'Keeffe's Lip Repair not only protects the skin from further water loss, but the balm also draws in moisture from the air. The protective barrier locks in that moisture, reducing the rate of evaporation. Cruelty-free.

listings.rawTitle: Weleda Calendula Oil Unfragranced 200ml
listings.description: Weleda Calendula Oil Unfragranced (200ml) is an organic baby oil for use on delicate skin which contains just two organic ingredients - light, organic Sesame Oil and an extract of organic Calendula, pure and fresh as baby's own skin.Treat dry, chafed or irritated skin, cleanse little bottoms, or enjoy a soothing massage together with this simplest of all formulations. This oil is softening, warming, calming, and relaxing - perfect for tender moments with your little one from the first day. Suitable for vegetarians. Cruelty-free according to UEBT.

listings.rawTitle: Phizz Daily 3-in-1 Hydration, Electrolytes & Vitamins Effervescent Tablets Orange 60 Tablets
listings.description: Phizz Daily 3-in-1 Hydration, Electrolytes & Vitamins Effervescent Tablets Orange (60 Tablets) are designed to help you feel energised, alert and at your best, wherever the day takes you. By harnessing the sodium-glucose co-transporter, a biological mechanism that accelerates water absorption, Phizz hydrates you three times faster than water alone. This science-led formula supports both body and mind with a carefully balanced blend of electrolytes, vitamins and minerals, keeping energy, focus and wellbeing in check from morning to night.Each tablet delivers a full spectrum of 7 key electrolytes (sodium, potassium, chloride, magnesium, zinc, copper and manganese) alongside 18 essential vitamins and minerals, including Vitamin C and Vitamin B12. With more potassium than a banana, Phizz aids muscle recovery and supports cognitive and nerve function. Its high-dose Vitamin C (three times more than an orange) and zinc (more than three cups of spinach) combine with B vitamins and antioxidants to strengthen immunity and boost natural energy levels, helping to reduce fatigue while maintaining mental alertness and daily performance. Endorsed by Dr Paul Anastasiades, PhD Neuroscientist and Co-Founder of Phizz, the formula embodies his belief that 'electrolytes are unsung heroes of daily health', keeping you clear-headed, awake and performing at your best in the gym, at work or while travelling.Phizz is also committed to sustainability. While tubes are packaged in plastic for safety and product efficacy, the brand offsets its impact by being proudly plastic neutral. For every tube sold, an equivalent weight of plastic waste is collected and recycled through a partnership with CleanHub. Since July 2023, Phizz has recovered 70,000kg of plastic waste, the equivalent of 3.5 million plastic bottles or 70 elephants in weight, with a target of over 100,000kg by the end of 2025. This commitment ensures that every purchase supports both personal health and the health of the planet.Key Features: Faster Hydration - Hydrates 3x faster than water alone, with 7 key electrolytes and 18 essential nutrients to support hydration, energy and wellbeing. Brain and Muscle Function - Contains more potassium than a banana to aid muscle recovery and supports cognitive, nerve and muscle function for sharper focus and peak performance. Natural Energy - Enriched with B vitamins to unlock natural energy, reducing tiredness and fatigue. Immune Support - Packed with Vitamin C, zinc and antioxidants to strengthen immune health and daily energy. Suitable for Vegans - Vegetarian and vegan-friendly formulation. Informed Sport Tested - Independently tested and verified for quality and safety. Contains 60 orange flavoured effervescent hydration, electrolyte and multivitamin tablets (60 servings).

listings.rawTitle: Byredo Bal D'Afrique Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Byredo Bal D'Afrique Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an amber, floral and woody EDP for men and women which depicts the fantasy of arriving in Africa on an imaginary journey, a celebration of African culture through olfactory notes. Characterised by a medium Intensity, the composition gives vibrant expression to this vibe through the excess, euphoria and intensity of its constituent parts.Opening with a combination of musky African Marigold, camphorous Buchu and Bergamot, the fragrant floral heart blends Violet, Cyclamen and Jasmine. This culminates in a woody drydown of Cedarwood and warm, earthy Vetiver. Top Notes: African Marigold, Bergamot and Buchu. Heart Notes: Cyclamen and Violet. Base Notes: Moroccan Cedarwood and Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Billie Eilish Eilish By Billie Eilish Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Eilish By Billie Eilish Eau De Parfum (30ml) is an amber, vanilla EDP for women with a seductive, sensual character, personified by the iconic bottle, crafted in the voluptuous and alluring shape of a female upper torso. The first fragrance launched by renowned music artist Billie Eilish, this fragrance was launched in 2021 and has rapidly gained popularity due to its enticing, sweet notes offset by the warm, ambery hues.Opening with a sweet and fruity, floral melange of Mandarin, Red Berries and Sugar, the composition leads on to a creamy, sensual heart of Vanilla, Rose and Cacao. This culminates in a woody, musky dry down where Tonka Bean melds with Amber. Cruelty-free & vegan-friendly. Top Notes: Sugar, Red Berries and Mandarin Orange. Heart Notes: Vanilla, Cacao, Spicy Notes and Rose. Base Notes: Tonka Bean, Amber, Musk and Woody Notes.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Be Eau De Toilette 200ml
listings.description: Calvin Klein Be Eau De Toilette (200ml) follows One as another fragrance designed for both men and women from the iconic US fashion house. This versatile EDT is a fresh, oriental, and woody fragrance that is aimed at anyone who is individualistic. The tonic musk was launched in 1996 and...

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Arancia Di Capri Eau De Toilette 30ml
listings.description: Acqua Di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Arancia Di Capri Eau De Toilette (30ml) is a relaxing and bright, fruity fragrance for men and women which encapsulates the signature scents of Orange, Mandarin, and Lemon from Capri.This fruity EDT is characterised by bright and radiant top notes of Orange, Mandarin and Lemon scents. At its heart, Petit Grain notes merge with an intense Cardamom aroma while the base of this fragrance is rounded off with a light touch of Caramello and sensual notes of Musk. Top Notes: Italian Sweet Orange, Italian Mandarin and Italian Lemon. Heart Notes: Petit Grain and Cardamom. Base Notes: Caramel and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Her Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Burberry Her Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a floral fruity gourmand fragrance for the headstrong woman, bold and adventurous, full of energy and optimism, enigmatically stylish, living life in the fast lane by her own rulebook. Opening with a sparkling burst of red and dark Berry notes including Blackcurrant, Blueberry and Raspberry, the EDP leads on to a fragrant, floral heart combining sensual Jasmine and romantic, powdery Violet. This culminates in a base lightened by a luminous, White Woods accord together with sensual Dry Amber and earthy Musk. Top Notes: Blackcurrant, Blueberry and Raspberry. Heart Notes: Jasmine Accord and Violet Accord. Base Notes: White Woods, Musk and Dry Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Ariana Grande R.E.M. Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Ariana Grande REM Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a floral, woody fragrance, brimming with limitless, empowering potential. Inspired by Ari's love of outer space and the Universe, this fragrance will make you feel like you can conquer the galaxy.This EDP draws you in with a cosmic blend of Juicy Fig and Warm Salted Caramel. Lavender essence takes you to dreamy new heights, while sparkling Pear Blossom explodes like a supernova in the night sky. Intoxicating Musk, wrapped with Sandalwood, creates the perfect ending to your unforgettable journey. Cruelty-free. Top notes: Quince, Fig, Salted Caramel and Marshmallow. Heart notes: Pear Blossom and Lavender Blossom. Base notes: Tonka Bean, White Musk and Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Afnan Supremacy In Oud Extrait De Parfum 150ml
listings.description: Afnan Supremacy In Oud Extrait De Parfum (150ml) is a versatile and captivating fragrance suitable for a variety of occasions, whether it's a date, a party, or a casual meet-up with friends. This unisex scent is expertly crafted to enhance your unique charisma, making it an essential addition to your fragrance collection. listings.rawTitle: Burberry Touch for Women Eau De Parfum 100ml

listings.rawTitle: Britney Spears Fantasy Eau De Parfum 30ml

Top Notes: Red Lychee, Golden Quince and Kiwi. Heart Notes: Jasmine Petals and White Chocolate Orchid. Base Notes: Musk, Orris Root and Sensual Woods.

This culminates in a woody drydown of Cedarwood and warm, earthy Vetiver. Top Notes: African Marigold, Bergamot and Buchu. Heart Notes: Cyclamen and Violet. Base Notes: Moroccan Cedarwood and Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Gloria Vanderbilt Vanderbilt In Red Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Gloria Vanderbilt Vanderbilt In Red Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a fruity floral EDP for women which depicts an elegant, sophisticated wearer with an intriguing aura and allure.Opening with a zesty and spicy melange of Pear, Bergamot and Pink Pepper, the composition leads on to a floral heart of sensual Jasmine, fragrant Rose and Black Currant. This culminates in a musky, citrusy and comforting base of Vanilla, Vetiver and Cashmeran. Top Notes: Pink Pepper, Bergamot and Pear. Heart Notes: Jasmine, Rose and Black Currant Blossom. Base Notes: Cashmeran, Vanilla and Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Code Le Parfum 125ml
listings.description: Giorgio Armani Code Le Parfum (125ml) is a sensual, oriental woody fragrance for men which conveys the image of a sophisticated, elegant male who exudes effortless magnetism and intense yet unprovocative seduction.This parfum opens with the bright, invigorating top notes of Mandarin and Bergamot, enlivened by the addition of Lemon Essence. This leads on to an aromatic heart combining notes of Rosemary and Lavender from Provence which lend a powerful, magnetic aspect. This culminates in a rich, sensual base with roasted Tonka Bean Absolute lending warmth together with the dry, woodiness of natural Cedar and Musk. Vanilla creates a seductive undertone to this addictive dry down. The shiny, iconic black bottle is adorned with an elegant, golden cap and gold lettering. The textured granular detail at the flacon's neck is reminiscent of a tuxedo's cummerbund. Top Notes: Mandarin, Lemon Essence and Bergamot. Heart Notes: Rosemary and Lavender. Base Notes: Tonka Bean, Vanilla and Cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentleman Society Eau De Parfum 60ml
listings.description: Givenchy Gentleman Society Eau De Parfum (60ml) is a woody, floral, aromatic fragrance for men which redefines the characteristics of modern masculinity with a wild Narcissus flower at its heart.Long-wearing, deep and multifaceted, the EDP opens with the crisp, green, aromatic notes of Sage and the comforting, seductive, spiciness of Cardamom. This leads on to a heart where the rich florality of Wild Narcissus contrasts with the earthy woodiness of a quartet of Vetiver variants, harvested in France, Haiti, Madagascar and Uruguay. This culminates in a sensuous, woody base with creamy Vanilla combining with the addictive essences of Sandalwood and Cedarwood. Gentleman Society is housed in the iconic bottle of Givenchy men's fragrances with a 4G monogram in gleaming silver metal adorning the black lacquered finish. Top Notes: Sage and Cardamom. Heart Notes: Absolute of Narcissus, Essence of Vetiver (Haiti), CO2 Vetiver Extract (Haiti), Essence of Vetiver (Uruguay) and Organic Essence of Vetiver (Madagascar). Base Notes: Cedarwood, Sandalwood and Tasuki Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Jasmine Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Jasmine Eau De Parfum (30ml) is a fruity floral EDP for women bursting with the radiance and inner joy of a composition featuring Jasmine Grandiflorum. This inner joy is further elevated by notes of Mandarin Essence and Magnolia Accord which bring a joyous element to the scent.Opening with a fruity melange of Mandarin and Bergamot, the olfactory trail leads to an overtly floral heart with tender wreaths of Jasmine meeting the sweetness of Magnolia and Damask Rose. This culminates in an earthy, woody base comprising Patchouli, Sandalwood and sensual Benzoin. The fragrant liquid is housed in an elongated bottle featuring a shiny gold cap, crafted from lacquered turquoise stone glass and bearing the distinctive Gucci flora pattern. Top Notes: Italian Mandarin, Bergamot and Black Pepper. Heart Notes: Jasmine, Jasmine Sambac, Magnolia and Damask Rose. Base Notes: Benzoin, Australian Sandalwood and Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy L'Interdit Rouge Eau De Parfum 35ml
listings.description: Givenchy L'Interdit Rouge Eau De Parfum (35ml) captures a whisper of carnal excitement at the heart of its iconic white flower bouquet.Combining the luminous Orange Blossom with opulent Jasmine, the scent achieves a radiant glow, further intensified by a spicy red accord of Blood Orange, Ginger, and Pimento Leaf, all smoothly rounded off with suave Sandalwood. This intricate mix leaves a trail filled with provocative promise. Crafted in France at the historic Givenchy Ateliers, L'Interdit Eau de Parfum Rouge highlights traceable natural ingredients, processed through traditional techniques, to boldly reveal the Underground Flower. The bottle's innovative red lacquer design glows smoulderingly from within, marking a striking debut on the world's perfume stage. L'Interdit invites wearers to experience the thrill of the forbidden and to embrace their singularity. Top Notes: Blood Orange Essence from Sicily, Ginger Extract from Nigeria. Heart Notes: Orange Blossom Absolute from Tunisia, Sambac Jasmine Absolute from India, Pimento Leaves from Jamaica. Base Notes: Patchouli Essence from Indonesia, Sandalwood Essence from New Caledonia.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty For Her Eau De Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Gucci Guilty For Her Eau De Parfum (90ml) is an ambery floral EDP for women who treasure friendship and love, thriving on these emotions to engender self-acceptance and inner confidence. The scent is characterised by the delicate, fresh femininity of Lilac Petals invigorated with a sparkling citrus Mandora facet on a trail of richly sensual amber notes and Patchouli.The composition opens with shimmering top notes of Mediterranean Mandora citrus, natural Bergamot and spicy Pink Pepper, generating a welcoming luminosity and warmth. This leads on to a blooming heart featuring Lilac in combination with a floral melange of Violet, Rose and Geranium. This culminates in an earthy, powdery base blending Patchouli with Amber. Top Notes: Mandora and Pink Pepper. Heart Notes: Lilac. Base Notes: Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a chypre floral EDP for women conveying the image of a confident wearer brimming with inner strength.The composition features the fruity floral sweetness of the Magnolia flower, its Clary Sage-like edge exuding a joyous spirit. The olfactory melange opens with the juicy citrus notes of Dewberry in sensual unison with the creamy Vanilla freshness of Coconut. This leads on to the floral heart of Magnolia, Jasmine Sambac and calming, warming Clary Sage. The scent culminates in the earthy, intense woodiness of Patchouli and Blonde Woods in a drydown which includes the mellow, leathery undertones of Musk. Gucci's iconic flora pattern, featuring vibrant blooms and rich hues, decorates both the bottle and outer packaging of Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia with its captivating purple shade. Top Notes: Dewberry and Coconut. Heart Notes: Magnolia, Jasmine Sambac and Clary Sage. Base Notes: Musk, Patchouli and Blonde Woods.

listings.rawTitle: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Intensely Men's Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Intensely Men's Eau De Parfum (50ml) is an amber, fougere EDP for men which draws its inspiration from Emporio Armani's web series 'Together Stronger', depicting a young couple, irresistibly in love, exploring each other every day both emotionally and physically, challenging the boundaries of their love and making it stronger.This composition opens with a melange of addictively aromatic Chestnut and softly piquant Pink Pepper, leading on to a sensual heart of creamy Vanilla and leathery Suede. This culminates in a drydown of smoky and earthy Vetiver and woody Amber. Top Notes: Pink Pepper and Chestnut Accord. Heart Notes: Vanilla and Suede Accord. Base Notes: Bourbon Vetiver and Ambery Woods Accord.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Armani Code Eau De Parfum 125ml

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Goddess Eau De Parfum Refill 150ml

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity Aromatic Essence for Her Eau De Parfum 100ml

listings.rawTitle: Armaf Club De Nuit Urban Man Elixir Eau De Parfum 10ml

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Touch for Men Eau De Toilette 50ml

Top Notes: Artemisia, Mandarin Tree and Violet Leaves. Heart Notes: Nutmeg, Virginia Cedar Wood and White Pepper. Base Notes: Vetiver, Soft Musk and Tonka Beans.

listings.rawTitle: Bentley For Men Intense Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Bentley For Men Intense Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a powerful men's fragrance from the producers of Britain's internationally renowned luxury cars. listings.rawTitle: Armaf Club De Nuit Untold Eau De Parfum 105ml

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Her Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Burberry Her Eau De Parfum (30ml) is a floral fruity gourmand fragrance for the headstrong woman, bold and adventurous, full of energy and optimism, enigmatically stylish, living life in the fast lane by her own rulebook.Opening with a sparkling burst of red and dark Berry notes including Blackcurrant, Blueberry and Raspberry, the EDP leads on to a fragrant, floral heart combining sensual Jasmine and romantic, powdery Violet. listings.rawTitle: Armaf Club De Nuit Milestone Eau De Parfum 105ml

listings.rawTitle: Cacharel Amor Amor Eau De Toilette 30ml

listings.rawTitle: Armaf Craze Men Eau De Parfum 100ml

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Original Woman Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Burberry Original Woman Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a floral, fruity, and quintessentially classic women's fragrance which has developed a historic richness with chic yet understated luxury.This EDP opens with a succulent and fresh burst of fruits, including Peach, Apricot, cool Pear, and tangy Blackcurrant. listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity Aromatic Essence for Him Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Calvin Klein Eternity Aromatic Essence for Him Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a warm, fougere gourmand EDP which serves as an intense expression of eternal love and the overwhelming passion of lovers.Intense and multifaceted, the composition opens with an aromatic blend of Organic Lavender and Spearmint, taking inspiration from the original Calvin Klein Eternity fragrance. listings.rawTitle: Directions Fluorescent Orange Hair Dye 88ml
listings.description: La Riche Directions Fluorescent Orange (88ml) is a stunning and user-friendly semi-permanent hair colour. listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Si Intense Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Giorgio Armani Si Intense Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an oriental amber floral EDP for women which conveys the irresistibly modern femininity of an empowered Si lady with her enigmatic sophisticated, seductive persona. Opening with a reiteration of the signature Si Blackcurrant Nectar scent, the composition moves on to a heart of intense Turkish Isparta Rose in combination with velvety Davana before culminating in a fiercely intense, enveloping base of Patchouli Essence and Benzoin Resin. The refillable bottle has been lacquered in a transparent blush shade changing to black at the base to imply an intensity in the precious liquid within. A shiny black, stone-shaped cap retains the signature bottle design of Giorgio Armani fragrances with elegant gold rings around the bottle's neck and base adding sophistication and opulence. Top Notes: Blackcurrant Syrup. Heart Notes: Turkish Rose and Davana. Base Notes: Benzoin Resin and Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Irresistible Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Givenchy Irresistible Eau De Parfum (50ml) is an uplifting fruity floral EDP for women characterised by a magnetically powerful melange of two contrasting accords - luscious Rose and luminous Blond Wood - enticing you to feel charming, irresistibly you.The composition opens with an effervescent combination of juicy Pear and musky, slightly sweet Ambrette, leading on to a heart characterised by the luscious notes of Rose blending with the powdery, floral and vaguely earthy notes of Iris. This culminates in a woody drydown of radiant Cedarwood and Musk. The transparent and faceted glass of the prismatic bottle enhances the luminous fragrance within. A charming pink ribbon wraps around the collar of this resolutely couture casing. Top Notes: Pear and Ambrette. Heart Notes: Rose and Iris. Base Botes: Musk and Virginia Cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty For Him Eau De Toilette 90ml
listings.description: Gucci Guilty For Him Eau De Toilette (90ml) is a woody, aromatic fougere EDT for men with a seductive, provocative composition which depicts a charismatic alpha male wearer, an irresistible magnet for his admirers.The fragrance opens with a fruity melange blending Lavender with zesty Lemon, leading on to a heart brimming over with the appealing scents of African Orange Blossom. It culminates in an earthy, woody and sensual base combining warm accords of Cedar, Patchouli and creamy Vanilla. The fragrance is housed in a luxurious, masculine bottle crafted from cold metal and heavy glass, making an impression of masculinity and luxury. The centre of the bottle is adorned with a metallic Gucci sign, transparent to reveal the contents. Top Notes: Lavender and Amalfi Lemon. Heart Note: African Orange Flower. Base Notes: Virginia Cedar, Patchouli and Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentleman Reserve Privee Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Givenchy Gentleman Reserve Privee Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an amber vanilla fragrance inspired by the exquisite notes of whiskey. Designed for the sophisticated man, this EDP represents timeless elegance, blending sophisticated floral notes with the richness of amber for a refined and captivating finish.The scent opens with the refreshing aroma of Bergamot, offering a sweet yet spicy introduction that invigorates the senses. As the fragrance unfolds, it reveals a heart of Iris and Chestnut, contributing to its depth and intensity. The base notes are enveloped in Amber and smoky Whisky, leaving an intoxicating and memorable scent trail. Top Notes: Bergamot. Heart Notes: Iris and Chestnut. Base Notes: Whisky, Amber and Woods.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a joyful floral EDP for free-spirited women who abound with positive energy. The composition centres around the Gardenia flower, revered since time immemorial for its splendour and regularly included in elixirs and magic potions. Drawing inspiration from this legendary power, the gorgeous White Gardenia note blends with the smooth, intense florality of Jasmine Grandiflorum Absolute.Opening with a jubilant citrus melange of Pear Blossom accord, Mandarin Orange and Red Berries, the scent moves on to an overtly floral heart combining fragrant Jasmine, spicy and zesty Gardenia and exotic, sultry Frangipani. This culminates in an earthy Patchouli base with Brown Sugar accord adding a delicate sweetness to the silage. The fragrant liquid is housed in an elongated bottle, the lacquered pink glass and shiny gold cap transforming it into an object of beauty. Top Notes: Pear Blossom, Red Berries and Italian Mandarin. Heart Notes: Gardenia, Jasmine and Frangipani. Base Notes: Brown Sugar and Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty For Her Eau De Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Gucci Guilty For Her Eau De Toilette (50ml) is an amber floral EDT for women which depicts freedom and unconventional love with its notion of genuine liberation whilst radiating warmth and grace. The composition features a light, fresh Lilac Petal within a sparkling citrus opening followed by the signature fougere accord of Geranium and a trail of rich and sensual Amber notes and Patchouli.The scent opens with the flamboyant rush of Mandarin Orange and audacious Pink Pepper. This leads on to an alluring concoction in the heart where heady Lilac and Geranium meet the succulence of Peach, Raspberry and Blackcurrant for a beguiling touch of femininity. This culminates in a voluptuous base with Amber combining with earthy Patchouli, the hallmark of Gucci fragrances. The soft pink fragrance is housed in Gucci's signature tall and slender bottle with rose gold details. Its design replicates the silhouette of the corresponding men's fragrance, reflecting the equal standing of the sexes. Top Notes: Pink Pepper and Mandarin Orange. Heart Notes: Lilac, Peach, Jasmine, Raspberry, Geranium and Blackcurrant. Base Notes: White Musk, Amber, Patchouli and Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Code Pour Homme Eau De Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Giorgio Armani Code Pour Homme Eau De Toilette (50ml) is a distinctively powerful citrus for the modern man, one who is not afraid to display his pride and sense of self.Code New combines elegance and sophistication to create a truly timeless fragrance. Opening with notes of Green mandarin Superessence, the fragrance develops into a heart of Lavandin before resting on a base of Tonka Bean Absolute and Cedarwood Heart. Top Notes: Green Mandarin Superessence. Heart Notes: Lavandin Heart. Base Notes: Tonka Bean Absolute and Cedarwood Heart.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentleman Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Givenchy Gentleman Eau De Toilette (100ml) encapsulates the essence of modern masculinity with a touch of timeless elegance. This EDT from Givenchy paints a portrait of a man who embodies both tradition and spontaneity, showcasing the perfect blend of strength with delicate confidence. A unique offering that brings to the forefront the contrasts within a man's character.Opening with the crisp freshness of a biting Pear, the fragrance takes an aromatic turn with the warmth of Cardamom. The heart reveals a comforting blend of spiced Lavender, presenting a scent that's deeply anchored in masculine tones. At its base, the powdery note of Iris merges seamlessly with Leather and Patchouli, introducing a sensual vibrancy balanced by the allure of Black Vanilla. Top Notes: Pear. Heart Notes: Cardamom, Spiced Lavender. Base Notes: Iris, Leather, Patchouli, Black Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Bloom Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Gucci Bloom Eau De Parfum (30ml) is a floral EDP for women whose title gently inspires and encourages the wearer to blossom into the optimum, empowered version of themselves, pursuing a journey of self-discovery built on vitality and diversity. Gucci Bloom women flourish in their individual, expressive manner outside conventional limitations.Opening with the energising, romantic and naturally sedative qualities of Jasmine, the composition leads on to a rich, honey-like ambrosial heart with a concentration of blossoms provided by natural Tuberose. This culminates in a powdery, feminine base of intoxicating, Honeysuckle-like Rangoon Creeper. A delicate powder pink colour the lacquered porcelain square-shaped bottle, is appliquéd with the Gucci label ribbed and framed in black. The outer carton is covered inside and outside in Herbarium, a red-and-white toile de Jouy House print of leaves, cherry branches and flowers framed in black. Top Notes: Jasmine. Heart Notes: Tuberose. Base Notes: Rangoon Creeper.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Si Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Giorgio Armani Si Eau De Parfum (30ml) is a timeless floral perfume for the resolute yet graceful woman who is sufficiently self-assured to say 'Si' to the values which best define them. The fragrance conveys the contemporary femininity of Giorgio Armani.This EDP exudes the scent of freshly-laundered sheets drying off in the summer breeze, soft and warm with a hint of sophisticated, creamy sweetness. Intense, voluptuous, and deep, it combines the elegance of Freesia with the delightful honey tones of Rose De Mai Absolute to lend it a certain distinction. The lasting, sensual notes of Oakmoss and Patchouli add captivating softness to this modern chypre. The gold ring which encircles the neck of the Armani Si bottle serves as a symbol of eternity, a perfect wedding, engagement, or anniversary icon. Top Notes: Blackcurrant Liqueur. Heart Notes: Rose de Mai Absolute and Freesia. Base Notes: Patchouli and Oakmoss.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Beverly Hills Eau De Toilette 30ml
listings.description: Giorgio Beverley Hills Eau De Toilette (30ml) is a legendary floral, warm, and feminine EDT whose character embodies the glamour and luxury of the heady Californian lifestyle.Opening with a floral fruity melange of citrus notes and mildly spicy, fragrant Bergamot, the composition leads on to an exclusively floral heart featuring zesty Gardenia, rich and sensual Jasmine, and honeyed Tuberose. The sensuality is augmented by the woody dry down blending Sandalwood and Cedar with Patchouli and creamy Vanilla. The fragrance is packaged in the iconic yellow and white striped packaging, replicating the frontage of the brand's ultra-luxurious Rodeo Drive shopping venue which attracts Hollywood's greatest stars. Top Notes: Apricot, Orange Blossom, Peach and Bergamot. Heart Notes: Tuberose, Gardenia, Ylang-Ylang, Jasmine, Orchid and Rose. Base Notes: Chamomile, Oakmoss, Vanilla, Amber, Musk, Sandalwood, Patchouli and Cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden Pretty Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Elizabeth Arden Pretty Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a floral EDP for women which engenders a heightened sense of femininity in its wearer, an irresistible charm.This fragrance opens with refreshing notes of Italian Mandarin and Orange Blossom combined with Peach juices. This leads on to a gentle floral heart with...

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani My Way Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Giorgio Armani My Way Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a floral, woody EDP for the curious woman who seeks new experiences to challenge her preconceptions, covering previously uncharted territory. Connecting with others, she reinvents herself through learning and experience to develop a stronger sense of self.This perfume opens with a sparkling Orange Blossom note, extracted from hand-picked, bitter Egyptian Orange fruit. This leads on to a bright floral heart of Indian Tuberose Flower and culminates in an enveloping, vibrant base of sustainably-sourced Vanilla. The fragrance is housed in a sleek, transparent glass, showcasing the feminine perfume within. It is stoppered with a deep blue rounded cap, acting as a metaphor for the Earth which encapsulates all our human experiences. Top Notes: Calabrian Bergamot and Egyptian Orange Blossom. Heart Notes: Tuberose and Indian Jasmine. Base Notes: Virginian Cedarwood, Vanilla and White Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Intense Eau De Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Intense Eau De Parfum (90ml) is a rich floral EDP for women which conveys sensuality and power. Conveying captivating magnetism, the composition includes the traditionally masculine note of Lavender to emphasise the infinite strength of contemporary woman - bold and empowered.This aromatic expression of power is illuminated by the burning feminine sensuality of Moroccan Orange Blossom to conjure a couture-infused scent which is uniquely unisex in character. A carnal characteristic resonates in the base of Vanilla and Tonka Bean. The edgy and iconic bottle resembles a fashion accessory and is decorated with an oversized Yves Saint Laurent logo in gold-tone hardware. Top Notes: Tangerine, Bergamot and Lavender. Heart Notes: Jasmine Sambac, Orange Blossom and Orchid Accord. Base Notes: Tonka Bean, Vanilla, Amber Gris and Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Night Vision Eau De Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Night Vision Eau De Parfum (90ml) is a sensual, rich, and intense fragrance for men, reflecting bold and seductive sensuality operating in the hours of darkness. The intense composition is a mysterious detonation of vibrant spices and green, woody notes.This EDP opens with electric Lemon combining with the freshness of a black spices complex blending Black Pepper, Black Chilli, Nutmeg and Clove. This leads on to an aromatic heart, both dark and vibrant, in which Rosemary and Coriander support aromatic Clary Sage. The fragrance culminates in a sensual and rich base of Incense. Fir Balsam intensifies the woody, warm element. Taking inspiration from the green light of Night Vision technology, the fragrance is presented in the iconic Spicebomb grenade bottle, fashioned from black glass, restrained by an emerald green strap . Top Notes: Grapefruit, Green Apple, Lemon, Black Spices and Cardamon. Heart Notes: Rosemary, Clary Sage, Coriander, Lentisk, Lavender and Peppermint. Base Notes: Patchouli, Cedarwood, Pistachio, Incense Resinoid, Peru Balm, Fir Balsam, Labdanum and Benzoin.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Eros Pour Homme Eau De Parfum 200ml
listings.description: Versace Eros Pour Homme Eau De Parfum (200ml) is a woody, oriental fragrance for the bold, passionate man, embodying excess. Masculine and confident, this sensual EDP evokes Eros - the god of love - bringing charm, passion and seduction splendidly to the fore.Radiant top notes of Italian Lemon and Mandarin are paired with Mint Oil and a unique note of Candied Apple which give way to a heart of Geranium Flower, Clary Sage and Ambermax. In the dry down, Atlas and Virginia Cedarwood, Haitian Vetiver, Indonesian Patchouli and Sandalwood combine with Vanilla, a decadent weapon with its intoxicating and creamy effects and oriental character. The new fragrance is presented in a blue and gold geometric bottle boasting tactile Medusa and Greca details. Top Notes: Italian Lemon, Mandarin, Mint Oil and Candied Apple. Heart Notes: Geranium Flower, Clary Sage Essence and Ambermax. Base Notes: Cedarwood Atlas, Virginia, Vetiver Orpur Essence, Patchouli Coeur, Sandalwood and Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Le Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Le Parfum (50ml) is a floral parfum for women that epitomises women's enduring spirit, empowering them to live as authentically as possible.Conveying authenticity and strength, this composition boasts a spicy Saffron opening to emphasise the infinite strength of the contemporary woman - bold and empowered. This aromatic expression of power is illuminated by the burning feminine sensuality of an abundant floral bouquet before settling into a smooth, velvety base. The edgy and iconic bottle resembles a fashion accessory tailored from fine materials. Top Notes: Bergamot, Mandarin, Ginger and Saffron Accord. Heart Notes: Orange Blossom, Diva Lavender Heart and Lavandin Heart. Base Notes: Vanilla Bourbon, Honey Accord and Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau De Toilette 90ml
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau De Toilette (90ml) is a floral fruity EDT for women which is a lighter, fresher version of the original signature Libre fragrance.This fragrance symbolises the duality between warm and cold, evidenced in the olfactory tension between aromatic French Lavender and sensual Orange Blossom Absolute from Morocco. This floral melange is infused with the coldness of androgynous White Tea Accord, completing this bright and sensual fragrance. The liquid is housed in a vertical, elongated, elegant and feminine bottle with a gold oversize Cassandra symbolising freedom. Top Notes: Tangerine, Bergamot and Lavender. Heart Notes: Orange Blossom, Jasmine Ansolu and White Jasmine Tea. Base Notes: Musk, Vanilla and Ambergris.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent L'Homme Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent L'Homme Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a floral, spicy EDT for men which conveys charisma and elegance, intertwined with masculinity and urbanity. This manly fragrance opens with sparkling Bergamot and zesty Cedarwood lending a vibrant luminosity which is augmented by Chinese Ginger. This leads to a subtle heart blending floral and spicy notes with Violet Leaves and Basil Flowers sharpened by the piquancy and resonance of White Pepper for refined masculinity. This culminates in a base of Sandalwood, Virginia Cedarwood and Haitian Vetiver which serves to emphasise the magnetic vibe. Top Notes: Bergamot, Cedarwood and Ginger. Heart Notes: Violet Leaves, Basil and White Pepper. Base Notes: Vetiver, Sandalwood and Cedarwood.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Le Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Le Parfum (90ml) is a floral parfum for women that epitomises women's enduring spirit, empowering them to live as authentically as possible.Conveying authenticity and strength, this composition boasts a spicy Saffron opening to emphasise the infinite strength of the contemporary woman - bold and empowered. listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Night Vision Eau De Toilette 90ml
listings.description: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Night Vision Eau De Toilette (90ml) is an intense, oriental, fougere fragrance for men, reflecting bold and seductive sensuality operating in the hours of darkness. The intense composition is an electrifying blend of hot spice and vibrant citrus notes.This EDP opens with the freshness of Bergamot, Cardamom, and Grapefruit, leading on to a masculine heart of Clary Sage, Geranium, and Lavandin. This culminates in a dark base of potent Tonka Bean, Patchouli, and warm woods. Taking inspiration from the green light of Night Vision technology, the fragrance is presented in the iconic Spicebomb grenade bottle, fashioned from emerald green glass which fades to black. Top Notes: Granny Smith Apple, Green Mandarin, Cardamom and Grapefruit. Heart Notes: Pepper, Sage, Nutmeg, Red Chilli Pepper, Clove and Geranium. Base Notes: Tonka Bean, Almond and Woody Notes.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Men Y Le Parfum Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent Men Y Le Parfum Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an intense, woody EDP for men which exudes the strength, elegance and single-minded determination of a man who blazes his own trail. Inspired, diligent and collaborative, he meets life's challenges head on, achieving success through self-accomplishment.This unique composition combines the vibrancy of French Lavender with the power of American Black Cedarwood, and grounds it on strong foundations with the minty vitality of Geranium and the alluring sensuality of Incense. The iconic Yves Saint Laurent bottle has been enveloped in black lacquer from top to bottom, creating a striking image of boldness. Top Notes: Grapefruit, Ginger, Elemi and Aldehydes. Heart Notes: Lavender, Clary Sage and Geranium. Base Notes: Cedarwood, Patchouli, Tonka Bean and Olibanum.

listings.rawTitle: Zimaya Fatima Velvet Love Pour Femme Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Zimaya Fatima Velvet Love Pour Femme Eau De Parfum (100ml) presents itself as a chypre floral fragrance that captures the essence of femininity with its passionate and voluptuous scent. This EDP is designed for the woman who embraces her sensuality with confidence and grace.The fragrance opens with the sweet and succulent note of Pear, providing a juicy and inviting introduction. At its heart lies a bouquet of Egyptian Jasmine and Ylang Ylang, a white floral medley that exudes elegance and romance. The scent concludes with the earthy and rich aroma of Patchouli, creating a sophisticated and long-lasting base. The perfume bottle, classic in design, is tinted with a soft peachy pink shade, reflecting the luscious and affectionate nature of the fragrance within. Zimaya Fatima Velvet Love is more than just a perfume; it's a statement of love and luxury in every drop.Inspired by Louis Vuitton Coeur Battant. Top Notes: Pear. Heart Notes: Egyptian Jasmine and Ylang Ylang. Base Notes: Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Eau De Parfum 150ml
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Eau De Parfum (150ml) is a daring fragrance that embodies sultry, provocative and enthralling femininity. This floral gourmand EDP couples energy with sensuality, pushing boundaries and redefining desire in a contemporary light for the modern woman. A trailblazing scent that bewitches with its trail, it is a revolution in a bottle crafted by Marie Salamagne, Nathalie Lorson, Olivier Cresp and Honorine Blanc.The distinctive black coffee accord meets the sensual sweetness of Vanilla, harmonised by the soft allure of White Flowers and Orange Blossom. A comforting base of Patchouli and White Musk enriches the composition, creating an intriguing contrast of light and dark. The ingredients, distilled to their highest quality, result in a captivating, vigorous and vital fragrance, as embodied by YSL Beauty muse Zoë Kravitz. The Black Opium bottle is a marvel of design - feminine, sleek, and dazzling. Adorned with black glitter as if dressed in sequins, the shimmering black of the bottle is contrasted with the pink hue at its core. The radical contours of the bottle silhouette create an edgy and glamorous aesthetic, evoking the sparkling allure of the fragrance within. Top Notes: Pear Accord, Mandarin Essence. Heart Notes: Vanilla, Orange Blossom, White Flowers. Base Notes: Black Coffee Accord, Cedarwood Essence, White Musk, Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau De Parfum Refill 100ml

The edgy and iconic bottle resembles a fashion accessory tailored from fine materials. Top Notes: Mandarin, Petit Grain, Lavender and Blackcurrant. Heart Notes: Lavender, Jasmine Sambac Absolute, Jasmine Grandiflorum India Absolute and Orange Flower Absolute. Base Notes: Madagascan Vanilla Extract, Cedarwood, Ambergris and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Bonbon Eau De Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Viktor & Rolf Bonbon Eau De Parfum (90ml) is a sweet, floral amber EDP for women, characterised by indulgent scents and a Caramel heart, resulting in an addictive perfume.This irresistible composition blends fruity top notes of Mandarin, Orange, and Blackcurrant with heart notes of Jasmine, Orange Blossom and creamy Caramel. Almost good enough to eat, the delicious Caramel notes progress from an intense first impression to a softer and more delicate heart, evolving into a woody base with Cedarwood, Guaiac Wood, Sandalwood, and Amber. Top Notes: Mandarin, Orange and Blackcurrant. Heart Notes: Peach, Jasmine and Orange Blossom. Base Notes: Cedarwood, Guaiac Wood and Caramel.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb Eau De Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb Eau De Parfum (10ml) is a floral, EDP for women which explodes from the diamond grenade bottle, releasing an eruption of fresh and sweet notes, and depositing you in a world of floral fantasy.This fragrance opens with tingling fresh, sweet accords of Bergamot and Green Tea. This leads on to an opulently floral heart bedecked with intense, sweet, and pure Sambac Jasmine, enticing Centifolia Rose, Freesia, and Cattleya Orchid. In the base, Musk and Patchouli envelope us in an oriental scent, while its milky and powdery elements gently caress our skin. Top Notes: Tea, Bergamot and Osmanthus. Heart Notes: Orchid, Jasmine, Rose, Freesia and African Orange Flower. Base Notes: Patchouli, Musk and Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Infrared Eau De Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Infrared Eau De Parfum (90ml) is a fiery, spicy EDP for men with a carnal leather accord which elevates the Spicebomb collection's renowned seduction and masculinity to an unprecedented level, bestowing the wearer with irrepressible magnetism.A torrid, irresistible explosion of burning spices, the composition ignites with its top notes of spicy floral Red Pepper Accord and warming, peppery Cinnamon, leading on to an incandescent heart of flaming Habanero Red Pepper Accord and woody Eucalyptus. This culminates in a woody, earthy drydown rendered sensual and magnetic by the sophisticated melange of animalistic Leather Accord and balsamic Resinous Wood Accord. The grenade-shaped bottle depicts the piercing red glow of infrared light, fading to smoky black glass. Top Notes: Red Pepper Accord and Cinnamon Essence. Heart Notes: Habanero Red Pepper Accord and Eucalyptus Oil. Base Notes: Resinous Wood Accord and Leather Accord.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Mon Paris Eau De Parfum 150ml
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent Mon Paris Eau De Parfum (150ml) is a chypre floral EDP for women which reflects Parisian femininity, both seductive and sophisticated.Alluring and hypnotic, the composition features nocturnal Datura, a mysterious and intoxicating flower which is complemented by elegant White Peony, vibrant Red Fruits, and sensual Patchouli. It culminates in a base of White Musk. The multifaceted glass bottle with deep base has been adorned with a soft lavalliere around the neck in matte silk, together with leather ties and a stunning, gold Yves Saint Laurent tablet. Top Notes: Pear and Fruit. Heart Notes: Datura and White Flowers. Base Notes: Patchouli and White Musk.

listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent Opium Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a floral, amber EDP for women which exudes sensuality, allure, and voluptuousness.This composition opens with fruity, aromatic notes of Mandarin and Bergamot, leading to an intense, profound heart of Jasmine and Myrrh, lending a sublime and sensual quality.
