listings.rawTitle: Zimaya Ilham Al Oud Pour Homme Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Zimaya Ilham Al Oud Pour Homme Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an EDP that captures the essence of rebellion and freedom, uniquely blending the pleasant aroma of Raspberry with the rich woodiness of Oud. This perfume is a distinct and bold statement in the Zimaya collection.The fragrance opens with the unconventional mix of Leather notes, Jasmine, Amber, and Patchouli, creating a top note that is both daring and captivating. The heart is a rich and intense blend of Oud, Rose, and Incense, evoking the mystery and allure of the desert. The base note combines the sweet and tart scent of Raspberry with the exotic richness of Saffron and the deep, resinous touch of Benzoic Resin, culminating in a fragrance that symbolizes the spirit of infinite freedom. Zimaya Ilham Al Oud is more than a perfume; it's an olfactory representation of unbridled spirit and distinctiveness. Top Notes: Leather, Jasmine, Amber and Patchouli. Heart Notes: Oud, Rose and Incense. Base Notes: Raspberry, Saffron and Benzoic Resin.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau De Parfum 150ml
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau De Parfum (150ml) is a floral EDP for women which epitomises the exhilarating sensation of freedom. The edgy and iconic bottle resembles a fashion accessory tailored from fine materials. Top Notes: Mandarin, Petit Grain, Lavender and Blackcurrant. Heart Notes: Lavender, Jasmine Sambac Absolute, Jasmine Grandiflorum India Absolute and Orange Flower Absolute. Base Notes: Madagascan Vanilla Extract, Cedarwood, Ambergris and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Heritage Yvresse Eau De Toilette 80ml

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Myslf Eau De Parfum for Men 100ml
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent Myslf Eau De Parfum for Men (100ml) is a woody, floral EDP for men that exudes a unique, long-lasting trail of modernity, capturing every nuance and emotion that makes you uniquely you. This leads to the heart of the rich and intense Tunisian Orange Blossom. The scent is balanced at the base by warm and sensual woods, including Indonesian Patchouli and musky Ambrofix. Top Notes: Bergamot. Heart Notes: Tunisian Orange Blossom. Base Notes: Patchouli and Ambrofix.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Eau De Parfum (30ml) is a daring fragrance that embodies sultry, provocative and enthralling femininity. This floral gourmand EDP couples energy with sensuality, pushing boundaries and redefining desire in a contemporary light for the modern woman. A trailblazing scent that bewitches with its trail, it is a revolution in a bottle crafted by Marie Salamagne, Nathalie Lorson, Olivier Cresp and Honorine Blanc.The distinctive black coffee accord meets the sensual sweetness of Vanilla, harmonised by the soft allure of White Flowers and Orange Blossom. A comforting base of Patchouli and White Musk enriches the composition, creating an intriguing contrast of light and dark. The ingredients, distilled to their highest quality, result in a captivating, vigorous and vital fragrance, as embodied by YSL Beauty muse Zoë Kravitz. The Black Opium bottle is a marvel of design - feminine, sleek, and dazzling. Adorned with black glitter as if dressed in sequins, the shimmering black of the bottle is contrasted with the pink hue at its core. The radical contours of the bottle silhouette create an edgy and glamorous aesthetic, evoking the sparkling allure of the fragrance within. Top Notes: Pear Accord, Mandarin Essence. Heart Notes: Vanilla, Orange Blossom, White Flowers. Base Notes: Black Coffee Accord, Cedarwood Essence, White Musk, Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Y For Him Eau De Toilette 100ml

Base Notes: Incense, Ambergris Accord, Cedarwood Oil, Balsam Absolute and Vanilla Accord.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Rive Gauche Eau De Toilette 100ml

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Y Eau De Parfum Intense 100ml

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Y For Him Eau De Parfum 100ml

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Amarige Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Givenchy Amarige Eau De Toilette (100ml) embodies the essence of pure femininity, radiating joy and capturing the simplicity of life's happiest moments. This EDT, designed for the modern woman, is a tribute to the spirit of jubilance and the beauty of the Mediterranean.With each spritz, Amarige unveils its soft and sublime notes, creating a scent that's not only delightful but also evokes the serene shores of the Mediterranean, transporting you to a realm of tranquillity and bliss. Top Notes: Orange Blossom, Peach, Plum, Neroli, Brazilian Rosewood, Mandarin Orange and Violet. Heart Notes: Tuberose, Mimosa, Gardenia, Ylang-Ylang, Jasmine, Black locust, Carnation, Red Berries, Black Currant, Cassia, Rose and Orchid. Base Notes: Sandalwood, Woody Notes, Amber, Vanilla, Musk, Tonka Bean and Cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani My Way Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Giorgio Armani My Way Eau De Parfum (30ml) is a floral, woody EDP for the curious woman who seeks new experiences to challenge her preconceptions, covering previously uncharted territory. Connecting with others, she reinvents herself through learning and experience to develop a stronger sense of self.This perfume opens with a sparkling Orange Blossom note, extracted from hand-picked, bitter Egyptian Orange fruit. This leads on to a bright floral heart of Indian Tuberose Flower and culminates in an enveloping, vibrant base of sustainably-sourced Vanilla. The fragrance is housed in a sleek, transparent glass, showcasing the feminine perfume within. It is stoppered with a deep blue rounded cap, acting as a metaphor for the Earth which encapsulates all our human experiences. Top Notes: Calabrian Bergamot and Egyptian Orange Blossom. Heart Notes: Tuberose and Indian Jasmine. Base Notes: Virginian Cedarwood, Vanilla and White Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Bloom Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Gucci Bloom Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a floral EDP for women whose title gently inspires and encourages the wearer to blossom into the optimum, empowered version of themselves, pursuing a journey of self-discovery built on vitality and diversity. Gucci Bloom women flourish in their individual, expressive manner outside conventional limitations.Opening with the energising, romantic and naturally sedative qualities of Jasmine, the composition leads on to a rich, honey-like ambrosial heart with a concentration of blossoms provided by natural Tuberose. This culminates in a powdery, feminine base of intoxicating, Honeysuckle-like Rangoon Creeper. A delicate powder pink colour the lacquered porcelain square-shaped bottle, is appliquéd with the Gucci label ribbed and framed in black. The outer carton is covered inside and outside in Herbarium, a red-and-white toile de Jouy House print of leaves, cherry branches and flowers framed in black. Top Notes: Jasmine. Heart Notes: Tuberose. Base Notes: Rangoon Creeper.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a chypre floral EDP for women conveying the image of a confident wearer brimming with inner strength.The composition features the fruity floral sweetness of the Magnolia flower, its Clary Sage-like edge exuding a joyous spirit. The olfactory melange opens with the juicy citrus notes of Dewberry in sensual unison with the creamy Vanilla freshness of Coconut. This leads on to the floral heart of Magnolia, Jasmine Sambac and calming, warming Clary Sage. The scent culminates in the earthy, intense woodiness of Patchouli and Blonde Woods in a drydown which includes the mellow, leathery undertones of Musk. Gucci's iconic flora pattern, featuring vibrant blooms and rich hues, decorates both the bottle and outer packaging of Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia with its captivating purple shade. Top Notes: Dewberry and Coconut. Heart Notes: Magnolia, Jasmine Sambac and Clary Sage. Base Notes: Musk, Patchouli and Blonde Woods.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Taylor White Diamonds Eau De Toilette 30ml
listings.description: Elizabeth Taylor White Diamonds Eau De Toilette (30ml) is a sheer floral fragrance in which the harmony of flowers and aldehydes in the top notes, together with the sharp base, creates an elegant vintage nuance.This EDT is a timeless fragrance which celebrates the glamour of Elizabeth Taylor. For the classic and sophisticated woman, White Diamonds is a rich and luxurious fragrance with the endless brilliance of a rare jewel. It is the epitome of Elizabeth's star-quality - radiant, glamorous, overwhelmingly beautiful. White Diamonds is a sensual, floral fragrance that imbues its wearer with the glamour and sparkle of her world-famous diamond jewellery collection. Top Notes: Living Amazon Lily and Neroli Bigarade. Heart Notes: Tuberose, Living Jasmin and Living Narcisse Rose. Base Notes: Amber, Oakmoss, Patchouli, and Sandalwood Mysore.

listings.rawTitle: Gres Madame Gres Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Gres Madame Gres Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a floral, oriental fragrance for women. This elegant and sophisticated EDP begins with citrus notes of Grapefruit combined with juicy Pineapple which mingle with spicy notes of Cardamom.The heart provides a graceful bouquet of Magnolia, White Peony and Freesia, creating rich floral tones. The base contribute sensuality, warmth and femininity with soft notes of Vanilla, Sandalwood, Patchouli, providing a unique signature dry down. Top Notes: Pineapple, Grapefruit, Cornflower and Sultan Seeds. Heart Notes: Magnolia, Peony and Freesia. Base Notes: Sandalwood, Vanilla, Patchouli and Leather.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Ysatis Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Givenchy Ysatis Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a tribute to the spirit of liberated femininity, perfectly blending the ethos of sophisticated elegance with joy and sensuality in a spiced floral concoction.This mesmerising EDT by Givenchy begins with the effervescent note of Raspberry Accord, leading to the heart enriched with the exotic Grandiflorum Jasmine Absolute from India, radiating floral freshness. Anchoring the fragrance is the deep and warm note of Vetiver Essence from Haiti, adding a smoky woodiness that complements and balances the preceding notes beautifully, offering a harmonious juxtaposition that speaks of depth and elegance. Top Notes: Raspberry Accord. Heart Notes: Grandiflorum Jasmine Absolute from India. Base Notes: Vetiver Essence from Haiti.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Si Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Giorgio Armani Si Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a timeless floral perfume for the resolute yet graceful woman who is sufficiently self-assured to say 'Si' to the values which best define them. The fragrance conveys the contemporary femininity of Giorgio Armani.This EDP exudes the scent of freshly-laundered sheets drying off in the summer breeze, soft and warm with a hint of sophisticated, creamy sweetness. Intense, voluptuous, and deep, it combines the elegance of Freesia with the delightful honey tones of Rose De Mai Absolute to lend it a certain distinction. The lasting, sensual notes of Oakmoss and Patchouli add captivating softness to this modern chypre. The gold ring which encircles the neck of the Armani Si bottle serves as a symbol of eternity, a perfect wedding, engagement, or anniversary icon. Top Notes: Blackcurrant Liqueur. Heart Notes: Rose de Mai Absolute and Freesia. Base Notes: Patchouli and Oakmoss.

listings.rawTitle: Gloria Vanderbilt Jardin a New York Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Gloria Vanderbilt Jardin à New York Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a floral EDP for women which seeks through its composition to capture the freshness of Central Park with magnificent blossoms and charming accords of delicate white flowers exuding divine scents which are transported on the summer city air.Flower meets wood in this olfactory melange. Woody petitgrain, juicy Pear and fragrant Gardenia release an invigorating, green freshness. Pink Peony, earthy Neroli and intoxicating Jasmine enhance the mix. Top Notes: Gardenia and Petitgrain. Heart Notes: Jasmine, Neroli and Peony. Base Notes: Cedar and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Ange Ou Demon Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Givenchy Ange Ou Demon Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a captivating floral amber EDP that places the noble Lily at its heart, beautifully magnified by the sophisticated elegance of Palisander and Oak Woods. This sensual and elegant scent boasts a high level of natural ingredients, making it a symbol of luxury and femininity, encapsulated within a precious bottle that reflects its exquisite nature.The fragrance opens with the unique blend of White Thyme Essence, Mandarin from Calabria, and Saffron Essence, introducing a vibrant and inviting start. The heart unfolds with the regal presence of Noble Lily, complemented by the exotic aromas of Ylang-Ylang and Orchid Maxillaria, weaving a rich tapestry of floral elegance. The base notes of Tonka Bean, Vanilla, Palisander Wood, and Oak Wood Essence provide a warm and enveloping finish, grounding the fragrance in a deep, mesmerising trail. Top Notes: White Thyme Essence, Mandarin from Calabria, Saffron Essence. Heart Notes: Noble Lily, Ylang-Ylang, Orchid Maxillaria. Base Notes: Tonka Bean, Vanilla, Palisander Wood, Oak Wood Essence.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy L'Interdit Eau De Parfum 80ml
listings.description: Givenchy L'Interdit Eau De Parfum (80ml) unveils the beauty concealed within, marking its stature as an emblematic floral woody fragrance that resonates with your deepest cravings.This enthralling EDP by Givenchy opens with the familiar zest of Ginger, drawing you into its pristine aura. As it evolves, the fragrance reveals a captivating heart imbued with the opulence of Orange Blossom, Jasmine and Tuberose, wrapping you in its luxurious embrace. As it dries, the fragrance indulges in the profound, mesmerising chords of Patchouli and Vetiver, adding depth and intricacy to its allure. The celebrated scent by Givenchy takes you on an odyssey of introspection, inspiring you to acknowledge the shadowed passions within. The fragrance is encased in a classic bottle, its contrasting edges and supple curves mirroring the multifaceted nature of one's identity. Top Notes: Ginger. Heart Notes: Orange Blossom, Jasmine and Tuberose. Base Notes: Patchouli and Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a joyful floral EDP for free-spirited women who abound with positive energy. The composition centres around the Gardenia flower, revered since time immemorial for its splendour and regularly included in elixirs and magic potions. Drawing inspiration from this legendary power, the gorgeous White Gardenia note blends with the smooth, intense florality of Jasmine Grandiflorum Absolute.Opening with a jubilant citrus melange of Pear Blossom accord, Mandarin Orange and Red Berries, the scent moves on to an overtly floral heart combining fragrant Jasmine, spicy and zesty Gardenia and exotic, sultry Frangipani. This culminates in an earthy Patchouli base with Brown Sugar accord adding a delicate sweetness to the silage. The fragrant liquid is housed in an elongated bottle, the lacquered pink glass and shiny gold cap transforming it into an object of beauty. Top Notes: Pear Blossom, Red Berries and Italian Mandarin. Heart Notes: Gardenia, Jasmine and Frangipani. Base Notes: Brown Sugar and Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Armani Code Femme Eau De Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Giorgio Armani Armani Code Femme Eau De Parfum (75ml) is a floral amber EDP for women which conveys the breathless, seductive power experienced in the surprise intimacy and excitement of an unforgettable encounter.Intoxicating and addictive, this fragrance opens with a sensual note of Orange Flower mingling with fresh Ginger accents, which are augmented by a heart of Orange Blossom. This culminates in a creamy, caressing base of Honey and Vanilla. Top Notes: Jasmine and Orange. Heart Notes: Orange Blossom. Base Notes: Honey and Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Taylor White Diamonds Eau De Toilette 100ml

listings.rawTitle: Versace Eros Pour Homme Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Versace Eros Pour Homme Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a woody, oriental fragrance for the bold, passionate man, embodying excess. Masculine and confident, this sensual EDP evokes Eros - the god of love - bringing charm, passion and seduction splendidly to the fore. Radiant top notes of Italian Lemon and Mandarin are paired with Mint Oil and a unique note of Candied Apple which give way to a heart of Geranium Flower, Clary Sage and Ambermax. In the dry down, Atlas and Virginia Cedarwood, Haitian Vetiver, Indonesian Patchouli and Sandalwood combine with Vanilla, a decadent weapon with its intoxicating and creamy effects and oriental character. The new fragrance is presented in a blue and gold geometric bottle boasting tactile Medusa and Greca details. Top Notes: Italian Lemon, Mandarin, Mint Oil and Candied Apple. Heart Notes: Geranium Flower, Clary Sage Essence and Ambermax. Base Notes: Cedarwood Atlas, Virginia, Vetiver Orpur Essence, Patchouli Coeur, Sandalwood and Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Red Jeans Eau De Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Versace Red Jeans Eau De Toilette (75ml) is a floral, fruity fragrance for women who are young at heart. Light, feminine and intended for everyday wear, this EDT possesses a blend of Jasmine, Vanilla, Musk, Sandalwood and Lily. Top Notes: Peach, Apricot, Freesia and Black Currant. Heart Notes: Rose, Violet, Lily-of-the-Valley, Water Lily and Ylang Ylang. Base Notes: Musk, Sandalwood and Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Crystal Noir Eau De Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Versace Crystal Noir Eau De Parfum (90ml) is a floral, oriental EDP for the charismatic woman, perfect to wear on colder days with its warming aroma of Ginger, and hot notes of Cardamon, and Spicy Pepper.This is followed by the slightly bitter mix of Orange Blossom, Gardenia, and the floral aroma of Peony. The dry down includes warm Sandalwood, Musk, and rare Amber. Top Notes: Cardamom, Ginger and Pepper. Heart Notes: Gardenia, Orange Blossom and Peony. Base Notes: Amber, Musk and Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Woman Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Versace Woman Eau De Parfum (50ml) is an elegant and feminine floral, woody EDP that captures the essence of timeless beauty and sensuality. It is designed for women who exude confidence and grace, making it a perfect addition to any collection. The perfume embraces a harmonious blend of delicate florals and warm, woody notes, offering a versatile scent for both day and evening wear. The fragrance opens with a fresh burst of Frangipani Blossoms and Jasmine, creating a captivating floral introduction. The heart reveals a soft blend of Lotus and Cedarwood, adding a natural depth to the composition. Finally, the base brings a comforting touch of Musk and Amber, rounding off the scent with warmth and sophistication. Top Notes: Frangipani Blossoms, Jasmine. Heart Notes: Lotus, Cedarwood. Base Notes: Musk, Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Uomo Intense Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Valentino Uomo Intense Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a wholly unique EDP by Valentino. Though it can be enjoyed worn by itself, this particular parfum is designed to compliment and fuse seamlessly with other popular Valentino scents, creating a totally unique, personalised perfume to be enjoyed by the wearer. By deeply studying and experimenting with the fine science of fragrance layering, Uomo Intense promises, and entire world of possibility. It is known to work best with fresh fragrances, particularly with powdery and woody notes to illuminate the already musky scent of Uomo Intense.This EDP combines citrus and floral notes with woody subtleties to wrap the wearer in an intense atmosphere. It opens citrus, floral notes of Mandarin Orange and Clary Sage, before developing into a heart of Iris and Tonka Bean which nestles itself upon a bed of Vanilla and Leather. Housed in a faceted, black bottle. Top Notes: Mandarin Orange and Clary Sage. Heart Notes: Iris and Tonka Bean. Base Notes: Vanilla and Leather.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Dreamer Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Versace Dreamer Eau De Toilette (100ml) is an oriental and woody fragrance, intended for the man who knows no limits, who experiences his strength naturally - his elegance spontaneously.The woody, manly and sensual EDT comes from notes of Citrus, Neroli, Bergamot and Petit Grain, resting on a heart of Hyacinth, Clary Sage, Cedar and Geranium, and completed by powerful base notes of Tonka Bean, Musk and Amber. Top Notes: Juniper, Mugwort and Tarragon. Heart Notes: Aerial Flower, Amber Lily and Iris. Base Notes: Amber and Tobacco Flowers.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Uomo Eau De Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Valentino Uomo Eau De Toilette (50ml) is a classically spicy, woody fragrance for men which envelopes the wearer in a refine, masculine atmosphere which inspires confidence and manly sophistication.Comprising a smoky blend of spicy and floral essences, this EDT opens with notes of Bergamot Essence, Lemon Essence and Cardamom Essence, a surprisingly citrusy opening which gradually evolves into a spicy heart of Clary Sage, Lavendin Accord and Black Pepper Essence, lending the fragrance its unexpected strength and character. The base is full of rich and woody notes which leave behind an irresistible trail of Vanilla, Iris, Cedar, and Vetiver. Housed in a multi-faceted, transparent glass bottle which showcases the golden ichor within. Top Notes: Bergamot Essence, Lemon Essence and Cardamom Essence. Heart Notes: Clary Sage Essence, Lavendin Accord and Black Pepper Essence. Base Notes: Cedar Essence, Vetiver Essence, Vanilla Accord and Iris Accord.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Bright Crystal Eau De Toilette 30ml
listings.description: Versace Bright Crystal Eau De Toilette (30ml) is a floral and fruity fragrance that is enthralling, voluptuous and eloquent. This EDT perfectly symbolises the glamorous Versace woman, who is strong and sure of her sensual and feminine charm.She is a woman who loves to be enveloped in this fragrance which delicately reveals colourful and juicy Pomegranate grains, iced freshness and shining Yuzu. The beauty of Magnolia, Peonia and Lotus Flower provide voluptuousness and transparency, while Vegetal Amber is delicately sensual and will delight the senses. Top Notes: Pomegranate Grains, Iced Accord and Yuzu. Heart Notes: Magnolia, Peony and Lotus Flower. Base Notes: Plant Amber, Acajou and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Crystal Noir Eau De Toilette 90ml
listings.description: Versace Crystal Noir Eau De Toilette (90ml) is a floral and oriental fragrance with an ethereal yet carnal aspect. Precious, delicate, and magical, this EDT has an ultra-feminine, persistent scent.Minimalist in composition, it emphasises the intrinsic elegance of the ingredients. Made from garnet glass, the jewel-like bottle is inspired by the facets of a diamond. Top Notes: Blackcurrant, Black Fig and Violet. Heart Notes: Tuberose, Frangipani and Jasmine. Base Notes: Sandalwood, Cashmeran, Vanilla Pod and Heliotropine.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Eros Flame Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Versace Eros Flame Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a woody, citrus fragrance for the strong, passionate, self-confident man who is deeply in touch with his emotions. Simultaneously virile, an ode to passion and a celebration of sensuous rapture, this EDP is characterised by strong contrasts between its ingredients which complement, enrich and enhance one another.The vivacious top notes of fresh, juicy Italian Lemon, Tangerine and Bitter Orange are warmed with notes of Black Pepper from Madagascar and aromatic Wild Rosemary. Through a heart of Pepperwood, Geranium and Rose Facets, you arrive at the base where Texas Cedar, Patchouli Heart, Haitian Vetiver, Mountain Oak Moss Accord and Sandalwood combine with Tonka Bean and Vanilla to create a sensuous trail. Top Notes: Italian Lemon, Tangerine and Bitter Orange. Heart Notes: Pepperwood, Geranium and Rose Facets. Base Notes: Texas Cedar, Patchouli Heart, Haitian Vetiver, Mountain Oak Moss Accord and Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Bright Crystal Absolu Eau De Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Versace Bright Crystal Absolu Eau De Parfum (90ml) is a sweet, floral fragrance for women, recommended for daytime wear. This vibrant and bright EDP represents pure sensuality and is a more intense version of the original Versace Bright Crystal.As precious as a diamond, it is perfect for the Versace woman who has been blessed with strength and confidence, yet is feminine and glamorous. This sensual scent features delicate notes of colourful, juicy Pomegranate Grains and Japanese Yuzu, blended with a gorgeous fruity and floral heart of Peony, Lotus Flower, Magnolia and Raspberry, wonderfully combined with Musk, Amber and Mahogany. It is presented in a beautiful, pink glass bottle, topped with a large, diamond-cut stopper. Top Notes: Pomegranate, Yuzu and Water. Heart Notes: Peony, Raspberry, Lotus and Magnolia. Base Notes: Musk, Mahogany and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Uomo Born In Roma Intense Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Valentino Uomo Born In Roma Intense Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an enticing amber fougere EDP for men who exude the cool, vibrant energy of Rome's hip streets as the sun sets. This playful yet deeply sensual scent amplifies the addictive nature of the original Uomo Born in Roma fragrance, boasting an explosive personality that remains true to the collection.Opening with the sensual creaminess of Vanilla Bourbon, Uomo Born in Roma Intense captivates with a bewitching blend enhanced by the exotic warmth of Ginger and the Mediterranean spark of Bergamot. The heart features vibrant Lavandin, dancing with the aromatic spice of Nutmeg, heightened by a seductive salty accord. The base culminates in an irresistibly addictive blend of smoky Vetiver and a sophisticated array of woody notes, creating a hypnotic trail. Presented in an iconic studded bottle, this Valentino fragrance for men draws inspiration from Roman architecture and symbolises a rebellious new era in high fashion, led by the fashion house itself. The Born In Roma collection celebrates magnificent personalities and pairings, with Uomo (for him) and Donna (for her), playfully exploring the contrasts between day and night, classic and intensity, and you and me. Top Notes: Vanilla Bourbon, Ginger, Bergamot. Heart Notes: Nutmeg, Lavandin, Salty Accord. Base Notes: Vetiver, Woody Notes.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Eros Pour Homme Eau De Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Versace Eros Pour Homme Eau De Toilette (50ml) is an oriental, fruity EDT for men that personifies masculinity with its intense, vibrant, and glowing freshness, derived from the combination of Mint Leaves, Italian Lemon Zest and Green Apple.An addictive sensuality results from intriguing, oriental elements such as Tonka Beans, Amber, Geranium Flower and Vanilla. Virility, intensity and power are provided by Cedarwood, Vetiver and Oak Moss. Top Notes: Mint, Apple and Lemon. Heart Notes: Tonka Bean, Geranium and Ambroxan. Base Notes: Vanilla, Vetiver, Oak Moss and Cedarwood.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Bonbon Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Viktor & Rolf Bonbon Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a sweet, floral amber EDP for women, characterised by indulgent scents and a Caramel heart, resulting in an addictive perfume.This irresistible composition blends fruity top notes of Mandarin, Orange, and Blackcurrant with heart notes of Jasmine, Orange Blossom and creamy Caramel. Almost good enough to eat, the delicious Caramel notes progress from an intense first impression to a softer and more delicate heart, evolving into a woody base with Cedarwood, Guaiac Wood, Sandalwood, and Amber. Top Notes: Mandarin, Orange and Blackcurrant. Heart Notes: Peach, Jasmine and Orange Blossom. Base Notes: Cedarwood, Guaiac Wood and Caramel.

Green Tea remains the hallmark scent of this refreshingly clean fragrance that's ideal for everyday wear, especially...

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Irresistible Eau De Parfum 80ml
listings.description: Givenchy Irresistible Eau De Parfum (80ml) is an uplifting fruity floral EDP for women characterised by a magnetically powerful melange of two contrasting accords - luscious Rose and luminous Blond Wood - enticing you to feel charming, irresistibly you.The composition opens with an effervescent combination of juicy Pear and musky, slightly sweet Ambrette, leading on to a heart characterised by the luscious notes of Rose blending with the powdery, floral and vaguely earthy notes of Iris. This culminates in a woody drydown of radiant Cedarwood and Musk. The transparent and faceted glass of the prismatic bottle enhances the luminous fragrance within. A charming pink ribbon wraps around the collar of this resolutely couture casing. Top Notes: Pear and Ambrette. Heart Notes: Rose and Iris. Base Notes: Musk and Virginia Cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Armani Code Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Giorgio Armani Armani Code Eau De Parfum (50ml) captures a vibrant new intensity in this captivating, refillable masculine fragrance.Starting with a fresh and vibrant Green Mandarin essence from Italy, this spicy woody fougere perfume sets a distinctive tone. The heart features a warm and spicy essence of Nutmeg, leading to a base where a rich and warm Tonka Bean Absolute brings out a deep masculine sensuality. The new Armani Code bottle reimagines the original iconic design with an environmentally mindful approach by Giorgio Armani. Its sleek, striking black form, enhanced with silver accents and sensorial touches, is not only aesthetically pleasing but also rechargeable in all formats, demonstrating a commitment to environmental sustainability. Top Notes: Green Mandarin Essence. Heart Notes: Nutmeg Essence. Base Notes: Tonka Bean Absolute.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Armani Code Femme Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Giorgio Armani Armani Code Femme Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a floral amber EDP for women which conveys the breathless, seductive power experienced in the surprise intimacy and excitement of an unforgettable encounter.Intoxicating and addictive, this fragrance opens with a sensual note of Orange Flower mingling with fresh Ginger accents, which are augmented by a heart of Orange Blossom. This culminates in a creamy, caressing base of Honey and Vanilla. Top Notes: Jasmine and Orange. Heart Notes: Orange Blossom. Base Notes: Honey and Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Beverly Hills Yellow Fine Fragrance Mist 240ml
listings.description: Giorgio Beverly Hills Yellow Fine Fragrance Mist (240ml) is a refreshing spray for women's hair and body which surrounds the user with this legendary floral, warm, and feminine fragrance whose character embodies the glamour and luxury of the heady Californian lifestyle.Opening with a floral fruity melange of citrus notes and mildly spicy, fragrant Bergamot, the composition leads on to an exclusively floral heart featuring zesty Gardenia, rich and sensual Jasmine, and honeyed Tuberose. The sensuality is augmented by the woody dry down blending Sandalwood and Cedar with Patchouli and creamy Vanilla. The fragrance is packaged in the iconic yellow and white striped packaging, replicating the frontage of the brand's ultra-luxurious Rodeo Drive shopping venue which attracts Hollywood's greatest stars. Top Notes: Apricot, Orange Blossom, Peach and Bergamot. Heart Notes: Tuberose, Gardenia, Ylang-Ylang, Jasmine, Orchid and Rose. Base Notes: Chamomile, Oakmoss, Vanilla, Amber, Musk, Sandalwood, Patchouli and Cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Code Pour Homme Eau De Toilette 125ml
listings.description: Giorgio Armani Code Pour Homme Eau De Toilette (125ml) is a distinctively powerful citrus for the modern man, one who is not afraid to display his pride and sense of self.Code New combines elegance and sophistication to create a truly timeless fragrance. Opening with notes of Green mandarin Superessence, the fragrance develops into a heart of Lavandin before resting on a base of Tonka Bean Absolute and Cedarwood Heart. Top Notes: Green Mandarin Superessence. Heart Notes: Lavandin Heart. Base Notes: Tonka Bean Absolute and Cedarwood Heart.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Homme Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Homme Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a fresh and aquatic, fruity floral EDT for men which portrays a canvas of warm sunshine, fresh sea, and rich earth.Masculine and sensual, minimalistic, and authentic, this fragrance opens with fresh and stimulating Bergamot, Neroli and Green Tangerine. This leads on to a heart of warm aquatic notes with Rock Rose and fruity Persimmon. The fragrance culminates in a warm, woody and sensual base of Patchouli, Cedarwood and Musk. Top Notes: Bergamot, Neroli and Tangerine. Heart Notes: Ozonic Marine Notes, Sambac Jasmine Essence, Rock Rose and Persimmon Fruit. Base Notes: Cedarwood, Patchouli and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Intensely Men's Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Intensely Men's Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an amber, fougere EDP for men which draws its inspiration from Emporio Armani's web series 'Together Stronger', depicting a young couple, irresistibly in love, exploring each other every day both emotionally and physically, challenging the boundaries of their love and making it stronger.This composition opens with a melange of addictively aromatic Chestnut and softly piquant Pink Pepper, leading on to a sensual heart of creamy Vanilla and leathery Suede. This culminates in a drydown of smoky and earthy Vetiver and woody Amber. Top Notes: Pink Pepper and Chestnut Accord. Heart Notes: Vanilla and Suede Accord. Base Notes: Bourbon Vetiver and Ambery Woods Accord.

listings.rawTitle: Estée Lauder Knowing Eau De Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Estée Lauder Knowing Eau De Parfum (75ml) is heady, woody fragrance that is as mysterious as it is exciting. Filled with incredible floral and green notes, this fragrance possesses impressive style with minimal effort.Top notes of Rose, Tuberose, Coriander and Green notes combine with Plum, Mimosa and Melon. This slowly...

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Taylor Diamonds & Rubies Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Elizabeth Taylor Diamonds & Rubies Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a light floral and feminine fragrance for casual daytime wear with a refreshing flowery scent.This EDT uses a subtle blend of luscious notes including Peach, Lilies, Rose, Bitter Almond, Jasmine, Heliotrope, White Rose, Ylang Ylang, Lily Of The Valley, Amber, Cedarwood, Vanilla, Benzoin and Musk. Top Notes: Red Rose, Peach, Almond Wood, Lilac and Lily. Heart Notes: Rose, Spices, Heliotrope, Ylang-Ylang, Orchid, Jasmine and Lily-of-the-Valley. Base Notes: Vanilla, Sandalwood, Amber, Benzoin, Musk and Cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Ariana Grande Ari Eau De Parfum 100ml

Base notes: Creamy Musk, Blonde Woods and Marshmallow.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Colonia Eau De Cologne 50ml
listings.description: Acqua Di Parma Colonia Eau De Cologne (50ml) is an iconic floral EDC for men and women, which reflects Italian sophistication, embodied in this harmonious blend of floral essences.Timeless, enduring and crafted from sunny Sicilian citrus fruits, it is a fresh, elegant embodiment of Italian style and culture. With a citrusy floral heart derived from a Lavender and a Damask Rose blend, the refined scent of this aroma is rounded off with woody notes of Vetiver, Sandalwood and Patchouli at the base. Top Notes: Lemon, Sweet Orange and Calabrian Bergamot. Heart Notes: Lavender, Bulgarian Rose, Verbena and Rosemary. Base Notes: Vetiver, Sandalwood and Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Colonia Essenza Eau De Cologne 100ml
listings.description: Acqua Di Parma Colonia Essenza Eau De Cologne (100ml) exudes a fragrance which embodies the traditional values of the Colonia while embracing a modern perspective.This EDC a citrus-scented and woody fragrance with a strong personality. Its classic freshness becomes even more vivacious with the addition of floral scents like Grapefruit, Mandarin and Petit Grain notes, all brought together by a vibrant woody Patchouli base. The sophisticated woody notes lend an elegant sober touch to this cologne. Top Notes: Lemon, Orange, Bergamot, Mandarin, Grapefruit, Neroli and Petit Grain. Heart Notes: Rosemary, Lily of the Valley, Rose Accord, Jasmine Accord and Cloves. Base Notes: Vetiver, Patchouli, White Musk and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Serge Lutens Feminite du Bois Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Serge Lutens Feminite du Bois Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a woody unisex EDP which takes its inspiration from the warm, honeyed scents exuding from the Moroccan soukhs selling leather goods. Mythical, pure and essential, this confection of Cedarwood seeks to reflect the masculine side of femininity and, conversely, the feminine aspect of masculinity. Sumptuous and rich, the composition comprises 60% wood-based olfactory notes giving it a unique identity with its numerous scents and colours conveying human's nuanced characters. The fragrant liquid is housed in a minimalist, angular and straight-lined bottle with a refined image which mirrors the exacting character of its creator. Top Notes: Plum. Heart Notes: Floral Notes. Base Notes: Cedarwood.

listings.rawTitle: Shay & Blue Atropa Belladonna Eau De Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Shay & Blue Atropa Belladonna Eau De Parfum (10ml) is a boldly different, chic and mesmerising, unisex floral, fragrance which draws its inspiration from deadly nightshade. Seductive and heady, the overtly decadent scent of Dark Cassis Berries mingles with Narcissus and Jasmine on a base of rich Bourbon Vanilla.All Shay & Blue scents are made with real flowers, fruits, and spices with a long-lasting scent. They are carefully handcrafted in England and produced to the highest standards of animal and planet welfare. Cruelty-free & vegan-friendly. Top Note: Dark Cassis Berries. Heart Notes: White Narcissus and Jasmine. Base Notes: Patchouli and Bourbon Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Uomo Born In Roma Intense Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Valentino Uomo Born In Roma Intense Eau De Parfum (50ml) is an enticing amber fougere EDP for men who exude the cool, vibrant energy of Rome's hip streets as the sun sets. This playful yet deeply sensual scent amplifies the addictive nature of the original Uomo Born in Roma fragrance, boasting an explosive personality that remains true to the collection.Opening with the sensual creaminess of Vanilla Bourbon, Uomo Born in Roma Intense captivates with a bewitching blend enhanced by the exotic warmth of Ginger and the Mediterranean spark of Bergamot. The heart features vibrant Lavandin, dancing with the aromatic spice of Nutmeg, heightened by a seductive salty accord. The base culminates in an irresistibly addictive blend of smoky Vetiver and a sophisticated array of woody notes, creating a hypnotic trail. Presented in an iconic studded bottle, this Valentino fragrance for men draws inspiration from Roman architecture and symbolises a rebellious new era in high fashion, led by the fashion house itself. The Born In Roma collection celebrates magnificent personalities and pairings, with Uomo (for him) and Donna (for her), playfully exploring the contrasts between day and night, classic and intensity, and you and me. Top Notes: Vanilla Bourbon, Ginger, Bergamot. Heart Notes: Nutmeg, Lavandin, Salty Accord. Base Notes: Vetiver, Woody Notes.

listings.rawTitle: Tommy Hilfiger Tommy Girl Eau De Toilette 50ml

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Black Orchid Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Tom Ford Black Orchid Parfum (50ml) is an amber chypre floral fragrance which heightens the iconic sensuality of the original Tom Ford Black Orchid EDP. Reflecting his obsession with the perfection and elusive nature of a Black Orchid flower, the precious, hypnotic essential oil features in a magnified seductive melange where potent Ylang Ylang flowers are immersed in golden Rum Absolute.The composition opens with the decadent complexity of Black Truffle, sophisticated Black Orchid and the nuanced floralcy of Ylang Ylang. This leads on to a heart where the mysterious, sweet depth of Black Plum blends with the odoriferous elements of Rum Absolute. This culminates in a robust drydown of earthy, musky Patchouli. The fragrant liquid is housed in a gold-toned, elegant flacon with fluted detail. Top Notes: Black Truffle, Ylang Ylang and Black Orchid. Heart Notes: Black Plum and Rum Absolute. Base Note: Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Born In Roma Donna Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Valentino Born In Roma Donna Eau De Parfum (30ml) a floral amber EDP for women which inspires self-celebration and femininity, whilst mirroring the classicism of the Italian city.A zesty opening of Bergamot and Blackcurrant Accord leads on to a heart blending Jasmine with luxurious Vanilla Bourbon. The composition culminates in a sensual, woody base of Cashmeran and Guaiacwood. The multi-faceted bottle bearing Valentino's iconic stud reflects Rome's rich heritage and conveys power and strength. Top Notes: Bergamot Essence and Blackcurrant Accord. Heart Notes: Sambac Jasmine Absolute, Jasmine Grandiflorum and Jasmine Tea. Base Notes: Bourbon Vanilla, Cashmeran and Guaiacwood.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Cafe Rose Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Tom Ford Cafe Rose Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a luxurious, sensual floral EDP for women which entwines opulence and warmth in its sophisticated olfactory melange.Opening with the unexpected combination of Turkish Rose Essence and sultry Dark Coffee, the composition leads on to a heart of sparkling Rose Bulgaria Absolute and dreamy, balsamic Ylang Ylang. This culminates in a spicy infusion of Coriander, Patchouli and Cardamom in the base together with Incense Resin and Sandalwood accords. The fragrant liquid is housed in a semi-transparent rosy pink bottle, adorned with a violet bronze-toned cap and plaque. Top Notes: Rose Essence and Dark Coffee. Heart Notes: Rose Absolute and Ylang Ylang. Base Notes: Coriander, Patchouli, Cardamom, Incense and Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Ted Baker M Eau De Toilette 75ml

Cruelty-free & vegan-friendly. Top notes: Musk, Vetiver and Tonka Bean. Heart notes: Fir Resin and Coriander. Base notes: Amber and Guaiac Wood.

Daylight hits the cobbled walkways and old tiled roofs of civilization passed, yet memories of the night become another new beginning. Bathed in the yellow light of the sun, the Eternal City stirs.This EDP opens with Bergamot Essence, created in the south fields of Italy, complimented by fizzy and zesty Primofiore Lemon. At the heart, Uomo Yellow Dream delves into luxurious notes of Damascan Rose and a delicate Peony scent. A trail of White Musk and Madagascan Vanilla creates an alluring trail of powdery softness. Top Notes: Lemon and Italian Bergamot. Heart Notes: Damascan Rose and Peony. Base Notes: White Musk and Madagascan Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Velvet Orchid Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Tom Ford Velvet Orchid Eau De Parfum (50ml) is an ultra-feminine floral amber EDP for women which refines the glamorous mystique of Black Orchid with a harmonious, appealing identity, lavishing the wearer with a shimmering veil of floral freshness. Placing the sophisticated floral signature of Black Orchid at its heart, this composition features a warm femininity born of its profusion of floral notes in contrast to the spicy, woody elements which characterise the original Black Orchid scent.Opening with a sweet and zesty blend of Mandarin, golden Rum and warming, gourmand Honey, the composition leads on to an overtly floral heart comprising multifarious scents including Rose, Jasmine, Magnolia and Hyacinth, all enveloping the opulence of the Black Orchid. This culminates in a sensuous base featuring creamy Vanilla, luxurious Suede and powdery amber Labdanum. The fragrant liquid is housed in a dark pearlised violet flacon adorned with a gold-toned plaque. Top Notes: Italian Bergamot, Mandarin, Rum Succan Absolute and Honey. Heart Notes: Jasmine, Turkish Rose, Cattleya Leopoldii Orchid, Black Orchid, Orange Blossom, Moroccan Rose, Heliotropin, Magnolia, Jonquil and Hyacinth. Base Notes: Labdanum, Peru Balsam, Myrrh, Suede and Comoro Island Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Donna Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Valentino Donna Eau De Parfum (30ml) is a floral, woody fragrance for women which effectively captures the timeless spirit of La Dolce Vita, Italian meaning The Sweet Life'. Donna is an EDP concocted to celebrate the modern woman and their collective journeys of romance, grace and femininity.This floral perfume opens with radiant and bright bursts of Grapefruit and Bergamot, accompanied by a Blackcurrant Accord before developing into a fruity heart of Rose Essence and sweet Peach Accord. The perfume dries down to create a trail of Iris and Vanilla Accord. Presented in a transparent, multi-faceted crystal glass bottle, decorated with a reflective gold stopper and finished with a gold-detailed Valentino logo. Top Notes: Grapefruit Accord, Bergamot Essence and Blackcurrant Accord. Heart Notes: Rose Essence, Rose Accord, Peach Accord and Iris Accord. Base Notes: Patchouli Essence, Vanilla Accord and Praline Accord.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Ombre Leather Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Tom Ford Ombre Leather Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a floral leather, deeply textural EDP which bestows the wearer with a tactile sensuality and the beautiful sense of being desired.With each olfactory note inspired by Tom Ford's American West upbringing, the composition opens with the intensely powerful green scent of Violet Leaf Absolute in combination with the invigorating warm, sweet spice of Cardamom. This leads to a captivating heart where fragrant Jasmine Sambac with its Honeysuckle facets meets the luxurious, creamy sensuality of the signature Black Leather notes. The intoxicating earthiness of Patchouli in the base is given a fresh crispness by the presence of Moss whilst Amber brings a sweet richness. The fragrant liquid is housed in a matte black flacon adorned with a faux leather plaque. Top Notes: Cardamom and Violet Flower. Heart Notes: Jasmine and Black Leather. Base Notes: Amber, Patchouli and Moss.

listings.description: Valentino Born In Roma Uomo Coral Fantasy Eau De Toilette (100ml) invites you to bask in the new Rome at sunset. This amber, fruity fragrance is inspired by the coral-lit sky over the Eternal City of Rome, capturing the magic of the fragrance within.This fragrance centres around a Red Apple Accord, twisted with notes of Tobacco, a surprisingly elegant mix which evokes warmth from within. Bright Geranium at the heart is complimented by Clary Sage. Warm Tobacco rounds of the fragrance, elevated by Patchouli to reveal a bold and powerful finish. The fragrance is housed in an ombre black and coral pink multi-faceted bottle, finished with the Valentino logo. Top Notes: Red Apple, Cardamom, Calabrian Bergamot. The composition opens with a captivating combination of zesty fruity accords which instantly captures the attention. The citrus melange of juicy Passionfruit, luscious Pear, Raspberry, Cassis and Sand is given an additional touch of allure by the sweet and succulent notes of Peach. This leads on to a heart which reveals the opulent richness of Lily-of-the-Valley, implying feminine sensuality and seduction. This culminates in a captivating, irresistible base of seductive power where the sweetness of Heliotrope melds with the sensual creamy embrace of Vanilla, the earthiness of Patchouli and the woody allure of Sandalwood. Top Notes: Passionfruit, Peach, Pear, Raspberry, Cassis and Sand. Heart Notes: Lily-of-the-Valley. Base Notes: Musk, Sandalwood, Vanilla, Patchouli and Heliotrope.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Ombre Leather Parfum 100ml

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Uomo Born In Roma Eau De Toilette 50ml

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Born In Roma Uomo Coral Fantasy Eau De Toilette 50ml

The fragrance is housed in an ombre black and coral pink multi-faceted bottle, finished with the Valentino logo. Top Notes: Red Apple, Cardamom, Calabrian Bergamot. Heart Notes: Bourbon Geranium, Lavender and Clary Sage. Tobacco Leaf, Patchouli and Haitian Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Donna Born In Roma Intense Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Valentino Donna Born In Roma Intense Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a floral, amber EDP for sophisticated, powerful women who embody the elegance of Rome's modern street culture. This intense and addictive scent pays tribute to the eternal city and its enchanting nights, amplifying the couture elegance of its inspiration.Opening with a captivating blend of Mandarin, Bergamot, and Blackcurrant, this fragrance captures the seductive atmosphere of Rome at dusk. The heart reveals a mesmerising trio of Jasmine, offering a bewitching and passionate embrace. This opulent, luminous floral heart transitions into a warm base of Benzoin and Vanilla, creating a sensuous and irresistible finish. Presented in an iconic studded bottle, Valentino Donna Born In Roma Intense is a nod to the fashion house's rebellious spirit. Drawing inspiration from Roman architecture, the bottle symbolises a new era in high fashion, with the Born In Roma collection celebrating magnificent personalities and pairings through the Uomo (for him) and Donna (for her) duo. Top Notes: Mandarin, Bergamot, Blackcurrant. Heart Notes: Trio of Jasmine. Base Notes: Benzoin, Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Donna Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Valentino Donna Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a floral, woody fragrance for women which effectively captures the timeless spirit of La Dolce Vita, Italian meaning The Sweet Life'. The perfume dries down to create a trail of Iris and Vanilla Accord. Presented in a transparent, multi-faceted crystal glass bottle, decorated with a reflective gold stopper and finished with a gold-detailed Valentino logo. Top Notes: Grapefruit Accord, Bergamot Essence and Blackcurrant Accord. Heart Notes: Rose Essence, Rose Accord, Peach Accord and Iris Accord. Base Notes: Patchouli Essence, Vanilla Accord and Praline Accord.

listings.rawTitle: Ted Baker Floret Amelia Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Ted Baker Floret Amelia Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a fruity floral gourmand EDT for women with a fizzy composition.Opening with zesty Rhubarb, Magnolia and Almond, before leading on to an intensely fragrant floral heart of Heliotrope and Jasmine. This culminates in an earthy base of Tonka and Maple. Top Notes: Rhubarb, Magnolia and Almond. Heart Notes: Jasmine and Heliotrope. Base Notes: Tonka and Maple.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Eros Pour Femme Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Versace Eros Pour Femme Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a floral, woody EDP which conveys attraction, desire, and passion.The alchemy of seductive, luminous, and feminine notes opens with a refined accord of Lemon and Jasmine, enhanced with soft and sensual woods. Pomegranate Seeds surprise and seduce, whilst the Jasmine infusion and Jasmine Sambac Absolute convey an authentic and timeless femininity. Peony petals lend a velvety touch, while the luminous Lemon Flower provides the floral accord. Finally, the Ambroxan is unveiled, mysterious and deep, accompanied by an accord of sensual woods, Sandalwood and Musk, revealing intense and enchanting notes. The gold colour flacon bottle is rounded and embellished with a prominent relief Medusa symbol. Top Notes: Sicilian Lemon, Pomegranate and Calabrian Bergamot. Heart Notes: Lemon Blossom, Jasmine Sambac, Jasmine and Peony. Base Notes: Musk, Ambroxan, Woody Notes and Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Tommy Hilfiger Tommy Girl Eau De Toilette 200ml

Spritz on some Tommy Girl perfume and soak up the lush scents of Mandarin, Apple Blossom and Blackcurrant. These blend perfectly with floral undertones to create a classic EDT which is subtle enough for everyday use. Top Notes: Apple Tree Blossom, Camelia, Mandarin Orange and Black Currant. Heart Notes: Lemon, Honeysuckle, Rose, Grapefruit, Lily, Mint and Violet. Base Notes: Magnolia, Jasmine, Cedar, Sandalwood and Leather.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Noir Eau De Parfum 100ml

This olfactory dichotomy evokes both the refined outward image of the composed urban gentleman and the inner carnal character with his thoughts of eroticism and forbidden pleasure.Comprising only the finest ingredients and iconic accords, the opening reflects this duality with overtly floral notes of Violet Flower and Verbena contrasting with the sharp spice of Pink Pepper and the peppery warmth of Caraway.
