listings.description: Emporio Armani Diamonds She Eau De Parfum 100ml is a sparkling, floral perfume concocted to reflect the individual strength, brilliance, and sexiness or the Emporio Armani woman.This EDP is an olfactory experience of glimmering floral notes which rests upon a bed of Amber. It opens with top notes of Litchi and Raspberry, before developing into a seductive heart of Rose, Patchouli, Freesia, Cedar, and Lily of the Valley. The dry down reveals a base of sweet Vanilla notes, Amber, and Vetiver. Top Notes: Litchi and Raspberry. Heart Notes: Rose, Patchouli, Freesia, Cedar and Lily of the Valley. Base Notes: Vanilla, Amber and Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Emporio Armani She Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Emporio Armani She Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a timeless and ultimately iconic fragrance for women. This floral, oriental and slightly powdery fragrance tells an enticing story of tenderness, sensuality and intimacy.This EDP opens with a refreshing blend of delicate floral Heliotrope and Juicy Pear, which slowly develops to reveal a touch of White Musk, which gives this fragrance its tender feel. This scent comes in a minimalist rose gold-tinted bottle - the star of the show is housed within. Top Notes: Citruses and Pear. Heart Notes: Heliotrope, Angelica, Cardamom and Jasmine. Base Notes: Almond, White Musk, Vanilla, Cedar and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Ghost Deep Night Eau De Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Ghost Deep Night Eau De Toilette (75ml) is a sensual, addictive, and intoxicating fragrance for women which reflects the inky unknown of night. A vast canopy of glittering stars, a crescent moon, silhouettes, and shadows.This mysterious EDT opens with the addictive notes of Indian Rose and Belle De Nuit flower which only opens and releases its perfume at night. This leads to a heart of ripe Peach and Moon Flower, culminating in a powerful and rich base of Vanilla Orchid and Precious Wood. Presented in a violet, crescent moon-shaped bottle, in fitting with the fragrance's theme. Top Notes: Indian Rose and Belle Du Nuit. Heart Notes: White Woods, Apricot and Peach. Base Notes: Vanilla, Amber and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden Beauty Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Elizabeth Arden Beauty Eau De Parfum (100ml) is another classic women's perfume from the iconic beauty house's extensive collection of fragrances. Launched in 2002, Beauty is a refreshingly oriental and woody women's EDP that's ideal for everyday wear.The subtle and sensual aroma is formulated from delicate florals to create a...

listings.rawTitle: Emporio Armani Because It's You For Her Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Emporio Armani Because It's You For Her Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a fruity, floral EDP for women who seek to embody the spirit of modern love, exuding confident elegance and the effortless sensuality of youth.This composition opens with the sparkling citrus combination of Raspberry and Blackcurrant, tempered by the honeyed aroma of Neroli Essence. This leads to a complex, sophisticated heart with animalistic Jasmine combined with rich Rose Absolute and ozonic Violet Leaves. This culminates in an overtly sensual base with creamy Vanilla, earthy Patchouli and woodsy Musk. Top Notes: Raspberry, Blackcurrant and Neroli Essence. Heart Notes: Violet Leaves Accord, Rose Absolute and Jasmin Sambac Absolute. Base Notes: Patchouli Essence, Vanilla Extract and Musks.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Si Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Giorgio Armani Si Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a timeless floral perfume for the resolute yet graceful woman who is sufficiently self-assured to say 'Si' to the values which best define them. The fragrance conveys the contemporary femininity of Giorgio Armani.This EDP exudes the scent of freshly-laundered sheets drying off in the summer breeze, soft and warm with a hint of sophisticated, creamy sweetness. Intense, voluptuous, and deep, it combines the elegance of Freesia with the delightful honey tones of Rose De Mai Absolute to lend it a certain distinction. The lasting, sensual notes of Oakmoss and Patchouli add captivating softness to this modern chypre. The gold ring which encircles the neck of the Armani Si bottle serves as a symbol of eternity, a perfect wedding, engagement, or anniversary icon. Top Notes: Blackcurrant Liqueur. Heart Notes: Rose de Mai Absolute and Freesia. Base Notes: Patchouli and Oakmoss.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Dylan Blue Pour Homme Eau De Toilette 200ml
listings.description: Versace Dylan Blue Pour Homme Eau De Toilette (200ml) is an aromatic, woody fragrance for men which encapsulates the sensual scents of the Mediterranean.This EDT's bold Ambroxan notes are refreshed with hints of Bergamot and Grapefruit. These earthy and citrusy notes are enveloped with Black Pepper, Papyrus Wood and Incense, along with Mineral Musk, Tonka Beans and Saffron. Packaged in a blue, geometric bottle enriched with gold Medusa accents and a gold tone lid, it is finished with a blue and gold box. Top Notes: Calabrian Bergamot, Grapefruit, Water Notes and Fig Leaf. Heart Notes: Ambroxan, Patchouli, Black Pepper, Violet Leaf and Papyrus. Base Notes: Incense, Musk, Tonka Bean and Saffron.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Colonia Club Eau De Cologne 100ml
listings.description: Acqua Di Parma Colonia Club Eau De Cologne (100ml) is a fresh and stylish embodiment of contemporary Italian living, a refined and elegant olfactory interpretation of classic Italian cologne for the gentleman who experiences life with passion.Elegantly dynamic and fresh, the Colonia Club scent is characterised by original top notes of Neroli, Mint and Galbanol. The energetic vitality of the Mint and the freshness of the Galbanol give a new spicy perspective to the traditional Colonia. Top Notes: Sicilian Lemon, Petit Grain, Bergamot, Sicilian Mandarin, Mint and Neroli. Heart Notes: Lavender, Geranium and Galbanol. Base Notes: Haitian Vetiver, White Musk and Ambergris Accord.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro The Most Wanted Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Azzaro The Most Wanted Parfum (100ml) is a woody, spicy parfum for men with an intoxicating, stimulating olfactory signature which entices the wearer into releasing his full store of burning energy.This composition opens with invigorating, comforting Bourbon Vanilla, leading on to a heart of Incandescent Wood Accord. This culminates in the sparkling warmth and spice of Red Ginger. The liquid is housed in Azzaro's emblematic, barrel-shaped fragrance bottle in black, contrasting with the amber scent within. Top Notes: Bourbon Vanilla. Heart Notes: Incandescent Wood Accord. Base Notes: Red Ginger.

listings.rawTitle: Serge Lutens Fleurs d'Oranger Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Serge Lutens Fleurs d'Oranger Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a mythical, radiant and floral EDP from Serge Lutens' Collection Noire which has its origins in his first arrival in Morocco, his senses encountering the country's amazing aromas as Orange Blossom fell from the trees in large white clouds.Opening the composition, Orange Blossom blends with fragrant Jasmine in an overtly floral melange. This scent of happiness concludes with a drydown featuring White Rose. Sumptuous and rich, the scent blends a selection of unique olfactory notes giving it an authentic identity with its numerous scents and colours conveying human's nuanced characters. The fragrant liquid is housed in a minimalist, angular and straight-lined bottle with a refined image which mirrors the exacting character of its creator. Top Notes: Orange Blossom. Heart Notes: Egyptian Jasmine. Base Notes: White Rose.

listings.rawTitle: Paloma Picasso Mon Parfum Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Paloma Picasso Mon Parfum Eau De Parfum (30ml) is a powerfully evocative floral women's EDP which is perfect for those wishing to display a bold and daring aura.The natural floral opening of Rose and Hyacinth perfectly complements the fruity blend of Bergamot and Amalfi Lemon. The overtly floral heart delights with its combination of fragrant Jasmine, Mimosa and Rose before the composition culminates in an earthy, woody and natural base blending Patchouli, Sandalwood and Oakmoss with Honey and Iris. Top Notes: Rose, Angelica, Hyacinth, Bergamot, Ylang Ylang and Lemon. Heart Notes: Rose, Coriander, Mimosa and Jasmine. Base Notes: Oakmoss, Honey, Sandalwood, Amber, Patchouli, Musk and Iris.

listings.rawTitle: Serge Lutens Chergui Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Serge Lutens Chergui Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a warm, heady EDP with an irresistible composition inspired by a scorching desert wind as it consumes shrubs, bushes and berries to concoct oriental, ambery scents. Opening with the overt floral nature of Immortal Flower, the olfactory trail leads on to the warm, spicy and slightly sweet notes of Russian Leather. This culminates in a drydown characterised by the grassy, earthy warmth of Hay. Sumptuous and rich, the scent blends a selection of unique olfactory notes giving it an authentic identity with its numerous scents and colours conveying human's nuanced characters. The fragrant liquid is housed in a minimalist, angular and straight-lined bottle with a refined image which mirrors the exacting character of its creator. Top Notes: Immortal Flower. Heart Notes: Leather of Russia. Base Notes: Hay.

listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Ralph's Club Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Ralph Lauren Ralph's Club Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a fragrance where icons of style and culture meet. This woody, aromatic EDP balances elegance, sophistication and splendour, transporting you to a world of high fashion - the greatest night of your life captured in a fragrance.Fresh notes of Lavandin dance with the warm richness of Virginia Cedarwood, Vetiver and aromatic Clary Sage for a unique, seductive scent. Crafted with natural inspiration in mind, the ingredients are distilled to their highest quality to achieve and clean and long-lasting aroma, making it the most natural fragrance in the Ralph Lauren portfolio. The bottle is elegant, tactile, and timeless, crafted in the shape of a sleek gentleman's flask with the Ralph's Club monogram engraved on the lid, inspired by the glamour of the 1930's Art Deco Club located in the heart of New York City. Top Notes: Lavandin, Apple and Grapefruit. Heart Notes: Clary Sage, Geranium and Orange Blossom. Base Notes: Virginia Cedarwood and Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Polo Red Eau De Toilette 125ml
listings.description: Ralph Lauren Polo Red Eau De Toilette (125ml) is part of the iconic US fashion house's signature collection of men's fragrances. The scent is inspired by the masculinity of a sporting lifestyle - with luxury, fast cars the sole muse of this recreation of the timeless classic.The spicy and woody men's scent embodies the sophisticated man of leisure with a distinctly masculine aroma that is equal parts elegant and adventurous. This EDT opens with refreshing citrus notes that merge with fiery aromatics cooled by Lavender before ending with intense undertones of woods and Coffee. Polo Red comes packaged in the timeless Polo bottle - coloured sports car red with an instantly recognisable silver emblem. Cruelty-free. Top notes: Red Grapefruit, Lemon Oil, and Cranberry Accord. Heart notes: Red Saffron, Lavender, and Sage. Base notes: Redwood, Amber, and Coffee Accord.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Luna Rossa Sport Eau De Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Prada Luna Rossa Sport Eau De Toilette (50ml) is a spicy fougere EDT for men which conveys a competitive and innovative spirit, striving for achievement and ultimate victory.The composition opens with the freshness of Juniper Berries, given a sharp edge in combination with Ginger for vigour and vitality. This leads on to a floral heart with a classic Lavender accord. This culminates in a soothing dry down blending creamy Vanilla with sweet Tonka Bean. Top Notes: Juniper Berries and Ginger. Heart Note: Lavender. Base Notes: Vanilla and Tonka Bean.

listings.rawTitle: Serge Lutens Five O'Clock au Gingembre Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Serge Lutens Five O'Clock au Gingembre Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a spicy, elegant EDP which forms part of Serge Lutens' Collection Noire. Conveying the sensation of a ritual ceremony, the composition is a feast for the connoisseur, opening with candied Ginger conjuring images of English afternoon tea served in the finest black Wedgwood bone china. This leads to an invigorating burst of citrus zest with Bergamot in the heart before the warmth is rekindled by Spices in the drydown. Sumptuous and rich, the scent blends a selection of unique olfactory notes giving it an authentic identity with its numerous scents and colours conveying human's nuanced characters. The fragrant liquid is housed in a minimalist, angular and straight-lined bottle with a refined image which mirrors the exacting character of its creator. Top Notes: Ginger. Heart Notes: Bergamot. Base Notes: Spices.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Invictus Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Paco Rabanne Invictus Eau De Toilette (100ml) paints a portrait of a champion with a magnetic, fresh, and woody fragrance. Crafted for the gallant man, it encompasses a journey of victory, vigour, and vitality. This scent exudes a compelling dance of freshness with its citrus notes and a profound sense of sensual woodiness, offering a bold and magnetic allure that is distinctly Paco Rabanne.With a composition befitting a hero, the EDT features the pure and invigorating Marine Accord and the spirited Laurel Leaf at its pinnacle. The heart unveils a symphony of Ambergris Accord harmoniously united with the spirited burst of Grapefruit Zest, creating an enticing core. The journey culminates with the grounding forces of Guaiac Wood and the rich depth of Patchouli, laying down a sturdy foundation that echoes strength and endurance. The bottle stands as a trophy for our modern heroes, a glass sculpture designed by Cedric Ragot that illustrates athletic robustness in a simple yet triumphant manner. The cup of victory with its shining top signifies courage and strength, encouraging the bearer to embrace their invincible spirit with Invictus. Top Notes: Marine Accord and Laurel Leaf. Heart Notes: Ambergris Accord and Grapefruit Zest. Base Notes: Guaiac Wood and Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Romance Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Ralph Lauren Romance Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a floral women's fragrance from the iconic US fashion house's collection. The timeless scent is inspired by the essence of falling in love - a romantic, tender women's perfume that evokes powerful emotion.This fresh and clean fragrance is distinctly feminine and ideal for wear during the spring and summer months. This EDP opens with flirtatious florals that gradually become more pronounced as they reach velvety soft woods to create a light fragrance that can be worn at any time. Romance comes minimally packaged in a beautiful square bottle with silver detailing. Cruelty-free. Top notes: Sun Goddess, Rose, Marigold, Ginger, Chamomile Oil, and Yellow Freesia. Heart notes: White Violet, Lotus Flower, and Lily. Patchouli, Musk, and Oak Moss.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Amber Woman Eau De Parfum 80ml
listings.description: Prada Amber Woman Eau De Parfum (80ml) is a sensually hypnotising, floral EDP for women, as timeless as it is luxurious. Rich and opulent in its composition, this fragrance is described as a reinvention of traditional perfumery, balancing delicate floral notes with warm woods and seductive musk to create a perfume that is an enduring ode to unwavering femininity.This fragrance opens with green notes of Tarragon and Bergamot, before developing into a sweet, floral heart of Honey, Carnation, Ylang-Ylang, Jasmine and Rose. This perfume settles on a luxurious bed of Patchouli, Amber, Benzoin, Sandalwood, Vanilla, Oakmoss and Musk. Housed in a minimalist, transparent glass bottle, it showcases the Amber within - the real star of the show. Top Notes: Tarragon, Green Notes, Bergamot and Fruity Notes. Heart Notes: Honey, Carnation Ylang-Ylang, Jasmine and Rose. Base Notes: Patchouli, Amber, Benzoin, Sandalwood, Vanilla, Oakmoss and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Roberto Cavalli Eau De Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Roberto Cavalli Eau De Parfum (75ml) is a floral, amber fragrance for women centred on notes of Orange Blossom, symbolising Italian femininity, sensuality, and extravagance. Pink Pepper spikes its temperament with colourful shades, a seductive smile revealing a burst of Orange Blossom.Its sensual, velvety soft curves leave an unforgettable note of roasted Fava Tonka. This EDP is presented in a round bottle, topped with a tiara-shaped stopper bearing the designer's initials. Golden hues and leopard print decorate the bottle and packaging. Top Note: Pink Pepper. Heart Note: African Orange Flower. Base Notes: Vanilla, Benzoin and Tonka Bean.

listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Safari for Him Eau De Toilette 125ml
listings.description: Ralph Lauren Safari for Him Eau De Toilette (125ml) is a woody men's fragrance from the iconic US fashion house's renowned collection. Inspired by the masculinity of a sporting lifestyle, this EDT is a medley of distinctly masculine notes - designed for adventurous men who like to walk on the wild side.The scent opens with clean and fresh notes that seamlessly blend into a cocktail of spices and florals before ending in longlasting woods, leather and Musk. Safari is regally packaged in an embossed glass bottle with a silver coat of arms insignia. Cruelty-free. Top notes: Coriander, Lavender, Lemon, and Green Notes. Heart notes: Cyclamen, Carnation, Cinnamon, Tarragon, Jasmine, and Rose. Base notes: Leather, Sandalwood, Amber, Patchouli, Oakmoss, and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Ralph Eau De Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Ralph Lauren Ralph Eau De Toilette (50ml) is a fresh, youthful women's fragrance from the iconic US fashion house's collection. Ralph is a warm and aromatic scent that exudes the stylish confidence of youth. This fragrance was inspired by the prestigious designer's daughter and her friends, saying it was for young women who approach life with confidence, style, and complete optimism'.This women's EDT opens with fruity notes and a heart laden with exotic florals that give way to more intense Musk and woody Orris. The scent comes packaged in a compact glass bottle with ice blue detailing. Cruelty-free. Top notes: Apple Tree Leaves, Yellow Freesia, and Italian Mandarin. Heart notes: Japanese Osmanthus, Magnolia, Linden Blossom, Freesia, and Boronia. Base notes: Musk and White Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Sabrina Carpenter Sweet Tooth Eau De Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Sabrina Carpenter Sweet Tooth Eau De Parfum (75ml) is a sweet and fruity EDP created by the multi-talented actress and pop star, Sabrina Carpenter. Embodying her love for desserts, this signature fragrance is not only an expression of Sabrina's playful and light-hearted nature but is also vegan-friendly and cruelty-free, making...

listings.rawTitle: Serge Lutens Un Bois Vanille Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Serge Lutens Un Bois Vanille Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a carnal, sensual and woody EDP which takes its inspiration from the conquistador Hernan Cortes' journey to the heart of the forgotten Aztec civilisation where he discovered the heavenly Vanilla nectar. The composition opens with creamy Mexican Vanilla in its sultry black form, leading on to a refined, contrasting heart of warm and creamy Sandalwood. The olfactory trail culminates in the gourmand, earthy notes of Liquorice with its scent reminiscent of Aniseed and Caramel. Sumptuous and rich, the scent blends a selection of unique olfactory notes giving it an authentic identity with its numerous scents and colours conveying human's nuanced characters. The fragrant liquid is housed in a minimalist, angular and straight-lined bottle with a refined image which mirrors the exacting character of its creator. Top Notes: Mexican Black Vanilla. Heart Notes: Sandalwood. Base Notes: Liquorice.

listings.rawTitle: Sarah Jessica Parker Lovely Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Sarah Jessica Parker Lovely Eau De Parfum (30ml) is the original signature scent from the Sex in the City star's popular fragrance collection. The Eau De Parfum spray is influenced by a love of perfumery that was inspired by the actress' mother - and her first fragrance pays homage to that influence.Created by layering scents, Lovely is a silky, White-Amber fragrance with a timeless allure. Crafted as a soft, powdery fragrance for women of all ages, the perfume is packaged in a delicate pink bottle with SJP's trademark grosgrain ribbon which has become an iconic element throughout her style. Cruelty-free. Top notes: Mandarin, Bergamot, Rosewood, Lavender and Apple Martini. Heart notes: Patchouli, Paper Whites and Orchid. Base notes: Cedar Wood, White Amber, Musks and Woods.

listings.rawTitle: Shay & Blue Blood Oranges Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Shay & Blue Blood Oranges Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a zesty and refreshing unisex fragrance exuding bursts of Blood Orange, underpinned with an opulent and sensual blend of Musk, Woods and smoky, passionate Leather.All Shay & Blue scents are made with real flowers, fruits and spices with a long-lasting scent. They are carefully handcrafted in England and produced to the highest standards of animal and planet welfare. Cruelty-free & vegan-friendly. Top Note: Blood Orange. Heart Notes: Napa Leather. Base Notes: Musk, Charred Woods and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Strictly Professional Eau De Cologne 500ml
listings.description: Strictly Professional Eau De Cologne (500ml) is a floral EDC ideal for use to freshen up clients following treatments or visits at the salon.A delicate blend of florals like Rose, Orange Flower Water and Lemon Essential Oil offer a cooling and refreshing scent. Ideal to also add to baths or pedicure water for a more luxury experience.

listings.rawTitle: Shay & Blue Salt Caramel Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Shay & Blue Salt Caramel Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a unisex amber vanilla EDP which is both addictive and comforting. Featuring glossy Caramel at the top, the composition moves on to deliciously frothy Sea Salt before culminating in a woody, earthy dry down of Tonka Bean and Sandalwood. All Shay & Blue scents are made with real flowers, fruits and spices with a long-lasting scent. They are carefully handcrafted in England and produced to the highest standards of animal and planet welfare. Cruelty-free & vegan-friendly. Top Notes: Caramel. Heart Notes: Sea Salt. Base Notes: Tonka Bean and Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Shay & Blue Black Tulip Eau De Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Shay & Blue Black Tulip Eau De Parfum (10ml) is a decadent, floral unisex fragrance for daytime and evening wear with a smooth finish. Oriental Plum mingles with creamy White Chocolate and Wood, leading to contrasting sensual undertones of fresh Cyclamen.All Shay & Blue scents are made with real flowers, fruits and spices with a long-lasting scent. They are carefully handcrafted in England and produced to the highest standards of animal and planet welfare. Vegan-friendly and cruelty-free. Top Notes: Snowdrops and Cyclamen. Heart Notes: Black Tulip and Plum. Base Notes: White Chocolate and Soft Woods.

listings.rawTitle: Serge Lutens Ambre Sultan Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Serge Lutens Ambre Sultan Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a singular, Arab-influenced EDP comprising a melange of unique and authentic olfactory notes. The composition's opening features resinous Amber, taking its inspiration from a fragment of amber resin unearthed by Serge Lutens in the soukhs of Marrakech inside a thuja wooden box. Combining this with tar-like Cistus, the heart adds creamy and sensuous Vanilla. This culminates in an earthy base of Patchouli. Sumptuous and rich, the scent blends a selection of unique olfactory notes giving it an authentic identity with its numerous scents and colours conveying human's nuanced characters. The fragrant liquid is housed in a minimalist, angular and straight-lined bottle with a refined image which mirrors the exacting character of its creator. Top Notes: Amber. Heart Notes: Vanilla. Base Notes: Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Shay & Blue Black Tulip Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Shay & Blue Black Tulip Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a decadent, floral unisex fragrance for daytime and evening wear with a smooth finish. Oriental Plum mingles with creamy White Chocolate and Wood, leading to contrasting sensual undertones of fresh Cyclamen.All Shay & Blue scents are made with real flowers, fruits and spices with a long-lasting scent. They are carefully handcrafted in England and produced to the highest standards of animal and planet welfare. Vegan-friendly and cruelty-free. Top Notes: Snowdrops and Cyclamen. Heart Notes: Black Tulip and Plum. Base Notes: White Chocolate and Soft Woods.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Eau De Soleil Blanc Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Tom Ford Eau De Soleil Blanc Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a radiant citrus floral fragrance that captures the warmth and luminosity of sunlit skin. Bright and transportive, it evokes a carefree escape where sparkling freshness meets indulgent, sun-drenched sensuality.The scent begins with an uplifting burst of citrus, where Vert De Bergamot, Orange Bitter Orpur and Petitgrain Bigarade Orpur create a crisp, vibrant opening, softened by the savoury warmth of Pistachio Accord and a hint of Cardamom spice. As it develops, a luminous floral heart of Tuberose, Ylang Ylang and Orange Blossom unfolds, enriched by a creamy Coco De Mer Accord. The fragrance settles into a smooth, addictive warmth, where ambered tones wrap the composition in a soft, sun-kissed glow. Encapsulating the golden radiance of Soleil, the fragrance is housed in Tom Ford's signature fluted bottle, finished in a luminous ivory tone that reflects its warm, glowing character. Top Notes: Vert De Bergamot, Orange Bitter Orpur and Petitgrain Bigarade Orpur. Heart Notes: Tuberose, Ylang Ylang, Orange Blossom and Coco De Mer Accord. Base Notes: Amber and Pistachio Accord.

listings.rawTitle: Sarah Jessica Parker NYC Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Sarah Jessica Parker NYC Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a celebration of fashion and fragrance inspired by the Sex and the City's star's synonymous relationship with style and New York. Influenced by the actress' love of layering unexpected clothes and scents, NYC Eau De Parfum is a deliciously addictive floral fragrance that embodies fashion and feminine expression.The perfume was released in 2010 and described as a party in a bottle, a sensual, floral fragrance that is suitable for both everyday wear and special occasions. The perfume comes packaged in a fun spray that is colourfully adorned with contrasting prints, a signature style of SJP's Carrie Bradshaw character. Cruelty-free.Top notes: Mandarin, White Ostmanthus and Wild Strawberries. Heart notes: Gardenia, Honeysuckle, Mimosa and Red Damascene Rose. Base notes: Vanilla, Sandalwood, Musk and Rum.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Noir Extreme Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Tom Ford Noir Extreme Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a woody amber EDP for men which intensifies the original Noir Extreme scent, infusing an elevated concentration of spicy Indian Cardamom, enhanced by the warmth of an Amber Accord and the rich sensuality of Venezuelan Tonka Bean.Exuding refinement, allure and seduction, the composition opens with an enigmatic combination of citrus and spice elements as Mandarin Oil, Neroli Oil and North Africa Orpur encounter the vibrant heat of Saffron, Cardamom and Nutmeg. This leads on to an overtly floral heart with Rose Absolute, Jasmine Accord and Orange Flower joined unexpectedly by the milky coolness of Indian Kulfi. This culminates in the sensual woody, amber base with the deep, creamy sweetness of Sandalwood and Vanilla drenched in a profusion of Amber. Top Notes: Mandarin Oil, Neroli Oil, North Africa Orpur, Saffron, Cardamom and Nutmeg. Heart Notes: Indian Kulfi, Rose Absolute, Jasmine Accord and Orange Flower. Base Notes: Amber, Venezuelan Tonka Bean Absolute, Sandalwood and Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Black Orchid Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Tom Ford Black Orchid Eau De Parfum (30ml) is an iconic, seductive amber chypre EDP which fuses elements of spice and darkness to unleash a potent sensuality which is both modern and timeless.Featuring a combination of rich, dark accords with the alluring potion of Black Orchid and Spice, the composition opens with the decadent complexity of Black Truffle in a zesty and floral melange with Blackcurrant, Bergamot and Ylang Ylang. This leads on to an opulent heart where sophisticated Black Orchid is given warmth by spicy notes. The sensuous base blends a profusion of olfactory notes into an earthy, woody, rich and creamy blend with Patchouli, Sandalwood, Dark Chocolate and Vanilla heightening its seduction. The fragrant liquid is housed in a black, fluted glass flacon whose ribbed detailing seeks to convey the distinctive features of the architecture of the 1920's and 1930's with its style and glamour. Top Notes: Black Truffle, Blackcurrant, Bergamot and Ylang Ylang. Heart Notes: Black Orchid, Spicy Notes, Rich Fruit Accords and Lotus Wood. Base Notes: Vetiver, Patchouli, Sandalwood, Balsam, Dark Chocolate, Incense, Amber and Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Roberto Cavalli Paradiso Eau De Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Roberto Cavalli Paradiso Eau De Parfum (75ml) is a floral, woody and musky fragrance for women which is refined, carnal, sensual, and feminine, but also relaxed and carefree. Paradiso provides the key to a parallel world embraced by a secret garden in a magnificent villa nestled on the coast of the Mediterranean Sea. A tantalising prelude of crisp citrus notes blend with warm exotic Bergamot and sweet Mandarin. A fresh and sparkling head gives way to a subtle heart of wild Jasmine. The base note of this EDP boasts a rich and delicate accord of Cypress, Oleander and Mediterranean Pine. A refined accord of Italian aromas extends and intensifies the hypnotic effect of the Jasmine, generating a persistent woody base note. Top Notes: Citrus, Mandarin Orange and Bergamot. Heart Notes: Jasmine. Base Notes: Pine Tree, Cypress and Laurels.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Noir Extreme Eau De Parfum 150ml
listings.description: Tom Ford Noir Extreme Eau De Parfum (150ml) is a woody amber EDP for men which intensifies the original Noir Extreme scent, infusing an elevated concentration of spicy Indian Cardamom, enhanced by the warmth of an Amber Accord and the rich sensuality of Venezuelan Tonka Bean.Exuding refinement, allure and seduction, the composition opens with an enigmatic combination of citrus and spice elements as Mandarin Oil, Neroli Oil and North Africa Orpur encounter the vibrant heat of Saffron, Cardamom and Nutmeg. This leads on to an overtly floral heart with Rose Absolute, Jasmine Accord and Orange Flower joined unexpectedly by the milky coolness of Indian Kulfi. This culminates in the sensual woody, amber base with the deep, creamy sweetness of Sandalwood and Vanilla drenched in a profusion of Amber. This women's scent comes packaged in an eye-catching triangular bottle with Britney's name engraved on the silver top. Top Notes: Guava and Tangerine. Heart Notes: Honeysuckle and Linden Blossom. Base Notes: Patchouli, Amber and Praline.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Weekend for Women Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Burberry Weekend For Women Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a floral, powdery fragrance to accompany a relaxed, weekend lifestyle.This feminine scent, first launched in 1997, has a refreshing, citrusy tone, opening with notes of Tangerine, Tree Sap and Reseda Plant, leading to delicate floral notes of Wild Rose, Peach Blossom, Iris and Hyacinth, culminating in a subtle splash of Nectarine. This soft, feminine EDP becomes more iconic as the years pass. It is presented in simple glass bottle which fits perfectly into any fragrance collection. Top Notes: Mignonette, Mandarin Orange and Sage. Heart Notes: Nectarine, Blue Hyacinth, Peach Blossom, Rose Hip, Iris, Red Cyclamen and Violet Root. Base Notes: Musk, Sandalwood and Cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Hero Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Burberry Hero Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a woody fragrance for men which conveys the paradox of strength and subtlety, power and compassion, athleticism and creativity. Reflecting the metaphor of the natural world, creatures pushing beyond their physical limitations to transform themselves, this EDT depicts masculine endeavour, striving for metamorphosis.Opening with the sparkling luminosity and freshness of Bergamot, the composition leads on to a woody heart encompassing three variants of Cedarwood sourced from Virginia's Appalachian Mountains, the Atlas Mountains of Morocco and the Himalayan Mountains in Asia. This culminates in a vibrantly fresh drydown combining invigorating Juniper with warming Black Pepper. The angular bottle abstractly nods towards the shape of a horse's hoof, engraved with the Burberry logo. Top Notes: Bergamot Essence. Heart Notes: Cedarwood Trio. Base Notes: Black Pepper and Juniper.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Touch for Men Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Burberry Touch for Men Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a clean, refreshing, woody floral fragrance which embodies an innate male Britishness. This easy-going fragrance encompasses a symphony of complimenting fragrance notes, making it a super-convenient and ideal for throwing on for any occasion. Opening with notes of Artemisia, Mandarin Tree and Violet Leaves, scents of Nutmeg, Virginia Cedar Wood and White Pepper add warmth. This culminates in the woody aroma of Vetiver and the soft musk of Tonka Beans to provide depth. This EDT is presented in a clean, blue-tinted glass bottle with stylish wooden black top. Top Notes: Artemisia, Mandarin Tree and Violet Leaves. Heart Notes: Nutmeg, Virginia Cedar Wood and White Pepper. Base Notes: Vetiver, Soft Musk and Tonka Beans.

listings.rawTitle: Byredo Gypsy Water Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Byredo Gypsy Water Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a woody aromatic EDP for women and men whose name and composition pay homage to the beauty of Romani culture, its unique values, intimate beliefs and alternative way of life. Created with a medium intensity, the scent depicts the concept of an innately nomadic, characterful lifestyle.Opening with a zesty, spicy melange of Bergamot, Juniper Berries, Lemon and Pepper, the olfactory trail leads on to woody notes of Pine Needle, powdery Orris and exotic Incense before culminating in a sensual base of creamy Vanilla, Sandalwood and powdery Amber. Top Notes: Bergamot, Juniper Berries, Lemon and Pepper. Heart Notes: Incense, Orris and Pine Needle. Base Notes: Amber, Sandalwood and Vanilla.
